name: pow_map_bij
statement:
theorem pow_map_bij {p : M} {q : N} {a : ENNReal}
    (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) (hqnt : IsNontrivial q) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hat : a ≠ ⊤)
    (h : a⁻¹ * ((fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ q ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥) = (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥) :
    Function.Bijective (pow_map p q a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Function.Bijective (fun r ↦ a * r) := by
    simp [← IsUnit.isUnit_iff_mulLeft_bijective, ENNReal.isUnit_iff, ha0, hat]
  let f : ℝ≥0∞ ≃o ℝ≥0∞ := ⟨⟨fun r ↦ a * r, fun r ↦ a⁻¹ * r, by
    intro r
    simp [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel_left ha0 hat], by
    intro r
    simp [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel_left ha0 hat]⟩, by
    simp only [Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
    exact ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_right ha0 hat⟩
  constructor
  · refine comp_pseudoInvAnti_injective ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Antitone.comp_monotone (rpow_right_anti q) mul_right_mono
    · refine StrictAntiOn.comp_strictMonoOn (rpow_right_strictAntiOn' q hqnt) ?_ ?_
      · exact StrictMono.strictMonoOn (ENNReal.mul_right_strictMono ha0 hat) _
      · intro x
        simp
    · exact Function.Surjective.comp (rpow_right_surjective _ hqnt)
        (Function.Bijective.surjective ha)
    · rw [show (fun r ↦ a * r) = f by rfl, pseudoInvAnti_comp]
      simp [f, h]
    · exact rpow_right_anti p
    · exact rpow_right_continuous p hpnt.1
    · simp [one_eq_top]
    · rw [rpow_top _ hpnt.2, zero_eq_bot]
  · refine comp_pseudoInvAnti_surjective ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Antitone.comp_monotone (rpow_right_anti q) mul_right_mono
    · exact Continuous.comp (rpow_right_continuous q hqnt.1) (ENNReal.continuous_const_mul hat)
    · simp [one_eq_top]
    · simp [ENNReal.mul_top ha0, rpow_top _ hqnt.2, zero_eq_bot]
    · rw [show (fun r ↦ a * r) = f by rfl, pseudoInvAnti_comp]
      simp [f, h]
    · exact rpow_right_anti p
    · exact rpow_right_strictAntiOn' p hpnt

name: rpow_pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti
statement:
lemma rpow_pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti {p : M}  (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) :
    StrictAnti (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  refine pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti ?_ ?_ (rpow_right_continuous _ hpnt.1) (rpow_right_anti _)
  · simp [rpow_top p hpnt.2, zero_eq_bot]
  · simp [one_eq_top]

name: lt_rpow_mul_pseudoInvAnti
statement:
lemma lt_rpow_mul_pseudoInvAnti {p x : M} {q : N} {a : ENNReal}
    (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hat : a ≠ ⊤)
    (h : a⁻¹ * ((fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ q ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥) = (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥)
    (hx : ⊥ < x) : ⊥ < q ^ (a * (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ x)
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti (rpow_right_anti q) ?_
  contrapose! hx
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_mul_le_iff ha0 hat, h] at hx
  contrapose! hx
  exact rpow_pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti hpnt hx

name: rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_zero
statement: lemma rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_zero {p : M} (hp : p ≠ 0) : (fun r : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bot_eq_zero, ne_eq, eq_bot_iff]
  push Not
  rw [pseudoInvAnti, lt_sSup_iff]
  rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero', zero_eq_bot] at hp
  use 1
  simp [hp]

name: rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top
statement:
lemma rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top [Nilpotent M] {p : M} (hp1 : p ≠ 1) :
    (fun r : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, eq_top_iff, pseudoInvAnti]
  push Not
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nilpotent.nilpt p hp1
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (ENNReal.natCast_lt_top n)
  refine sSup_le ?_
  simp only [gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  intro x hnx
  contrapose! hnx
  rw [← zero_eq_bot, ← hn, ← RatPow.qpow_eq_npow, ← rpow_eq_qpow]
  exact rpow_right_anti p <| by simp [le_of_lt hnx]

name: iso_luk_of_nilpt
statement:
theorem iso_luk_of_nilpt (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [CompleteLinearOrder M]
    [DenselyOrdered M] [Tnorm M] [IsFuzzyLogic M] [Nilpotent M] [Nontrivial M] :
    Nonempty (@OrderMonoidIso M unitInterval _ _ _ Tnorm.lukMul)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_between (zero_lt_one' unitInterval)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_between (zero_lt_one' M)
  have hpnt : IsNontrivial p := by grind
  have hqnt : IsNontrivial q := by grind
  let a : ℝ≥0∞ :=
    ((fun r : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ (@instRealPow unitInterval Tnorm.lukMonoid _).pow q r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥) *
    ((fun r ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥)⁻¹
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, ENNReal.inv_eq_zero, not_or, a]
    constructor
    · exact @rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_zero unitInterval _ _ _ Tnorm.lukTnorm _ _ _ hqnt.1
    · exact rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top hpnt.2
  have hat : a ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_top, inv_eq_top, hpnt.1, not_false_eq_true,
      rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_zero, and_false, ENNReal.inv_eq_zero, hpnt.2,
      rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top, and_true, false_or, a]
    exact @rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top unitInterval _ _ _ Tnorm.lukTnorm _ _ _ _ hqnt.2
  have h : a⁻¹ * ((fun r : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ (@instRealPow unitInterval Tnorm.lukMonoid _).pow q r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥) =
      (fun r ↦ p ^ r)⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ := by
    simp [a]
    rw [ENNReal.mul_inv, inv_inv, mul_comm, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel_left]
    · exact @rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_zero unitInterval _ _ _ Tnorm.lukTnorm _ _ _ hqnt.1
    · exact @rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top unitInterval _ _ _ Tnorm.lukTnorm _ _ _ _ hqnt.2
    · simp_rw [ne_eq, ENNReal.inv_eq_top, ← ne_eq]
      left
      exact @rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_zero unitInterval _ _ _ Tnorm.lukTnorm _ _ _ hqnt.1
    · simp_rw [ne_eq, ENNReal.inv_eq_zero, ← ne_eq]
      right
      exact rpow_pseudoInvAnti_bot_ne_top hpnt.2
  use @pow_iso M unitInterval _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Tnorm.lukTnorm _ _ _ _ _ hpnt hqnt ha0 hat h
  simp

name: RealPow.rpow_def
statement: lemma rpow_def (p : M) (x : ℝ≥0∞) : p ^ x = sInf ((p ^ ·) '' {s : ℚ | ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ x})
proof: := rfl

name: RealPow.rpow_right_anti
statement: theorem rpow_right_anti (p : M) : Antitone (fun (x : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  simp only [rpow_def, le_sInf_iff, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
  grind [sInf_le]

name: RealPow.rpow_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_top [IsOrderedMonoid M] [OneTop M] [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M]
    (p : M) (hp : p ≠ 1) : p ^ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def, le_top, Set.setOf_true, Set.image_univ, zero_eq_bot, sInf_eq_bot,
    Set.mem_range, exists_exists_eq_and]
  intro q hq
  suffices ∃ n : ℕ, p ^ n < q by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this
    use n
    rw [qpow_eq_npow]
    exact hn
  rw [← zero_eq_bot] at hq
  rw [one_eq_top, ← lt_top_iff_ne_top, ← one_eq_top] at hp
  exact MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch hq hp

name: RealPow.one_rpow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_rpow [OneTop M] (r : ℝ≥0∞) : (1 : M) ^ r = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def, one_qpow]
  rw [Set.Nonempty.image_const]
  · exact sInf_singleton
  · use 0
    simp

name: RealPow.rpow_eq_qpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_eq_qpow (p : M) (r : ℚ) : p ^ (ENNReal.ofReal r) = p ^ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def]
  refine le_antisymm (by grind [sInf_le]) ?_
  refine le_sInf ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
  intro a har
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff', Rat.cast_le, Rat.cast_nonpos] at har
  rcases har with har | ha
  · exact qpow_right_anti p har
  · by_cases! hp : p = 1
    · simp [hp]
    rw [(qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos _ _ hp).mpr ha]
    exact le_one _

name: RealPow.rpow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_zero (p : M) : p ^ (0 : ℝ≥0∞) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← npow_zero p, ← qpow_eq_npow, ← rpow_eq_qpow]
  simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, Rat.cast_zero, ofReal_zero]

name: RealPow.rpow_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_one (p : M) : p ^ (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = p
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← npow_one p]
  rw [← qpow_eq_npow]
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, ← rpow_eq_qpow, Rat.cast_one, ofReal_one]

name: RealPow.rpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos
statement: lemma rpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos (p : M) (x : ℝ≥0∞) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) : p ^ x = 1 ↔ x ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def, one_eq_top, sInf_eq_top, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
  simp only [← one_eq_top, qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos p _ hp1]
  constructor
  · contrapose!
    intro h
    rw [ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn] at h
    obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr0', hrx⟩ := h
    use r
    constructor
    · rw [ENNReal.ofNNReal_toNNReal] at hrx
      exact le_of_lt hrx
    · simpa using hr0'
  · rw [nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
    intro hx a hax
    subst hx
    simpa using hax

name: RealPow.rpow_ne_zero_of_lt_sSup
statement:
lemma rpow_ne_zero_of_lt_sSup (p : M) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0∞) (hx : x < sSup {y | p ^ y ≠ 0}) :
    p ^ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hx
  refine csSup_le ?_ ?_
  · use 1
    simp [hp0]
  · simp only [ne_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro y
    contrapose!
    intro hy
    rw [← le_zero_iff_zero, ← hx]
    exact rpow_right_anti p (le_of_lt hy)

name: RealPow.rpow_right_injOn
statement:
theorem rpow_right_injOn (p : M) (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) :
    Set.InjOn (p ^ ·) (Set.Icc 0 (sSup {x : ℝ≥0∞ | p ^ x ≠ 0}))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
  wlog hle : x ≤ y
  · symm at hxy
    symm
    exact this p hpnt hy hx hxy (by grind)
  · refine le_antisymm hle ?_
    contrapose! hxy
    obtain ⟨r, hr0, hrx, hry⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn.mp hxy
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hsx, hsr⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn.mp hrx
    symm
    refine ne_of_lt ?_
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (rpow_right_anti p (le_of_lt hry)) ?_
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (rpow_right_anti p (le_of_lt hsx))
    simp [ENNReal.ofNNReal_toNNReal] at hsx hsr ⊢ hrx hry
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg, Rat.cast_lt] at hsr
    · refine qpow_strictAnti _ _ _ ?_ hsr
      constructor
      · rw [← rpow_eq_qpow]
        exact rpow_ne_zero_of_lt_sSup p hpnt.1 (ENNReal.ofReal r) (by grind)
      · rw [ne_eq, qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos _ _ hpnt.2]
        grind
    · simp [hs0]

name: RealPow.rpow_right_strictAntiOn
statement:
theorem rpow_right_strictAntiOn (p : M) (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) :
    StrictAntiOn (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r) (Set.Icc 0 (sSup {x : ℝ≥0∞ | p ^ x ≠ 0}))
proof:
:= by
  refine AntitoneOn.strictAntiOn_of_injOn ?_ <| (rpow_right_injOn p hpnt)
  exact Antitone.antitoneOn (rpow_right_anti p) _

name: RealPow.rpow_right_strictAntiOn'
statement:
theorem rpow_right_strictAntiOn' (p : M) (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) :
    StrictAntiOn (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r) ((p ^ ·)⁻¹' ({q : M | q ≠ ⊥}))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← zero_eq_bot]
  suffices (p ^ ·)⁻¹' ({q : M | q ≠ 0}) ⊆ Set.Icc 0 (sSup {x : ℝ≥0∞ | p ^ x ≠ 0}) by
    exact StrictAntiOn.mono (rpow_right_strictAntiOn p hpnt) this
  intro x
  simp only [ne_eq, Set.preimage_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc, zero_le, true_and]
  intro hx
  refine le_sSup ?_
  grind

name: RealPow.rpow_right_seqContinuous
statement:
theorem rpow_right_seqContinuous (p : M) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) :
    SeqContinuous (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hpnt : ¬IsNontrivial p
  · simp_all [Continuous.seqContinuous continuous_const]
  intro x r hxt
  simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt, Function.comp_apply] at hxt ⊢
  constructor
  · intro q hq
    suffices ∃ s : ℝ≥0∞, r < s ∧ q < p ^ s by
      obtain ⟨s, hsr, hs⟩ := this
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hxt.2 s hsr
      use N
      intro n hn
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hs <| rpow_right_anti p <| le_of_lt <| hN n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩ := qpow_between p _ _ hpnt hq
    use ENNReal.ofReal s
    simp only [rpow_eq_qpow, hs, and_true]
    contrapose! hsr
    rw [← rpow_eq_qpow]
    exact rpow_right_anti p hsr
  · intro q hq
    suffices ∃ s : ℝ≥0∞, s < r ∧ p ^ s < q by
      obtain ⟨s, hsr, hs⟩ := this
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hxt.1 s hsr
      use N
      intro n hn
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le' hs <| rpow_right_anti p <| le_of_lt <| hN n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hsr, hs⟩ := qpow_between p _ _ hpnt hq
    use ENNReal.ofReal s
    simp only [rpow_eq_qpow, hs, and_true]
    contrapose! hsr
    rw [← rpow_eq_qpow]
    exact rpow_right_anti p hsr

name: RealPow.rpow_right_continuous
statement:
theorem rpow_right_continuous (p : M) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (fun (r : ℝ≥0∞) ↦ p ^ r)
proof:
:=
  SeqContinuous.continuous <| rpow_right_seqContinuous p hp0

name: RealPow.rpow_right_surjective
statement:
theorem rpow_right_surjective (p : M) (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) :
    Function.Surjective (fun r : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ p ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Set.Icc (p ^ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) (p ^ (⊥ : ℝ≥0∞)) = Set.univ := by
    simp only [rpow_top _ hpnt.2, bot_eq_zero', rpow_zero]
    grind [nonneg, le_one]
  rw [← Set.range_eq_univ, ← Set.univ_subset_iff, ← hs]
  exact intermediate_value_univ ⊤ ⊥ (rpow_right_continuous _ hpnt.1)

name: RealPow.rpow_add
statement: lemma rpow_add (p : M) (r s : ℝ≥0∞) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) : p ^ (r + s) = p ^ r * p ^ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu0, hu⟩ := ENNReal.exists_seq_rat_tendsto r
  obtain ⟨v, hv0, hv⟩ := ENNReal.exists_seq_rat_tendsto s
  have huv : Filter.Tendsto (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ((u + v) x)) Filter.atTop (nhds (r + s)) := by
    apply Filter.Tendsto.add hu at hv
    refine Filter.Tendsto.congr ?_ hv
    intro n
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Rat.cast_add]
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add]
    · exact_mod_cast hu0 n
    · exact_mod_cast hv0 n
  apply rpow_right_seqContinuous p hp0 at hu
  apply rpow_right_seqContinuous p hp0 at hv
  apply rpow_right_seqContinuous p hp0 at huv
  apply Filter.Tendsto.mul hu at hv
  simp only at hv huv
  refine tendsto_nhds_unique huv ?_
  refine Filter.Tendsto.congr ?_ hv
  intro n
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, rpow_eq_qpow, ge_iff_le, hu0, hv0, ← qpow_add, Pi.add_apply]

name: eq_one_of_antitone_of_tendsto_one
statement:
lemma eq_one_of_antitone_of_tendsto_one [One M] [IsTopOneClass M] {x : ℕ → M} (hax : Antitone x)
    (h : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) : x = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Pi.one_apply]
  exact le_antisymm le_one <| Antitone.le_of_tendsto hax h n

name: mul_tendsto_of_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem mul_tendsto_of_tendsto_one [MulOneClass M] [IsTopOneClass M] {q : M} {x y : ℕ → M}
    (hax : Antitone x) (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (hyt : Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (x * y) Filter.atTop (nhds q)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eq_one_of_antitone_of_tendsto_one hax hxt, one_mul, hyt]

name: mul_tendsto_of_tendsto_one'
statement:
theorem mul_tendsto_of_tendsto_one' [MulOneClass M] [IsTopOneClass M] {q : M} {x y : ℕ → M}
    (hax : Antitone x) (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (hyt : Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (y * x) Filter.atTop (nhds q)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eq_one_of_antitone_of_tendsto_one hax hxt, mul_one, hyt]

name: mul_tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem mul_tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_zero [MulZeroOneClass M] [MulLeftMono M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    {x y : ℕ → M} (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (x * y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tendsto_order, not_lt_zero, Filter.eventually_atTop, IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true,
    gt_iff_lt, true_and] at hxt ⊢
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxt a ha
  use n
  intro m hnm
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_left _ _) <| hn m hnm

name: mul_tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_zero'
statement:
theorem mul_tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_zero' [MulZeroOneClass M] [MulRightMono M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    {x y : ℕ → M} (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (y * x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tendsto_order, not_lt_zero, Filter.eventually_atTop, IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true,
    gt_iff_lt, true_and] at hxt ⊢
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxt a ha
  use n
  intro m hnm
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_right _ _) <| hn m hnm

name: nonempty_pow_gt
statement: lemma nonempty_pow_gt (p q : M) (hq : q ≠ 1) : {n | p ^ n > q}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  use 0
  simp [lt_one_iff_ne_one, hq]

name: bddAbove_pow_gt
statement:
lemma bddAbove_pow_gt [MulLeftMono M] [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M]
    (p q : M) (hp : p ≠ 1) (hq : q ≠ 0) : BddAbove {n | p ^ n > q}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch hq.pos hp.lt_one
  rw [bddAbove_def]
  use n
  simp only [gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  intro k hk
  by_contra! hnk
  have hpnk : p ^ k ≤ p ^ n := pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one' le_one (le_of_lt hnk)
  order

name: pow_sSup_gt_gt
statement:
lemma pow_sSup_gt_gt [MulLeftMono M] [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M]
    {p : M} (hp : IsNontrivial p) {z : ℕ → M} (m : ℕ) (hz : ∀ n, z n ≠ 1) :
    (z m) ^ (sSup {n | (z m) ^ n > p}) > p
proof:
:= by
  suffices (sSup {n | (z m) ^ n > p}) ∈ {n | (z m) ^ n > p} by simp_all
  exact Nat.sSup_mem (nonempty_pow_gt _ _ hp.2) (bddAbove_pow_gt _ _ (hz m) hp.1)

name: pow_sSup_gt_not_gt
statement:
lemma pow_sSup_gt_not_gt [MulLeftMono M] [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M]
    {p : M} (hp0 : p ≠ 0) {z : ℕ → M} (m : ℕ) (hz : ∀ n, z n ≠ 1) :
    ¬ (z m) ^ (sSup {n | (z m) ^ n > p} + 1) > p
proof:
:= by
  suffices (sSup {n | (z m) ^ n > p}) + 1 ∉ {n | (z m) ^ n > p} by simp_all
  exact notMem_of_csSup_lt (lt_add_one (sSup {n | (z m) ^ n > p})) (bddAbove_pow_gt _ _ (hz m) hp0)

name: phi_strictMono
statement: lemma phi_strictMono {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (hn : ∀ n, ∃ m > n, P m n) : StrictMono (φ hn)
proof:
:= by
  refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ ?_
  intro n
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (hn (φ hn n))).1

name: mono_of_tendsto_one
statement:
lemma mono_of_tendsto_one {x : ℕ → M}
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) (hx1 : ∀ n, x n ≠ 1) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → M, Monotone a ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m, a n ≤ x m) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  use x ∘ (φ (exists_next hx hx1))
  constructorm* _ ∧ _
  · refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ ?_
    intro n
    exact (Classical.choose_spec ((exists_next hx hx1) (φ (exists_next hx hx1) n))).2
  · intro n
    use φ (exists_next hx hx1) (n + 1)
    exact (Classical.choose_spec ((exists_next hx hx1) (φ (exists_next hx hx1) n))).2
  · exact Filter.Tendsto.comp hx <| (phi_strictMono (exists_next hx hx1)).tendsto_atTop

name: rightCont_of_leftCont_arch
statement:
theorem rightCont_of_leftCont_arch (M : Type*) [CompleteLinearOrder M]
    [TopologicalSpace M]
    [MonoidWithZero M] [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightMono M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    [OrderTopology M]
    
    [LeftContinuousMul M] [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M]
    
    (f : ℕ → M) (h1 : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) (hf1 : ∀ n, f n ≠ 1) :
    RightContinuousMul M
proof:
:= by
  refine RightContinuousMul.mk ?_
  nontriviality M
  intro x y p q hax hay hx hy
  by_cases! hp0 : p = 0
  · subst hp0
    rw [zero_mul]
    exact mul_tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_zero hx
  by_cases! hp1 : p = 1
  · subst hp1
    rw [one_mul]
    exact mul_tendsto_of_tendsto_one hax hx hy
  by_cases! hq0 : q = 0
  · subst hq0
    rw [mul_zero]
    exact mul_tendsto_zero_of_tendsto_zero' hy
  by_cases! hq1 : q = 1
  · subst hq1
    rw [mul_one]
    exact mul_tendsto_of_tendsto_one' hay hy hx
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨z, hmz, hz1, hz⟩ := mono_of_tendsto_one h1 hf1
  have hz1 : ∀ n, z n ≠ 1 := by
    simp_rw [← lt_one_iff_ne_one] at hf1 ⊢
    intro n
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hz1 n
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hm (hf1 m)
  let u : ℕ → ℕ := fun n ↦ sSup {m | (z n) ^ m > p}
  let v : ℕ → ℕ := fun n ↦ sSup {m | (z n) ^ m > q}
  let a := ⨅ n, (x n) * (y n)
  have haz : ∀ n, a * (z n) ^ 2 ≤ (z n) ^ (u n + v n + 2) := by
    intro n
    rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    refine mul_le_mul_left ?_ _
    have ha := tendsto_atTop_iInf (Antitone.mul' hax hay)
    simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hx hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx.2 (z n ^ u n) (pow_sSup_gt_gt ⟨hp0, hp1⟩ n hz1)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hy.2 (z n ^ v n) (pow_sSup_gt_gt ⟨hq0, hq1⟩ n hz1)
    specialize hi (i ⊔ j) (by grind)
    specialize hj (i ⊔ j) (by grind)
    refine le_trans (iInf_le _ (i ⊔ j)) ?_
    exact mul_le_mul' (le_of_lt hi) (le_of_lt hj)
  have hapq : p * q < a := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
    · rw [le_iInf_iff]
      intro i
      exact mul_le_mul' (Antitone.le_of_tendsto hax hx i) (Antitone.le_of_tendsto hay hy i)
    · contrapose! h
      rw [h]
      exact tendsto_atTop_iInf (Antitone.mul' hax hay)
  have hz2 : Monotone (fun n ↦ (z n) ^ 2) := by
    simp_rw [pow_two]
    exact Monotone.mul' hmz hmz
  have haz2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ a * (z n) ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds a) := by
    nth_rw 2 [← mul_one a]
    refine monotone_continuous_mul _ (fun n ↦ a) (fun n ↦ (z n) ^ 2) a 1 monotone_const hz2
      tendsto_const_nhds ?_
    simp_rw [pow_two]
    rw [show (1 : M) = 1 * 1 by norm_num]
    exact monotone_continuous_mul _ z z 1 1 hmz hmz hz hz
  have hn : ∃ n, p * q < a * (z n) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at haz2
    apply And.left at haz2
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := haz2 (p * q) hapq
    specialize hm m (by rfl)
    use m
  have hzpq : ∀ n, ¬ (z n) ^ (u n + v n + 2) > p * q := by
    intro n
    rw [show u n + v n + 2 = (u n + 1) + (v n + 1) by ring, pow_add]
    have hp0z := pow_sSup_gt_not_gt hp0 (z := z) n hz1
    have hq0z := pow_sSup_gt_not_gt hq0 (z := z) n hz1
    rw [gt_iff_lt, not_lt] at hp0z hq0z ⊢
    exact mul_le_mul' hp0z hq0z
  grind

name: RatPow.ipow_left_mono
statement: lemma ipow_left_mono (n : ℕ) : Monotone (fun (p : M) ↦ ipow p n)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  simp only [ipow, sSup_le_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  intro r hr
  apply le_trans' hpq at hr
  exact le_sSup (by grind)

name: RatPow.ipow_right_mono
statement: lemma ipow_right_mono [IsOrderedMonoid M] [OneTop M] (p : M) : Monotone (ipow p ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  simp only [sSup_le_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  intro q hq
  have hqy : q ∈ {y | y ^ m ≤ p} := by
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one' (le_one q) hnm) hq
  exact le_sSup hqy

name: RatPow.one_ipow
statement: lemma one_ipow [OneTop M] (n : ℕ) : ipow (1 : M) n = 1
proof: := by simp [ipow, one_eq_top]

name: RatPow.ipow_one
statement: lemma ipow_one (p : M) : ipow p 1 = p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ipow, pow_one]
  exact sSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt (by grind) (by grind)

name: RatPow.ipow_zero
statement:
lemma ipow_zero [IsOrderedMonoid M] [OneTop M] (p : M) :
    ipow p 0 = if p = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold ipow
  simp only [pow_zero]
  split_ifs
  · rename_i hp
    simp [hp, one_eq_top]
  · rename_i hp
    rw [one_eq_top] at hp
    simp [one_eq_top, hp, zero_eq_bot]

name: RatPow.ipow_pow
statement: theorem ipow_pow {n : ℕ} (p : M) (h : n ≠ 0) : (ipow p n) ^ n = p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ipow]
  have hpc : Continuous (fun x : M ↦ x ^ n) := continuous_pow n
  have hbp : (⊥ : M) ^ n = ⊥ := by simp [← zero_eq_bot, zero_pow h]
  have hs := is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono hpc (pow_left_mono n) hbp {y : M | y ^ n ≤ p}
  rw [← hs]
  refine le_antisymm (sSup_le (by grind)) ?_
  refine le_sSup ?_
  have hiv := intermediate_value_univ 0 1 hpc
  simp only [zero_pow h, one_pow] at hiv
  have hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0 : M) 1 := by simp [nonneg, le_one]
  apply hiv at hp
  simp only [Set.mem_range] at hp
  grind

name: RatPow.le_ipow_iff
statement: lemma le_ipow_iff {n : ℕ} (p q : M) (hn : n ≠ 0) : q ≤ ipow p n ↔ q ^ n ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply pow_left_mono n at h
    simp only [ipow_pow p hn] at h
    exact h
  · intro h
    have hq : q ∈ {y | y ^ n ≤ p} := by grind
    exact le_sSup hq

name: RatPow.ipow_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma ipow_eq_one_iff (p : M) (n : ℕ) : ipow p n = 1 ↔ p = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hM : ¬Nontrivial M
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hM
    simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]

  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases! hn : n = 0
    · rw [hn, ipow_zero] at h
      simp only [ite_eq_left_iff, zero_ne_one, imp_false, Decidable.not_not] at h
      grind
    refine le_antisymm (le_one p) ?_
    rw [← show (1 : M) ^ n = 1 by norm_num, ← le_ipow_iff _ _ hn, h]
  · intro hp
    simp [hp, one_ipow]

name: RatPow.ipow_mul
statement: theorem ipow_mul (p : M) (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) : ipow p (n * m) = ipow (ipow p m) n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn, ipow_zero, ipow_eq_one_iff p m]

  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [le_ipow_iff _ _ hn, le_ipow_iff _ _ hm, ← pow_mul, ipow_pow _ (Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hm)]
  · rw [le_ipow_iff _ _ (Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hm), pow_mul, ipow_pow _ hn, ipow_pow _ hm]

name: RatPow.ipow_tendsto_one
statement:
lemma ipow_tendsto_one [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M] (p : M) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ ipow p (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Monotone (fun n : ℕ ↦ ipow p (n + 1)) := by
    intro n m hnm
    simp only
    exact ipow_right_mono _ (by grind)
  apply tendsto_atTop_iSup at hm
  suffices ⨆ n, ipow p (n + 1) ≥ 1 by
    rw [show ⨆ n, ipow p (n + 1) = 1 by exact le_antisymm (le_one _) this] at hm
    exact hm
  rw [ge_iff_le, ← forall_lt_imp_le_iff_le_of_dense]
  intro q hq
  rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero'] at hp
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch hp hq
  refine le_iSup_of_le n ?_
  rw [le_ipow_iff _ _ (by grind)]
  exact le_trans (pow_right_anti₀ (nonneg q) (le_one q) (by grind)) (le_of_lt hn)

name: RatPow.qpow_def
statement: lemma qpow_def (p : M) (r : ℚ) : p ^ r = (ipow p r.den) ^ (r.num).toNat
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; rw [HPow.hPow, instHPow, Pow.pow, instRatPow]

name: RatPow.qpow_eq_npow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qpow_eq_npow (p : M) (n : ℕ) : p ^ (n : ℚ) = p ^ n
proof: := by simp [ipow_one, qpow_def]

name: RatPow.qpow_eq_ipow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qpow_eq_ipow (p : M) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : p ^ (1 / n : ℚ) = ipow p n
proof:
:= by
  simp [hn, Int.sign_natCast_of_ne_zero, qpow_def]

name: RatPow.one_qpow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_qpow [OneTop M] (r : ℚ) : (1 : M) ^ r = 1
proof: := by simp [one_ipow, qpow_def]

name: RatPow.nonpos_qpow
statement: lemma nonpos_qpow (p : M) (r : ℚ) (hr : r ≤ 0) : p ^ r = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [qpow_def, Int.toNat_of_nonpos (Rat.num_nonpos.mpr hr)]

name: RatPow.qpow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qpow_zero (p : M) : p ^ (0 : ℚ) = 1
proof: := nonpos_qpow p 0 (by rfl)

name: RatPow.qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos
statement: lemma qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos (p : M) (r : ℚ) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) : p ^ r = 1 ↔ r ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr
    rw [qpow_def] at hr
    rw [← Rat.num_nonpos, ← Int.toNat_eq_zero]
    by_contra! hrn
    suffices ipow p r.den = 1 by
      rw [ipow_eq_one_iff] at this
      contradiction
    contrapose! hr
    have hri : ipow p r.den < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_one _) hr
    refine ne_of_lt ?_
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hri
    exact pow_le_of_le_one (nonneg _) (le_one _) hrn
  · intro hr
    exact nonpos_qpow p r hr

name: RatPow.pos_of_nontrivial_qpow
statement: lemma pos_of_nontrivial_qpow (p : M) (r : ℚ) (h : IsNontrivial (p ^ r)) : r.num > 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  rw [Rat.num_nonpos] at h
  unfold IsNontrivial; push Not; intro h2
  by_cases! hp1 : p = 1
  · simp [hp1]
  rw [← qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos p _ hp1] at h
  exact h

name: RatPow.qpow_well_defined
statement:
theorem qpow_well_defined {n m : ℕ} {r : ℚ} {p : M} (hn : n ≠ 0) (h : r.num * n = r.den * m) :
    p ^ r = (ipow p n) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qpow_def]
  suffices ∃ k, m = k * r.num.toNat ∧ n = k * r.den by
    obtain ⟨k, hmk, hnk⟩ := this
    rw [hmk, hnk, pow_mul, ipow_mul _ _ _ r.den_nz, ipow_pow _ (by grind)]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_comm] at h
  rw [← Rat.mkRat_eq_iff r.den_nz hn, Rat.mkRat_self] at h
  symm at h
  apply Rat.mkRat_num_den hn at h
  obtain ⟨k, hk0, hmk, hnk⟩ := h
  use k
  simp only [hnk, mul_comm, and_true]
  rw [mul_comm]
  apply_fun Int.toNat at hmk
  simp only [Int.toNat_natCast, Nat.cast_nonneg, Int.toNat_mul'] at hmk
  exact hmk

name: RatPow.qpow_mkRat
statement: lemma qpow_mkRat {a b : ℕ} (hb : b ≠ 0) (p : M) : p ^ (mkRat a b) = (ipow p b) ^ a
proof:
:= by
  refine qpow_well_defined hb ?_
  simp only [Rat.num_mkRat, hb, ↓reduceIte, Int.natAbs_natCast, Rat.den_mkRat, Int.natCast_ediv]
  rw [← Int.mul_ediv_assoc', Int.mul_ediv_assoc, mul_comm]
  · exact Rat.normalize.dvd_num rfl
  · rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
    exact Rat.normalize.dvd_num rfl

name: RatPow.qpow_add
statement: theorem qpow_add (p : M) (r s : ℚ) (hr : r ≥ 0) (hs : s ≥ 0) : p ^ (r + s) = p ^ r * p ^ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ge_iff_le, ← Rat.num_nonneg] at hr hs
  have hrn : 0 ≤ r.num * ↑s.den := mul_nonneg hr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hsn : 0 ≤ s.num * ↑r.den := mul_nonneg hs (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hrs : r.num * ↑s.den + s.num * ↑r.den = ↑((r.num * ↑s.den + s.num * ↑r.den).toNat) := by
    grind
  rw [Rat.add_def', hrs, qpow_mkRat (mul_ne_zero r.den_nz s.den_nz),
    Int.toNat_add hrn hsn, pow_add]
  congr 1
  · symm
    exact qpow_well_defined (mul_ne_zero r.den_nz s.den_nz) (by grind)
  · symm
    exact qpow_well_defined (mul_ne_zero r.den_nz s.den_nz) (by grind)

name: RatPow.qpow_right_anti
statement: theorem qpow_right_anti (p : M) : Antitone (fun r : ℚ ↦ p ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs
  simp only
  by_cases! hp1 : p = 1
  · rw [hp1, one_qpow ,one_qpow]
  by_cases! hr : r < 0
  · rw [nonpos_qpow p r (le_of_lt hr)]
    exact le_one _
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_add_of_le hrs
  rw [ht, qpow_add _ _ _ hr (by grind)]
  exact mul_le_left _ _

name: RatPow.qpow_right_inj
statement:
theorem qpow_right_inj (p : M) (r s : ℚ) (hpr :  IsNontrivial (p ^ r)) (h : p ^ r = p ^ s) :
    r = s
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r > 0 := by
    rw [gt_iff_lt, ← Rat.num_pos]
    exact pos_of_nontrivial_qpow p r hpr
  have hs : s.num ≥ 0 := by
    rw [ge_iff_le, Rat.num_nonneg]
    refine le_of_lt ?_
    rw [← Rat.num_pos]
    rw [h] at hpr
    exact pos_of_nontrivial_qpow p s hpr
  have hrsd := mul_ne_zero r.den_nz s.den_nz
  have hrs : r.num * (r.den * s.den) = r.den * (r.num.toNat * s.den) := by
    grind [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hr))]
  have hrs' : s.num * (r.den * s.den) = s.den * (s.num.toNat * r.den) := by
    grind [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hs]
  rw [qpow_well_defined hrsd hrs, qpow_well_defined hrsd hrs'] at h
  have h1 : ipow p (r.den * s.den) ≠ 1 := by
    rw [ne_eq, ipow_eq_one_iff]
    contrapose! hpr
    simp only [hpr, one_qpow, IsNontrivial, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, and_false,
      not_false_eq_true]
  have h0 : ipow p (r.den * s.den) ^ (r.num.toNat * s.den) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← qpow_well_defined hrsd hrs]
    exact hpr.1
  apply npow_right_inj _ _ _ h1 h0 at h
  rw [Rat.eq_iff_mul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hr)),
    ← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hs]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: RatPow.qpow_strictAnti
statement:
theorem qpow_strictAnti (p : M) (r s : ℚ) (hr : IsNontrivial (p ^ r))
    (hrs : s < r) : p ^ r < p ^ s
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
  · exact qpow_right_anti p (le_of_lt hrs)
  contrapose! hrs
  apply qpow_right_inj _ _ _ hr at hrs
  exact le_of_eq hrs

name: RatPow.qpow_denseRange
statement: lemma qpow_denseRange (p : M) (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) : DenseRange (fun r : ℚ ↦ p ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hM : ¬Nontrivial M
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hM
    exact Function.Surjective.denseRange <| Function.surjective_to_subsingleton _
  rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range, ← Set.compl_empty_iff]
  by_contra!
  have hc : IsClosed (closure (Set.range fun r : ℚ ↦ p ^ r)) := isClosed_closure
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff] at hc
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, ho, hac, hbc⟩ := IsOpen.exists_Ioo_subset_mem_closure hc this
    (by
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, mem_closure_iff_seq_limit, Set.mem_range, not_exists, not_and,
        not_forall, not_not]
      use (fun n ↦ p ^ (n : ℚ))
      simp only [exists_prop]
      constructor
      · grind
      · simp only [qpow_eq_npow]
        exact npow_tendsto_bot _ hpnt.2
      ) (by
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not]
      apply subset_closure
      simp only [Set.mem_range]
      use 0
      rw [qpow_zero, one_eq_top])
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] at hac hbc
  clear hc this
  have hc : ∀ n : ℕ, (p ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℚ))) * b ∈ closure (Set.range fun r : ℚ ↦ p ^ r) := by
    intro n
    let S : Subsemigroup M := ⟨Set.range (fun r : ℚ ↦ p ^ r), by
      simp only [Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index]
      intro q q' r hpr r' hpr'
      by_cases! hr0 : r < 0
      · apply le_of_lt at hr0
        rw [(qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos _ _ hpnt.2).mpr hr0] at hpr
        use r'
        grind
      by_cases! hr0' : r' < 0
      · apply le_of_lt at hr0'
        rw [(qpow_eq_one_iff_nonpos _ _ hpnt.2).mpr hr0'] at hpr'
        use r
        grind
      use (r + r')
      rw [qpow_add _ _ _ hr0 hr0', hpr, hpr']⟩
    rw [show (Set.range fun r : ℚ ↦ p ^ r) = ↑S by rfl,
      ← Subsemigroup.coe_topologicalClosure]
    refine mul_mem ?_ ?_
    · simp only [← SetLike.mem_coe, Subsemigroup.coe_topologicalClosure,
        Subsemigroup.coe_set_mk, S]
      apply subset_closure
      grind
    · simp [← SetLike.mem_coe, Subsemigroup.coe_topologicalClosure, S, hbc]
  have hoo : ∃ n : ℕ, (p ^ (1 / (n + 1 : ℚ))) * b ∈ Set.Ioo a b := by
    have hip := ipow_tendsto_one p hpnt.1
    apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_const b at hip
    simp only [one_mul, tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hip
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hip.1 a hab
    specialize hr ⌈r⌉₊ <| Nat.le_ceil r
    use ⌈r⌉₊
    have hb : b ≠ 0 := by grind [nonneg a, pos_iff_ne_zero']
    have hp : ipow p (⌈r⌉₊ + 1) ≠ 1 := by
      rw [ne_eq, ipow_eq_one_iff]
      exact hpnt.2
    norm_cast
    rw [qpow_eq_ipow _ _ (by grind)]
    grind [mul_lt_right _ _ hp hb]
  grind

name: RatPow.qpow_between
statement: lemma qpow_between (p q q' : M) (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) (h : q < q') : ∃ s : ℚ, q < p ^ s ∧ p ^ s < q'
proof:
:= by
  have hd := qpow_denseRange p hpnt
  have hM := nontrivial_of_lt q q' h
  rw [DenseRange, dense_iff_exists_between] at hd
  obtain ⟨p', hp', hqp, hqp'⟩ := hd q q' h
  grind

name: MinTnorm.not_arch_of_infinite
statement: theorem not_arch_of_infinite [Infinite M] : ¬ MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M
proof:
:= by
  have : NontrivialZeroOne M := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ := this.exists_ne
  classical obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset ({0, 1, x})
  simp only [minMonoid_zero, minMonoid_one, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hy
  obtain ⟨hy0, hy1, hyx⟩ := hy
  simp only [mulArchimedeanDualWithZero_iff, minMonoid_zero, minMonoid_one, not_forall, not_exists]
  wlog hxy : ¬y < x
  · push Not at hxy
    rename_i hnzo
    specialize this hnzo y hy0 hy1 x hx0 hx1
    rw [eq_comm] at hyx
    exact this hyx <| Std.not_gt_of_lt hxy
  · use x, y, by rwa [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot], by rwa [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n => simp [hxy]

name: LukTnorm.lukMul_mul
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
lemma lukMul_mul (a b : Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) :
  @HMul.hMul _ _ _ (@instHMul _ (lukMul R)) a b =
  ⟨(max 0 (a.1 + b - 1)), by simp; grind [add_le_add]⟩
proof: := rfl

name: LukTnorm.luk_pow_le_max
statement:
lemma luk_pow_le_max (q : Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 1) :
    ((lukMonoid R).npow n q : Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) ≤ max 0 (n * (q.1 - 1) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => grind
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by grind
    by_cases! hn1 : n = 1
    · subst hn1
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, @npow_eq_pow _ (lukMonoid R).toMonoid,
        @pow_two _ (lukMonoid R).toMonoid, Nat.cast_ofNat, two_mul, le_sup_iff]
      simp only [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, sup_le_iff, le_refl, tsub_le_iff_right, zero_add, true_and]
      grind
    specialize ih (by grind)
    rw [@npow_eq_pow _ (lukMonoid R).toMonoid] at ih
    push_cast
    rw [@npow_eq_pow _ (lukMonoid R).toMonoid, @pow_succ _ (lukMonoid R).toMonoid, add_mul, one_mul]
    conv => lhs; simp only [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul]
    grind

name: LukTnorm.luk_isNilpotent
statement:
lemma luk_isNilpotent [Archimedean R] (p : Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) (hp : p ≠ 1) :
    @IsNilpotent (Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) (lukMonoid R).toZero (lukMonoid R).toPow p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lt_one_iff_ne_one, ← Subtype.coe_lt_coe, Set.Icc.coe_one] at hp
  have hp : 0 < 1 - p.1 := by grind
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Archimedean.arch (1 : R) hp
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul] at hn
  use (n + 2)
  suffices (n + 2) * (p.1 - 1) + 1 ≤ 0 by
    have hp := luk_pow_le_max R p (n + 2) (by grind)
    simp only [npow_eq_pow, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, this, sup_of_le_left] at hp
    exact le_antisymm hp zero_le
  have hn2 : 1 ≤ (n + 2) * (1 - p.1) := by
    rw [add_mul]
    refine le_trans hn ?_
    rw [le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
    exact mul_nonneg zero_le_two hp.le
  rwa [← neg_le_neg_iff, neg_mul_eq_mul_neg, neg_sub, le_neg_iff_add_nonpos_right] at hn2

name: LukTnorm.luk_not_strict
statement:
theorem luk_not_strict [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalAddGroup R]
    [Archimedean R] [ContinuousSup R] [OrderTopology R] [Nontrivial R]
    [PreconnectedSpace (Set.Icc (0 : R) 1)] :
    ¬ @Strict (Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) _ (lukMul R) _ _
proof:
:= by
  have : DenselyOrdered (Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) := denselyOrdered_of_preconnectedSpace
  have : Nontrivial (Set.Icc (0 : R) 1) := by
    refine Nontrivial.mk ?_
    use 0, 1
    rw [ne_eq, ← Subtype.coe_inj, Set.Icc.coe_zero, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    exact zero_ne_one' R
  rw [← nilpt_iff]
  infer_instance

name: LukTnorm.luk_LImp_eq_min
statement:
lemma luk_LImp_eq_min (p q : (Set.Icc (0 : R) 1)) :
    p ⇒ q = ⟨min 1 (1 - p.1 + q), by grind⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simp [LImp_def, ← Subtype.coe_le_coe]
    grind
  · rw [le_LImp_iff_mul_le]
    simp [← Subtype.coe_le_coe]

name: DrasticTnorm.drasticMul_mul

@[simp, grind =]
lemma drasticMul_mul [Bot M] [Top M] [DecidableEq M] (a b : M) :

name: DrasticTnorm.posMulStrictMono_iff_subsingletonZeroOne
statement:
theorem posMulStrictMono_iff_subsingletonZeroOne :
    PosMulStrictMono M ↔ SubsingletonZeroOne M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [posMulStrictMono_iff, drasticMul_mul, subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_nontrivialZeroOne]
    contrapose!
    intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha1⟩ := h.exists_ne
    use a
    constructor
    · rwa [zero_lt_iff]
    use ⊥, a
    constructor
    · rwa [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, bot_eq_zero]
    simp [ha1, bot_eq_zero, top_eq_one]
  · intro h
    infer_instance

name: DrasticTnorm.isCancelMulZero_iff_subsingletonZeroOne
statement:
theorem isCancelMulZero_iff_subsingletonZeroOne :
    IsCancelMulZero M ↔ SubsingletonZeroOne M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_nontrivialZeroOne, isCancelMulZero_iff]
    contrapose!
    intro h hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha1⟩ := h.exists_ne
    simp only [isRightCancelMulZero_iff, ne_eq, isRightRegular_iff_isRegular, not_forall]
    use a, ha0
    suffices ¬ IsLeftRegular a by simpa using this
    rw [IsLeftRegular, Function.Injective]
    push Not
    use a, 0
    simp [top_eq_one, ha1, ha0]
  · intro h
    infer_instance

name: DrasticTnorm.sq_eq_bot

name: DrasticTnorm.noZeroDivisors_iff_subsingletonZeroOne
statement:

name: DrasticTnorm.isReduced_iff_subsingletonZeroOne
statement:
theorem isReduced_iff_subsingletonZeroOne :
    IsReduced M ↔ SubsingletonZeroOne M
proof:

  · rw [subsingletonZeroOne_iff, isReduced_iff]
    contrapose!
    intro ⟨a, ha0, ha1⟩
    use a

    constructor
    · use 2
      exact sq_eq_bot M a ha1
    · exact ha0

name: DrasticTnorm.continuousMul_of_isOpen_top
statement: theorem continuousMul_of_isOpen_top (ht : IsOpen {(⊤ : M)}) : ContinuousMul M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hS : Subsingleton M
  · infer_instance
  rw [← subsingleton_iff_top_eq_bot] at hS
  refine ContinuousMul.mk ?_
  rw [OrderTopology.continuous_iff]
  intro x
  constructor
  · by_cases! hx : x = ⊤
    · simp [hx]
    have h : (fun p : M × M ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi x = {⊤} ×ˢ Set.Ioi x ∪ Set.Ioi x ×ˢ {⊤} := by
      grind [not_lt_bot]
    rw [h]
    refine IsOpen.union ?_ ?_
    · exact IsOpen.prod ht (isOpen_Ioi' _)
    · exact IsOpen.prod (isOpen_Ioi' _) ht
  · by_cases! hx : x = ⊤
    · have h : (fun p : M × M ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' Set.Iio x =
          Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Iio ⊤ ∪ Set.Iio ⊤ ×ˢ Set.univ := by
        grind [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
      rw [h]
      refine IsOpen.union ?_ ?_
      · exact IsOpen.prod isOpen_univ (isOpen_Iio' _)
      · exact IsOpen.prod (isOpen_Iio' _) isOpen_univ
    by_cases! hx : x = ⊥
    · simp [hx]
    suffices (fun p : M × M ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' Set.Iio x =
        (Set.Iio (⊤ : M) ×ˢ Set.Iio (⊤ : M) ∪ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Iio x ∪ Set.Iio x ×ˢ Set.univ) by
      rw [this]
      refine IsOpen.union ?_ ?_
      · refine IsOpen.union ?_ ?_
        · exact IsOpen.prod (isOpen_Iio' _) (isOpen_Iio' _)
        · exact IsOpen.prod isOpen_univ (isOpen_Iio' _)
      · exact IsOpen.prod (isOpen_Iio' _) isOpen_univ
    grind [lt_top_iff_ne_top, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]

name: DrasticTnorm.nilpotent_of_isOpen_top
statement: theorem nilpotent_of_isOpen_top (ht : IsOpen {(⊤ : M)}) : Nilpotent M
proof:
:= by
  have : ContinuousMul M := continuousMul_of_isOpen_top M ht
  refine Nilpotent.mk ?_
  intro p hp
  unfold IsNilpotent
  use 2
  exact sq_eq_bot M p hp

name: DrasticTnorm.strict_iff_subsingletonZeroOne
statement: theorem strict_iff_subsingletonZeroOne : Strict M ↔ SubsingletonZeroOne M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_nontrivialZeroOne, strict_iff, posMulStrictMono_iff]
    contrapose!
    intro h hcm
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha1⟩ := h.exists_ne
    use a
    constructor
    · rwa [← bot_eq_zero, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]
    use 0, a
    constructor
    · rwa [← bot_eq_zero, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]
    simp [ha1, bot_eq_zero, top_eq_one]
  · intro h
    infer_instance

name: pseudoInvAnti_anti
statement: lemma pseudoInvAnti_anti (f : α → β) : Antitone f⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  intro b b' hbb'
  rw [pseudoInvAnti, pseudoInvAnti]
  exact sSup_le_sSup (by grind)

name: pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti [TopologicalSpace α] [PreconnectedSpace α]
    [DenselyOrdered β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β]
    {f : α → β} (hft : f ⊤ = ⊥) (hfb : f ⊥ = ⊤) (h : Continuous f)
    (h' : Antitone f) : StrictAnti f⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  intro b b' hbb'
  simp only [pseudoInvAnti, gt_iff_lt, lt_sSup_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  obtain ⟨c, hcb, hcb'⟩ := exists_between hbb'
  have hfd := intermediate_value_univ ⊤ ⊥ h
  have hc : c ∈ Set.range f := by grind
  have hb' : b' ∈ Set.range f := by grind
  rw [Set.mem_range] at hc hb'
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hb'
  use a
  simp only [ha, hcb, true_and]
  have haa' : a' < a := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
    · contrapose! hcb'
      rw [← ha, ← ha']
      exact h' (le_of_lt hcb')
    · contrapose! hcb'
      subst hcb'
      rw [← ha', ha]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ haa'
  refine sSup_le ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  intro x hx
  contrapose! hx
  rw [← ha']
  exact h' (le_of_lt hx)

name: lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti
statement:
lemma lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f) {a : α} {b : β} (h : a < f⁻¹ᵃ b) :
    b < f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoInvAnti, lt_sSup_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hax⟩ := h
  specialize hf (le_of_lt hax)
  grind

name: le_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti
statement:
lemma le_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti {f : α → β} {a : α} {b : β} (h : f⁻¹ᵃ b < a) :
    f a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pseudoInvAnti, gt_iff_lt] at h
  apply notMem_of_sSup_lt at h
  grind

name: pseudoInvAnti_lowerSemicontinuous
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_lowerSemicontinuous [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology α]
    [OrderTopology β] [DenselyOrdered α] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f) :
    LowerSemicontinuous f⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  intro b a hab
  simp only [gt_iff_lt, eventually_nhds_iff]
  obtain ⟨x, hax, hxb⟩ := exists_between hab
  use Set.Iio <| f x
  simp only [Set.mem_Iio, isOpen_Iio, true_and]
  constructor
  · grind [pseudoInvAnti, lt_sSup_iff]
  · exact lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti hf hxb

name: pseudoInvAnti_comp_self_eq
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_comp_self_eq [DenselyOrdered α] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f)
    (h : StrictAntiOn f (f⁻¹' ({b : β | b ≠ ⊥}))) (a : α) (ha : f a ≠ ⊥) : f⁻¹ᵃ (f a) = a
proof:
:= by
  refine sSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt ?_ ?_
  · intro a'
    simp only [gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    contrapose!
    intro ha
    specialize hf (le_of_lt ha)
    exact hf
  · simp only [gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨x, hwx, hxa⟩ := exists_between hw
    use x
    constructor
    · refine h ?_ ?_ hxa
      · simp only [ne_eq, Set.preimage_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        specialize hf (le_of_lt hxa)
        grind
      · simp only [ne_eq, Set.preimage_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ha, not_false_eq_true]
    · exact hwx

name: pseudoInvAnti_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_upperSemicontinuous [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology α]
    [OrderTopology β] [DenselyOrdered α] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f)
    (h : StrictAntiOn f (f⁻¹' ({b : β | b ≠ ⊥}))) : UpperSemicontinuous f⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  intro b a hab
  simp only [eventually_nhds_iff]
  by_cases! hb : b = ⊥
  · subst hb
    use Set.univ
    simp only [Set.mem_univ, forall_const, isOpen_univ, and_self, and_true]
    intro b
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hab
    exact pseudoInvAnti_anti _ bot_le
  obtain ⟨x, hbx, hax⟩ := exists_between hab
  use Set.Ioi <| f x
  simp only [Set.mem_Ioi, isOpen_Ioi, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro y hy
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
    · refine sSup_le ?_
      simp only [gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      intro a' hay'
      contrapose! hay'
      have haa' := hf (le_of_lt hay')
      specialize hf (le_of_lt hax)
      grind
    · contrapose! hy
      rw [← hy] at hax
      refine le_of_lt ?_
      exact lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti hf hax
  · refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
    · contrapose! hbx
      exact le_sSup (by grind)
    · contrapose! hbx
      subst hbx
      rw [pseudoInvAnti_comp_self_eq hf h x hb]

name: pseudoInvAnti_continuous
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_continuous [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology α]
    [OrderTopology β] [DenselyOrdered α] {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f)
    (h : StrictAntiOn f (f⁻¹' ({b : β | b ≠ ⊥}))) : Continuous f⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_lower_upperSemicontinuous]
  constructor
  · exact pseudoInvAnti_lowerSemicontinuous hf
  · exact pseudoInvAnti_upperSemicontinuous hf h

name: pseudoInvAnti_pseudoInvAnti
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_pseudoInvAnti [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] [PreconnectedSpace α]
    [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    {f : α → β} (ha : Antitone f) (h : Continuous f) (hb : f ⊤ = ⊥) : (f⁻¹ᵃ)⁻¹ᵃ = f
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [pseudoInvAnti, gt_iff_lt]
  refine sSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro b has
    contrapose! has
    refine sSup_le ?_
    intro a' ha'
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ha'
    have haa' : f a < f a' := by grind
    contrapose! haa'
    exact ha (le_of_lt haa')
  · intro b hab
    simp only [lt_sSup_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    obtain ⟨b', hbb', hab'⟩ := exists_between hab
    obtain ⟨b'', hbb'', hab''⟩ := exists_between hab'
    have hf := intermediate_value_univ ⊤ a h
    have hb'' : b'' ∈ Set.range f := by grind
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hb''
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hb''
    subst ha'
    use b'
    simp only [hbb', and_true]
    use a'
    simp only [hbb'', true_and]
    contrapose! hab''
    exact ha hab''

name: pseudoInvAnti_top_eq_bot
statement: lemma pseudoInvAnti_top_eq_bot {f : α → β} : f⁻¹ᵃ ⊤ = ⊥
proof: := by simp [pseudoInvAnti]

name: self_comp_pseudoInvAnti
statement:
lemma self_comp_pseudoInvAnti [DenselyOrdered β] {f : α → β} (h : Antitone f) (hs : Function.Surjective f) :
    f ∘ f⁻¹ᵃ = id
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, pseudoInvAnti, gt_iff_lt, id_eq]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · by_contra!
    obtain ⟨b', hbb', hfb'⟩ := exists_between this
    obtain ⟨a', hab'⟩ := hs b'
    subst hab'
    suffices a' > sSup {a | b < f a} by
      apply notMem_of_sSup_lt at this
      grind
    contrapose! hfb'
    exact h hfb'
  · obtain ⟨a, hab⟩ := hs b
    rw [← hab]
    apply h
    refine sSup_le ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro a' ha'
    contrapose! ha'
    exact h (le_of_lt ha')

name: self_pseudoInvAnti_apply
statement:
lemma self_pseudoInvAnti_apply [DenselyOrdered β] {f : α → β} (h : Antitone f) (hs : Function.Surjective f)
    (b : β) : f (f⁻¹ᵃ b) = b
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [show b = id b by rfl]
  rw [← self_comp_pseudoInvAnti h hs]
  rfl

name: pseudoInvAnti_comp
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_comp {γ : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder γ] {f : α ≃o β} {g : β → γ} :
    (g ∘ f)⁻¹ᵃ = f.symm ∘ g⁻¹ᵃ
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp only [pseudoInvAnti, Function.comp_apply, gt_iff_lt, map_sSup]
  congr 1
  ext a
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hac
    use f a
    simp [hac]
  · intro ⟨b, hbc, haf⟩
    rw [OrderIso.symm_apply_eq] at haf
    rw [← haf]
    exact hbc

name: comp_pseudoInvAnti_surjective
statement:
theorem comp_pseudoInvAnti_surjective {γ : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder γ]
    [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace γ]
    [OrderTopology α] [OrderTopology β] [OrderTopology γ]
    [DenselyOrdered α] [DenselyOrdered β] [DenselyOrdered γ]
    {f : α → β} {g : α → γ}
    (hf : Antitone f) (hfc : Continuous f) (hfb : f ⊥ = ⊤) (hft : f ⊤ = ⊥)
    (hfg : f⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ =  g⁻¹ᵃ ⊥)
    (hg : Antitone g) (hag : StrictAntiOn g (g⁻¹' ({c : γ | c ≠ ⊥}))) :
    Function.Surjective (f ∘ g⁻¹ᵃ)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Set.Icc ((f ∘ g⁻¹ᵃ) ⊥) ((f ∘ g⁻¹ᵃ) ⊤) = Set.univ by
    rw [← Set.range_eq_univ, ← Set.univ_subset_iff, ← this]
    exact intermediate_value_univ ⊥ ⊤ <| Continuous.comp hfc (pseudoInvAnti_continuous hg hag)
  suffices Function.Surjective f by
    simp [← hfg, self_pseudoInvAnti_apply hf this, pseudoInvAnti_top_eq_bot, hfb]
  have hs : Set.Icc (f ⊤) (f ⊥) = Set.univ := by simp [hfb, hft]
  rw [← Set.range_eq_univ, ← Set.univ_subset_iff, ← hs]
  exact intermediate_value_univ ⊤ ⊥ hfc

name: comp_pseudoInvAnti_injective_of_strict
statement:
theorem comp_pseudoInvAnti_injective_of_strict {γ : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder γ]
    [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace γ]
    [OrderTopology α] [OrderTopology β] [OrderTopology γ]
    [DenselyOrdered α] [DenselyOrdered γ]
    {f : α → β} {g : α → γ}
    (hf : StrictAnti f)
    (hg : Antitone g) (hgc : Continuous g) (hgb : g ⊥ = ⊤) (hgt : g ⊤ = ⊥) :
    Function.Injective (f ∘ g⁻¹ᵃ)
proof:
:= by
  refine StrictMono.injective ?_
  exact StrictAnti.comp hf (pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti hgt hgb hgc hg)

name: comp_pseudoInvAnti_injective
statement:
theorem comp_pseudoInvAnti_injective {γ : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder γ]
    [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [TopologicalSpace γ]
    [OrderTopology α] [OrderTopology β] [OrderTopology γ]
    [DenselyOrdered α] [DenselyOrdered β] [DenselyOrdered γ]
    {f : α → β} {g : α → γ}
    (hfa : Antitone f) (hf : StrictAntiOn f (f⁻¹' ({b : β | b ≠ ⊥})))
    (hfs : Function.Surjective f)
    (hfg : f⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ =  g⁻¹ᵃ ⊥)
    (hg : Antitone g) (hgc : Continuous g) (hgb : g ⊥ = ⊤) (hgt : g ⊤ = ⊥) :
    Function.Injective (f ∘ g⁻¹ᵃ)
proof:
:= by
  refine StrictMono.injective ?_
  intro c c' hcc
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  by_cases! hc' : c' = ⊥
  · grind [not_lt_bot]
  have hfgc' : g⁻¹ᵃ c' < f⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ := by
    rw [hfg]
    exact pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti hgt hgb hgc hg (by grind)
  by_cases! hc : c = ⊥
  · rw [hc, ← hfg, self_pseudoInvAnti_apply hfa hfs]
    exact lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti hfa hfgc'

  apply pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti hgt hgb hgc hg at hcc
  refine hf ?_ ?_ hcc
  · simp only [ne_eq, Set.preimage_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    apply lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti hfa at hfgc'
    grind
  · simp only [ne_eq, Set.preimage_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    suffices g⁻¹ᵃ c < f⁻¹ᵃ ⊥ by
      apply lt_of_lt_pseudoInvAnti hfa at this
      grind
    rw [hfg]
    exact pseudoInvAnti_strictAnti hgt hgb hgc hg (by grind)

name: pseudoInvAnti_comp_le
statement: lemma pseudoInvAnti_comp_le {f : α → β} (hf : Antitone f) (a : α) : f⁻¹ᵃ (f a) ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  refine sSup_le ?_
  simp
  intro a' ha
  contrapose! ha
  exact hf (le_of_lt ha)

name: comp_pseudoInvAnti_mul
statement:
lemma comp_pseudoInvAnti_mul [AddMonoid α] [CommMonoidWithZero β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    (f : AddChar α β) (hfs : Function.Surjective f)
    (hfa : Antitone f) (b b' : β) :
    f ((f⁻¹ᵃ b) + (f⁻¹ᵃ b')) = b * b'
proof:
:= by
  simp [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, self_pseudoInvAnti_apply hfa hfs]

name: pseudoInvAnti_mul_le_add
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_mul_le_add [AddMonoid α] [CommMonoidWithZero β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    (f : AddChar α β) (hfs : Function.Surjective f) (hfa : Antitone f) (b b' : β) :
    f⁻¹ᵃ (b * b') ≤ (f⁻¹ᵃ b) + (f⁻¹ᵃ b')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_pseudoInvAnti_mul f hfs hfa]
  exact pseudoInvAnti_comp_le hfa _

name: pseudoInvAnti_add_le_mul
statement:
lemma pseudoInvAnti_add_le_mul [CommMonoidWithZero β]
    [IsOrderedMonoid β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    [OneTop β]
    (f : AddChar ENNReal β) (hfs : Function.Surjective f)
    (hfa : Antitone f) (haf : StrictAntiOn f (f⁻¹' ({b : β | b ≠ ⊥}))) (hft : f ⊤ = ⊥)
    (b b' : β) (hbb' : b * b' ≠ ⊥) :
    (f⁻¹ᵃ b) + (f⁻¹ᵃ b') ≤ f⁻¹ᵃ (b * b')
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hbt : b = ⊤
  · subst hbt
    rw [pseudoInvAnti_top_eq_bot, ← one_eq_top, one_mul, bot_eq_zero, zero_add]
  by_cases! hbt' : b' = ⊤
  · subst hbt'
    rw [pseudoInvAnti_top_eq_bot, ← one_eq_top, mul_one, bot_eq_zero, add_zero]

  simp only [pseudoInvAnti, gt_iff_lt]
  rw [← is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono' (continuous_add_const (sSup {a' | b' < f a'})) add_left_mono]
  · simp only [sSup_le_iff, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
      forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    intro a hf
    rw [← is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono' (continuous_const_add a) add_right_mono]
    · refine sSup_le_sSup ?_
      simp [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
      intro a' hf'
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (mul_le_mul' (le_of_lt hf) (le_of_lt hf')) ?_
      contrapose! haf
      unfold StrictAntiOn
      push Not
      have hat' : a' < ⊤ := by
        contrapose! hf'
        rw [top_le_iff] at hf'
        simp [hf', hft]
      use (a + a')
      constructor
      · simp [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, ← haf]
        exact hbb'

      · obtain ⟨c, hbc, hac⟩ := exists_between hf
        obtain ⟨a'', hab''⟩ := hfs c
        subst hab''
        use (a'' + a')
        constructor; rotate_left; constructor; rotate_right
        · simp [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
          suffices b * b' = f a'' * (f a') by
            rw [← this]
            exact hbb'
          refine le_antisymm (mul_le_mul' (le_of_lt hbc) (by grind)) ?_
          rw [haf]
          exact mul_le_mul_left (le_of_lt hac) _
        · rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top] at hat'
          rw [ENNReal.add_lt_add_iff_right hat']
          contrapose! hac
          exact hfa hac
        · rw [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, ← haf]
          exact mul_le_mul' (le_of_lt hbc) (le_of_lt hf')
    · use ⊥
      simp only [bot_eq_zero', Set.mem_setOf_eq, AddChar.map_zero_eq_one]
      grind [one_eq_top]
  · use ⊥
    simp only [bot_eq_zero', Set.mem_setOf_eq, AddChar.map_zero_eq_one]
    grind [one_eq_top]

name: pseudoInvAnti_add_eq_mul
statement:
theorem pseudoInvAnti_add_eq_mul [CommMonoidWithZero β]
    [IsOrderedMonoid β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    [OneTop β]
    (f : AddChar ENNReal β) (hfs : Function.Surjective f)
    (hfa : Antitone f) (haf : StrictAntiOn f (f⁻¹' ({b : β | b ≠ ⊥}))) (hft : f ⊤ = ⊥)
    (b b' : β) (hbb' : b * b' ≠ ⊥) :
    (f⁻¹ᵃ b) + (f⁻¹ᵃ b') = f⁻¹ᵃ (b * b')
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (pseudoInvAnti_add_le_mul f hfs hfa haf hft b b' hbb')
  (pseudoInvAnti_mul_le_add f hfs hfa b b')

name: correction_add
statement:
lemma correction_add (x : ℕ → X) (y : X) (p : I) (q : I) (a : ℝ)
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hx : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    (correction x y p q a).1  = (correction1 x y p a).1 + (correction2 q a).1
proof:
:= by
  simp [correction, correction1, correction2]
  have hd : dist (x 1) y < dist (x 0) y := hx zero_lt_one
  split_ifs <;> simp
  repeat grind [dist_nonneg]
  · rename_i ha1 ha01 hn had hd
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hn
    have hn0 : dist (x n) y ≤ dist (x 0) y := StrictAnti.antitone hx (Nat.zero_le n)
    grind
  · rename_i ha1 ha01 hn had hd
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hn
    have hn0 : dist (x n) y ≤ dist (x 0) y := StrictAnti.antitone hx (Nat.zero_le n)
    grind
  · have had : a = dist (x 0) y := by grind
    rw [had, interpolate_left]
    exact lt_add_one _
  · rename_i ha1 ha01 hn had hd
    rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero, tendsto_order] at hxt
    apply And.right at hxt
    specialize hxt a (by grind)
    simp at hxt
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hxt
    specialize hm m (by rfl)
    contrapose! hn
    rw [← not_lt] at hd
    simp_rw [and_comm, ← not_lt]
    exact Nat.exists_not_and_succ_of_not_zero_of_exists hd (by grind)

name: correction_uniformContinuous
statement:
lemma correction_uniformContinuous {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : I} {q : I}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hx : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    UniformContinuous (correction x y p q)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → I := fun a ↦ ⟨(correction1 x y p a).1 + (correction2 q a).1, by
    rw [← correction_add _ _ _ _ _ hxt hx]
    exact Subtype.coe_prop _⟩
  rw [show correction x y p q = f by ext a; rw [correction_add _ _ _ _ _ hxt hx]]
  refine UniformContinuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
  refine UniformContinuous.add ?_ ?_
  · refine UniformContinuous.comp uniformContinuous_subtype_val ?_
    exact ite_interpolate_uniformContinuous _ _ _ _ (lt_add_one _)
  · refine UniformContinuous.comp uniformContinuous_subtype_val ?_
    exact ite_interpolate_uniformContinuous _ _ _ _ (by norm_num)

name: ContinuousOn.Icc_of_tendsto_endpoints
statement:
lemma ContinuousOn.Icc_of_tendsto_endpoints {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] [OrderTopology α] [TopologicalSpace β] [RegularSpace β]
    [T2Space β] {f : α → β} {a b : α} (h : ContinuousOn f (Set.Ioo a b))
    (ha : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)) (nhds (f a)))
    (hb : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin b (Set.Iio b)) (nhds (f b))) :
    ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · simp [hab]
  suffices Set.EqOn f (extendFrom (Set.Ioo a b) f) (Set.Icc a b) by
    rw [continuousOn_congr this]
    exact continuousOn_Icc_extendFrom_Ioo h ha hb
  intro x hx
  symm
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at hx
  by_cases! hax : a = x
  · subst hax
    exact eq_lim_at_left_extendFrom_Ioo (by grind) ha
  by_cases! hbx : b = x
  · subst hbx
    exact eq_lim_at_right_extendFrom_Ioo (by grind) hb
  refine extendFrom_extends h _ ?_
  grind

name: Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_Iio_of_tendsto_nhdsWithin_Ioc
statement:
lemma Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_Iio_of_tendsto_nhdsWithin_Ioc
    {f : ℝ → I} {a b : ℝ} {p : I} (hab : a < b)
    (h : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioc a b)) (nhds p)) :
    Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin b (Set.Iio b)) (nhds p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds] at h ⊢
  intro ε he
  specialize h ε he
  obtain ⟨δ, hd, h⟩ := h
  use min δ (dist a b)
  constructor
  · grind [Real.dist_eq]
  intro y hy hxy
  have hyo : y ∈ Set.Ioc a b := by grind [Real.dist_eq]
  exact h hyo (by grind)
