name: dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_dist
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_dist {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} (n : ℕ)
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q (dist (x n) y) = p n
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : dist (x n) y > 0 := lt_of_le_of_lt dist_nonneg (hd (lt_add_one n))
  have hd1 : ¬ dist (x n) y ≤ -1 := by grind
  have hd01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ dist (x n) y ∧ dist (x n) y ≤ 0) := by grind
  have hm : ∃ m, dist (x (m + 1)) y < dist (x n) y ∧ dist (x n) y ≤ dist (x m) y := by
    use n
    grind [hd (lt_add_one n)]
  simp only [dist_fun_compactSupport, hd1, hd01, interpolate_n]
  simp only [↓reduceIte, hm, ↓reduceDIte]
  suffices n = Classical.choose hm by
    rw [← this, interpolate_right]
    exact hd (lt_add_one n)
  have hn' := Classical.choose_spec hm
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · apply And.left at hn'
    contrapose! hn'
    exact StrictAnti.antitone hd hn'
  · apply And.right at hn'
    contrapose! hn'
    exact hd hn'

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_zero
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_zero {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} :
  dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q 0 = q
proof: := by simp [dist_fun_compactSupport]

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Icc
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Icc {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} (n : ℕ)
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    Set.EqOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q)
      (interpolate (dist (x (n + 1)) y) (dist (x n) y) (p (n + 1)) (p n))
      (Set.Icc (dist (x (n + 1)) y) (dist (x n) y))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at hz
  have hz0 : z > 0 := by
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ hz.1
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt dist_nonneg (hd (lt_add_one (n + 1)))
  have hz1 : ¬ z ≤ -1 := by grind
  have hz01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 0) := by grind
  by_cases! hnd : z = dist (x (n + 1)) y
  · rw [hnd, interpolate_left, dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_dist _ hd]
    exact hd (lt_add_one n)
  have hn : ∃ n, dist (x (n + 1)) y < z ∧ z ≤ dist (x n) y := by
    use n
    grind
  simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, hz1, hz01, hn, interpolate_n]
  suffices n = Classical.choose hn by rw [← this]
  have hn' := Classical.choose_spec hn
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · apply And.left at hn'
    contrapose! hn'
    exact le_trans hz.2 <| StrictAnti.antitone hd hn'
  · apply And.right at hn'
    contrapose! hn'
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (StrictAnti.antitone hd hn') (by grind)

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Ioc
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Ioc {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} (n : ℕ)
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    Set.EqOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q)
      (interpolate (dist (x (n + 1)) y) (dist (x n) y) (p (n + 1)) (p n))
      (Set.Ioc (dist (x (n + 1)) y) (dist (x n) y))
proof:
:=
  Set.EqOn.mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self <| dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Icc n hd

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_dist_Icc
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_dist_Icc {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I} (i : ℕ)
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    ContinuousOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Icc (dist (x i) y) (dist (x 0) y))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hi0 : i = 0
  · simp [hi0]
  have hcc : Set.Icc (dist (x i) y) (dist (x 0) y) = Set.Icc (dist (x i) y) (dist (x (i - 1)) y) ∪
      Set.Icc (dist (x (i - 1)) y) (dist (x 0) y) := by
    symm
    refine Set.Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc ?_ ?_
    · exact StrictAnti.antitone hd (by grind)
    · exact StrictAnti.antitone hd (Nat.zero_le _)
  rw [hcc, continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed]
  constructor
  · have hseo : Set.EqOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q)
      (interpolate (dist (x (i - 1 + 1)) y) (dist (x (i - 1)) y) (p ((i - 1) + 1)) (p (i - 1)))
      (Set.Icc (dist (x (i - 1 + 1)) y) (dist (x (i - 1)) y)) := dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Icc (i - 1) hd
    simp [show i - 1 + 1 = i by grind] at hseo
    rw [continuousOn_congr hseo]
    exact ContinuousOn.mono (interpolate_continuousOn (dist (x i) y) (dist (x (i - 1)) y) _ _)
        (by grind)
  · exact dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_dist_Icc _ hxt hd
  · exact isClosed_Icc
  · exact isClosed_Icc

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_zero_dist_Ioo
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_zero_dist_Ioo {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y)) :
    ContinuousOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Ioo 0 (dist (x 0) y))
proof:
:= by
  have hoo : Set.Ioo 0 (dist (x 0) y) = ⋃ i, Set.Ioo (dist (x i) y) (dist (x 0) y) := by
    refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · intro a
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, Set.mem_iUnion, exists_and_right, and_imp]
      intro ha0 ha
      rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero, tendsto_order] at hxt
      apply And.right at hxt
      specialize hxt a ha0
      simp at hxt
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxt
      specialize hn n (by rfl)
      grind
    · intro a
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_Ioo, exists_and_right, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
      intro n han ha0
      constructor
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt dist_nonneg han
      · exact ha0
  rw [hoo, continuousOn_iUnion_iff_of_isOpen]
  · intro i
    exact ContinuousOn.mono (dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_dist_Icc i hxt hd) (by grind)
  · intro i
    exact isOpen_Ioo

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_zero_dist_Icc
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_zero_dist_Icc {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y))
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    ContinuousOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Icc 0 (dist (x 0) y))
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.Icc_of_tendsto_endpoints ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact ContinuousOn.mono (dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_zero_dist_Ioo hxt hd) (by grind)
  · rw [dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_zero]
    simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, Subtype.forall, Set.mem_Icc,
      forall_and_index, gt_iff_lt] at ⊢ hpt
    constructor
    · apply And.left at hpt
      intro a ha0 ha1 haq
      specialize hpt a ha0 ha1 haq
      rw [Filter.Eventually, mem_nhdsWithin]
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hpt
      use Set.Ioo (-1) (dist (x N) y)
      constructor
      · exact isOpen_Ioo
      constructor
      · simp [ne_of_dist_strictAnti hd]
      · simp only [Set.Ioo_inter_Ioi, Left.neg_nonpos_iff, zero_le_one, sup_of_le_right]
        intro z hz
        rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hz
        have hz1 : ¬ z ≤ -1 := by grind
        have hz01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 0) := by grind
        have hn : ∃ n, dist (x (n + 1)) y < z ∧ z ≤ dist (x n) y := by
          rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero, tendsto_order] at hxt
          apply And.right at hxt
          specialize hxt z hz.1
          simp at hxt
          obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hxt
          specialize hm m (by rfl)
          have hzd0 : ¬ dist (x 0) y < z := by
            push Not
            refine le_trans (le_of_lt hz.2) ?_
            exact StrictAnti.antitone hd (Nat.zero_le N)
          have hm' : ∃ n, dist (x n) y < z := by use m
          simp only [← not_lt, and_comm]
          exact Nat.exists_not_and_succ_of_not_zero_of_exists hzd0 hm'
        have hn' := Classical.choose_spec hn
        simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, hz1, hz01, hn, interpolate_n]
        suffices N ≤ Classical.choose hn by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (min_le_interpolate _ _ _ _ _ (le_of_lt hn'.1) hn'.2 (hd (lt_add_one _)))
          grind
        apply And.left at hn'
        contrapose! hn'
        exact le_of_lt <| lt_of_lt_of_le hz.2 <| StrictAnti.antitone hd hn'
    · apply And.right at hpt
      intro a ha0 ha1 haq
      specialize hpt a ha0 ha1 haq
      rw [Filter.Eventually, mem_nhdsWithin]
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hpt
      use Set.Ioo (-1) (dist (x N) y)
      constructor
      · exact isOpen_Ioo
      constructor
      · simp [ne_of_dist_strictAnti hd]
      · simp only [Set.Ioo_inter_Ioi, Left.neg_nonpos_iff, zero_le_one, sup_of_le_right]
        intro z hz
        rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hz
        have hz1 : ¬ z ≤ -1 := by grind
        have hz01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 0) := by grind
        have hn : ∃ n, dist (x (n + 1)) y < z ∧ z ≤ dist (x n) y := by
          rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero, tendsto_order] at hxt
          apply And.right at hxt
          specialize hxt z hz.1
          simp at hxt
          obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hxt
          specialize hm m (by rfl)
          have hzd0 : ¬ dist (x 0) y < z := by
            push Not
            refine le_trans (le_of_lt hz.2) ?_
            exact StrictAnti.antitone hd (Nat.zero_le N)
          have hm' : ∃ n, dist (x n) y < z := by use m
          simp only [← not_lt, and_comm]
          exact Nat.exists_not_and_succ_of_not_zero_of_exists hzd0 hm'
        have hn' := Classical.choose_spec hn
        simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, hz1, hz01, hn, interpolate_n]
        suffices N ≤ Classical.choose hn by
          refine lt_of_le_of_lt (interpolate_le_max _ _ _ _ _ (le_of_lt hn'.1) hn'.2 (hd (lt_add_one _))) ?_
          grind
        apply And.left at hn'
        contrapose! hn'
        exact le_of_lt <| lt_of_lt_of_le hz.2 <| StrictAnti.antitone hd hn'
  · rw [dist_fun_compactSupport_apply_dist 0 hd]
    refine Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_Iio_of_tendsto_nhdsWithin_Ioc (hd zero_lt_one) ?_
    simp only
    suffices Set.EqOn (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q)
        (interpolate (dist (x 1) y) (dist (x 0) y) (p 1) (p 0))
        (Set.Ioc (dist (x 1) y) (dist (x 0) y)) by
      rw [Set.eqOn_comm] at this
      refine Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_eqOn this ?_
      conv => arg 3; rw [← interpolate_right _ _ (p 1) (p 0) (hd zero_lt_one)]
      simp only
      refine Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds_of_continuousOn (by simp [hd zero_lt_one]) ?_
      exact ContinuousOn.mono (interpolate_continuousOn (dist (x 1) y) (dist (x 0) y) _ _)
        (by grind)
    exact dist_fun_compactSupport_eqOn_interpolate_Ioc 0 hd

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_dist_dist
proof:
:= by
  suffices Set.EqOn (interpolate (dist (x 0) y) (dist (x 0) y + 1) (p 0) 0)
      (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Icc (dist (x 0) y) (dist (x 0) y + 1)) by
    rw [← continuousOn_congr this]
    exact interpolate_continuousOn _ _ _ _
  intro a ha
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at ha
  have hxy0 : dist (x 0) y > 0 := by
    by_contra! hdx
    simp at hdx
    specialize hd zero_lt_one
    simp [hdx] at hd
    have hd' : dist (x 1) y ≥ 0 := dist_nonneg
    grind
  have ha1 : ¬a ≤ -1 := by grind
  have ha01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 0) := by grind
  by_cases! han' : a = dist (x 0) y
  · simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, ha1, ha01, interpolate_n]
    subst han'
    split_ifs
    · rename_i hn
      suffices 0 = Classical.choose hn by
        rw [← this, interpolate_left, interpolate_right]
        · exact hd zero_lt_one
        · exact lt_add_one _
      have hn' := Classical.choose_spec hn
      apply And.right at hn'
      contrapose! hn'
      symm at hn'
      rw [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at hn'
      exact hd hn'
    · rfl
  have han : ¬∃ n, dist (x (n + 1)) y < a ∧ a ≤ dist (x n) y := by
    apply And.left at ha
    contrapose! ha
    obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := ha
    by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · subst hn0
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hn han'
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt hn ?_
    rw [← ne_eq, ← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at hn0
    exact hd hn0
  simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, ha1, ha01, han, ha]

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_continuous
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_continuous {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y))
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    Continuous (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) = Set.Iic (-1) ∪ Set.Icc (-1) 0 ∪ Set.Icc 0 (dist (x 0) y) ∪
      Set.Icc (dist (x 0) y) (dist (x 0) y + 1) ∪ Set.Ici (dist (x 0) y + 1) := by grind
  rw [← continuousOn_univ, hu, continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed,
    continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed, continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed,
    continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed]
  · constructor; constructor; constructor; constructor
    · suffices Set.EqOn (fun a ↦ 0) (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Iic (-1)) by
        rw [← continuousOn_congr this]
        exact continuousOn_const
      intro a ha
      rw [Set.mem_Iic] at ha
      simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, ha]
    · suffices Set.EqOn (interpolate (-1) 0 0 q) (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Icc (-1) 0) by
        rw [← continuousOn_congr this]
        exact interpolate_continuousOn _ _ _ _
      intro a ha
      rw [Set.mem_Icc] at ha
      simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, ha]
      by_cases! ha1 : a = -1
      · rw [ha1, interpolate_left] <;> norm_num
      have ha1 : ¬ a ≤ -1 := by grind
      simp [ha1]
    · exact dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_zero_dist_Icc hxt hd hpt
    · exact dist_fun_compactSupport_continuousOn_dist_dist hd
    · suffices Set.EqOn (fun a ↦ 0) (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Set.Ici (dist (x 0) y + 1)) by
        rw [← continuousOn_congr this]
        exact continuousOn_const
      intro a ha
      rw [Set.mem_Ici] at ha
      have ha0 : 1 ≤ a := le_trans (by simp) ha
      have ha1 : ¬a ≤ -1 := by grind
      have ha01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 0) := by grind
      have han : ¬∃ n, dist (x (n + 1)) y < a ∧ a ≤ dist (x n) y := by
        contrapose! ha
        obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := ha
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt hn ?_
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (lt_add_one _)
        exact StrictAnti.antitone hd (Nat.zero_le n)
      simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, ha1, ha01, han]
      by_cases! ha' : a = dist (x 0) y + 1
      · simp [ha']
      have ha' : ¬ a ≤ dist (x 0) y + 1 := by grind
      simp [ha']

  all_goals simp [isClosed_Iic, isClosed_Icc, isClosed_Ici]

name: dist_fun_compactSupport_uniformContinuous
statement:
lemma dist_fun_compactSupport_uniformContinuous {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y))
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    UniformContinuous (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Filter.Tendsto (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) by
    exact (dist_fun_compactSupport_continuous hxt hd hpt).uniformContinuous_of_tendsto_cocompact this
  simp [tendsto_order]
  intro a ha0 ha1 ha0'
  constructor
  · use -1
    intro b hb1
    simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, hb1, ha0']
  · use dist (x 0) y + 1
    intro b hb
    have hb0 : 1 ≤ b := le_trans (by simp) hb
    have hb1 : ¬ b ≤ -1 := by grind
    have hb01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ 0) := by grind
    have hbn : ¬ ∃ n, dist (x (n + 1)) y < b ∧ b ≤ dist (x n) y := by
      contrapose! hb
      obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := hb
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt hn ?_
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (lt_add_one _)
      exact StrictAnti.antitone hd (Nat.zero_le n)
    by_cases! hbd : b = dist (x 0) y + 1
    · subst hbd
      simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, hb1, hb01, hbn, ha0']
    have hbn0 : ¬ (dist (x 0) y ≤ b ∧ b ≤ dist (x 0) y + 1) := by grind
    simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, hb1, hb01, hbn, hbn0, ha0']

name: dist_fun_add_compactSupport
statement:
lemma dist_fun_add_compactSupport {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} (p : ℕ → I) (q : I) (a : ℝ) :
    ((dist_fun x y p q) a).1 = (dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) a + (correction x y (p 0) q) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [dist_fun]
  split_ifs
  · rename_i ha0
    by_cases ha1 : a ≤ -1
    · simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, correction, ha1]
    · simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, correction, ha1, ha0, le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge ha1)]
  · rename_i ha0 hn
    have ha1 : ¬ a ≤ -1 := by grind
    have ha01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 0) := by grind
    simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, correction, ha1, ha01, hn]
  · rename_i hn
    have ha1 : ¬ a ≤ -1 := by grind
    have ha01 : ¬ (-1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 0) := by grind
    simp [dist_fun_compactSupport, correction, ha1, ha01, hn]
    split_ifs
    · rw [interpolate_add _ _ _ _ _]
      · simp
      · grind
      · grind
      · exact lt_add_one _
    · simp

name: dist_fun_uniformContinuous
statement:
lemma dist_fun_uniformContinuous {x : ℕ → X} {y : X} {p : ℕ → I} {q : I}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hd : StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x n) y))
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    UniformContinuous (dist_fun x y p q)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → I := fun a ↦ ⟨(dist_fun_compactSupport x y p q) a +
      (correction x y (p 0) q) a,
    by simp [← dist_fun_add_compactSupport p q]⟩
  rw [show dist_fun x y p q = f by ext a; rw [dist_fun_add_compactSupport]]
  refine UniformContinuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
  refine UniformContinuous.add ?_ ?_
  · exact UniformContinuous.comp uniformContinuous_subtype_val <| dist_fun_compactSupport_uniformContinuous hxt hd hpt
  · exact UniformContinuous.comp uniformContinuous_subtype_val <| correction_uniformContinuous hxt hd

name: interpolate_mem
statement:
lemma interpolate_mem {a b c : ℝ} (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    (q.1 - p.1) / (c - a) * (b - a) + p.1 ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hp := p.2
  have hq := q.2
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at hp hq ⊢
  constructor
  · by_cases hpq : p.1 ≤ q.1
    · suffices 0 ≤ (q.1 - p.1) / (c - a) * (b - a) by grind
      refine mul_nonneg (div_nonneg ?_ ?_) ?_ <;> grind
    · rw [← neg_le_iff_add_nonneg, mul_comm_div]
      trans (q.1 - p.1)
      · grind
      · conv => lhs; rw [← mul_one (q.1-p.1)]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left ?_ ?_
        · rw [div_le_one] <;> grind
        · grind
  · rw [mul_comm_div]
    by_cases hpq : p.1 ≤ q.1
    · suffices (q.1 - p.1) * ((b - a) / (c - a)) ≤ q.1 - p.1 by grind
      refine mul_le_of_le_one_right ?_ ?_
      · grind
      · rw [div_le_one] <;> grind
    · suffices (q.1 - p.1) * ((b - a) / (c - a)) ≤ 0 by grind
      refine mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · grind
      · exact div_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)

name: interpolate_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma interpolate_self (a b c : ℝ) (p : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    interpolate a c p p b = p
proof: := by grind [interpolate]

name: interpolate_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma interpolate_right (a b : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a < b) :
    (interpolate a b p q) b = q
proof: := by grind [interpolate]

name: interpolate_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma interpolate_left (a b : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a < b) :
    (interpolate a b p q) a = p
proof: := by grind [interpolate]

name: min_le_interpolate
statement:
lemma min_le_interpolate (a b c : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    min p q ≤ interpolate a c p q b
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolate, hab, hbc, hac]
  field_simp
  simp [mul_div_assoc]
  rw [Subtype.mk_le_mk, Subtype.mk_le_mk]
  have habc0 : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (c - a) := by
    refine div_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)
  have habc1 : (b - a) / (c - a) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one] <;> grind
  by_cases! hpq : p < q
  · have h : 0 ≤ (q.1 - p.1) * ((b - a) / (c - a)) := by
      refine mul_nonneg ?_ habc0
      rw [sub_nonneg, Subtype.coe_le_coe]
      exact le_of_lt hpq
    grind
  · have h : q.1 - p.1 ≤ (q.1 - p.1) * ((b - a) / (c - a)) := by
      refine le_mul_of_le_one_right ?_ habc1
      rw [sub_nonpos, Subtype.coe_le_coe]
      exact hpq
    grind

name: interpolate_le_max
statement:
lemma interpolate_le_max (a b c : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    interpolate a c p q b ≤ max p q
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolate, hab, hbc, hac]
  field_simp
  simp [mul_div_assoc]
  rw [Subtype.mk_le_mk, Subtype.mk_le_mk]
  have habc0 : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (c - a) := by
    refine div_nonneg (by grind) (by grind)
  have habc1 : (b - a) / (c - a) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one] <;> grind
  by_cases! hpq : p < q
  · have h : (q.1 - p.1) * ((b - a) / (c - a)) ≤ q.1 - p.1 := by
      refine mul_le_of_le_one_right ?_ habc1
      rw [sub_nonneg, Subtype.coe_le_coe]
      exact le_of_lt hpq
    grind
  · have h : (q.1 - p.1) * ((b - a) / (c - a)) ≤ 0 := by
      refine mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ habc0
      rw [sub_nonpos, Subtype.coe_le_coe]
      exact hpq
    grind

name: interpolate_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma interpolate_add (a b c : ℝ) (p q : I) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hac : a < c) :
    (interpolate a c p q b).1 + (interpolate a c q p b).1 = p.1 + q
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolate, hab, hbc, hac]
  ring

name: interpolate_continuousOn
statement:
lemma interpolate_continuousOn (a c : ℝ) (p q : I) :
    ContinuousOn (interpolate a c p q) (Set.Icc a c)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hac : ¬a ≤ c
  · simp [hac]
  by_cases! hac' : a = c
  · simp [hac']
  have hac : a < c := lt_of_le_of_ne hac hac'
  intro b hb
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at hb
  obtain ⟨hab, hbc⟩ := hb
  have h : ContinuousWithinAt (fun x ↦ (q.1 - p.1) / (c - a) * (x - a) + p.1) (Set.Icc a c) b := by
    refine Continuous.continuousWithinAt ?_
    refine Continuous.add ?_ continuous_const
    refine Continuous.mul continuous_const ?_
    exact continuous_add_const (-a)
  rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff] at ⊢ h
  intro ε hε
  specialize h ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hd, h⟩ := h
  use δ
  constructor
  · exact hd
  intro x hx hxb
  specialize h hx hxb
  rw [Set.mem_Icc] at hx
  simp [interpolate, hab, hbc, hac, hx.1, hx.2]
  exact h

name: interpolate_dist
statement:
lemma interpolate_dist {a b x y : ℝ} {p q : I} (hab : a < b)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hay : a ≤ y) (hyb : y ≤ b) :
    dist (interpolate a b p q x) (interpolate a b p q y) =
    |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) * (dist x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolate, hab, hax, hxb, hay, hyb, Real.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq]
  field_simp
  rw [abs_div, abs_mul]
  grind

name: interpolate_dist_left
statement:
lemma interpolate_dist_left {a b x : ℝ} {p q : I} (hab : a < b)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) :
    dist p (interpolate a b p q x) =
    |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) * dist x a
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolate, hab, hax, hxb, Real.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq]
  grind

name: interpolate_dist_right
statement:
lemma interpolate_dist_right {a b x : ℝ} {p q : I} (hab : a < b)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) :
    dist (interpolate a b p q x) q =
    |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) * dist x b
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolate, hab, hax, hxb, Real.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq]
  rw [← sub_sub_eq_add_sub]
  field_simp
  rw [abs_mul, mul_div_assoc]
  congr
  rw [show 1 = (b - a) / (b - a) by grind, div_sub_div_same, abs_div]
  grind

name: ite_interpolate_uniformContinuous
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hpq : p = q
  · subst hpq
    suffices (fun x ↦ p) = (fun x ↦ if x ≤ a then p else if a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b then
        interpolate a b p p x else p) by
      rw [← this]
      exact uniformContinuous_const
    ext x
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · rename_i hxa hx
      rw [interpolate_self _ _ _ _ hx.1 hx.2 hab]
    · rfl
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff]
  intro ε he
  wlog he' : ε ≤ |q.1 - p.1| generalizing ε
  · specialize this (|q.1 - p.1|) (by grind) (by rfl)
    grind
  have heab : ε * (b - a) / |q.1 - p.1| ≤ b - a := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀' (by grind), mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (by grind)]
    exact he'
  have hpqba : 0 < |q.1 - p.1| / (b - a) := div_pos (by grind) (by grind)
  use ε * (b - a) / |q.1 - p.1|
  constructor
  · refine div_pos ?_ (by grind)
    refine mul_pos he (by grind)
  intro x y hxy
  split_ifs
  · simp [he]
  · rename_i hy
    rw [interpolate_dist_left hab hy.1 hy.2, ← lt_div_iff₀' hpqba, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by grind [Real.dist_eq]) hxy
  · grind [Real.dist_eq]
  · rename_i hx _
    rw [dist_comm, interpolate_dist_left hab hx.1 hx.2, ← lt_div_iff₀' hpqba, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by grind [Real.dist_eq]) hxy
  · rename_i hx _ hy
    rw [interpolate_dist hab hx.1 hx.2 hy.1 hy.2, ← lt_div_iff₀' hpqba, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    exact hxy
  · rename_i hx _ _
    rw [interpolate_dist_right hab hx.1 hx.2, ← lt_div_iff₀' hpqba, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by grind [Real.dist_eq]) hxy
  · grind [Real.dist_eq]
  · rename_i hy
    rw [dist_comm, interpolate_dist_right hab hy.1 hy.2, ← lt_div_iff₀' hpqba, div_div_eq_mul_div]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by grind [Real.dist_eq]) hxy
  · simp [he]

name: isReduced_iff_noZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem isReduced_iff_noZeroDivisors {M : Type*} [MonoidWithZero M]
    [LinearOrder M] [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightMono M] [IsBotZeroClass M] :
    IsReduced M ↔ NoZeroDivisors M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ NoZeroDivisors.mk ?_, fun h ↦ isReduced_of_noZeroDivisors⟩
  intro p q hpq
  rw [← min_eq_zero]
  rw [isReduced_iff] at h
  refine h _ ?_
  use 2
  rw [pow_two, ← le_zero_iff, ← hpq]
  exact mul_le_mul' (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)

name: PosMulMono.toMulLeftMono

name: PosMulMono.mulLeftMono_iff_posMulMono

theorem PosMulMono.mulLeftMono_iff_posMulMono [IsBotZeroClass α] :

name: one_inf
statement:

proof: := by simp

name: Int.toNat_mul'
statement: lemma Int.toNat_mul' {a b : ℤ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) : (a * b).toNat = a.toNat * b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! ha : 0 ≤ a
  · exact Int.toNat_mul ha hb
  · simp only [Int.toNat_of_nonpos (le_of_lt ha), zero_mul, Int.toNat_eq_zero]
    exact Int.mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ha) hb

name: comp_self_subset
statement:
lemma comp_self_subset {α : Type*} [UniformSpace α] {U V : Set (α × α)}
    (hVU : SetRel.comp V V ⊆ U) (hV : V ∈ uniformity α) : V ⊆ U
proof:
:= by

  rw [SetRel.mem_comp]

name: Antitone.continuous_of_surjective
statement:
theorem Antitone.continuous_of_surjective {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [TopologicalSpace α]
    [OrderTopology α] [LinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β]
    [DenselyOrdered β] {f : α → β} (h_anti : Antitone f) (h_surj : Function.Surjective f) :
    Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  have h_mono := Antitone.dual_right h_anti
  have h_surj' := Function.Surjective.comp (Equiv.surjective OrderDual.toDual) h_surj
  apply Monotone.continuous_of_surjective h_mono at h_surj'
  exact (continuous_congr (congrFun rfl)).mp h_surj'

name: isNilpotent_monotone
statement:
lemma isNilpotent_monotone {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] [PartialOrder R]
    [IsOrderedMonoid R]
    {x y : R} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (h : x ≤ y) (hy : IsNilpotent y) :
    IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hy⟩ := hy
  use n
  by_cases! hn : n = 0
  · simp_all
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [← hy]
    exact pow_left_mono n h
  · rw [← show 0 ^ n = (0 : R) by rw [zero_pow hn]]
    exact pow_left_mono n hx0

name: notMem_of_sSup_lt
statement:
lemma notMem_of_sSup_lt {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] {x : α} {s : Set α} (h : sSup s < x) :
    x ∉ s
proof: := notMem_of_csSup_lt h <| OrderTop.bddAbove s

name: refine_seq_uniformity
statement:
lemma refine_seq_uniformity (x : ℕ → X) (y : X)
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y))
    (hxy : ∀ n, x n ≠ y) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ StrictAnti (fun n ↦ dist (x (φ n)) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ N, ∃ m > N, ∀ n ≤ N, dist (x m) y < dist (x n) y := by
    intro N
    rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero, tendsto_order] at hx
    apply And.right at hx
    let ε : ℝ := sInf {dist (x n) y | n ≤ N}
    have he : ε > 0 := by
      rw [gt_iff_lt, Set.Finite.lt_csInf_iff]
      · simp
        grind
      · let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ dist (x n) y
        refine Set.Finite.of_surjOn f ?_ <| Set.finite_le_nat N
        intro d
        grind
      · use dist (x 0) y
        grind
    specialize hx ε he
    simp only [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx
    specialize hm (max m (N + 1)) (by grind)
    use max m (N + 1)
    constructor
    · grind
    intro n hn
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le hm ?_
    refine csInf_le ?_ ?_
    · rw [bddBelow_def]
      use 0
      grind [dist_nonneg]
    · grind
  use φ hn
  constructor
  · refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ ?_
    intro m
    simp [φ, (Classical.choose_spec (hn (φ hn m))).1]
  · refine strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt ?_
    intro m
    simp [φ, (Classical.choose_spec (hn (φ hn m))).2 (φ hn m) (by rfl)]

name: IsOpen.exists_Ioo_subset_mem_closure
statement:
lemma IsOpen.exists_Ioo_subset_mem_closure {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Nontrivial α]
    [CompleteLinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s : Set α} (hs : IsOpen s)
    (h : s.Nonempty) (hsb : ⊥ ∉ s) (hst : ⊤ ∉ s) :
    ∃ a b, a < b ∧ Set.Ioo a b ⊆ s ∧ a ∉ s ∧ b ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, habs⟩ := IsOpen.exists_Ioo_subset hs h
  obtain ⟨z, haz, hzb⟩ := exists_between hab
  use sInf {x | Set.Ioo x z ⊆ s}
  use sSup {y | Set.Ioo z y ⊆ s}
  have hsis : sInf {x | Set.Ioo x z ⊆ s} < sSup {y | Set.Ioo z y ⊆ s} :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (sInf_le (by grind)) <| lt_of_lt_of_le hab <| le_sSup <| by grind
  simp only [hsis, true_and]
  constructor; swap; constructor
  · by_cases! hsib : sInf {x | Set.Ioo x z ⊆ s} = ⊥
    · rw [hsib]
      exact hsb
    by_contra!
    have hss : Set.Ioo (sInf {x | Set.Ioo x z ⊆ s}) z ⊆ s := by
      intro w
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, sInf_lt_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
      grind
    have hm : s ∈ nhds (sInf {x | Set.Ioo x z ⊆ s}) := by
      rw [mem_nhds_iff]
      use s
    rw [mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset' (by use ⊥; grind) (by grind)] at hm
    obtain ⟨l, u, hm, hlus⟩ := hm
    have hm' := hm
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hm'
    apply And.left at hm'
    apply notMem_of_lt_csInf' at hm'
    grind
  · by_cases! hsit : sSup {y | Set.Ioo z y ⊆ s} = ⊤
    · rw [hsit]
      exact hst
    by_contra!
    have hss : Set.Ioo z (sSup {y | Set.Ioo z y ⊆ s}) ⊆ s := by
      intro w
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, lt_sSup_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
      grind
    have hm : s ∈ nhds (sSup {y | Set.Ioo z y ⊆ s}) := by
      rw [mem_nhds_iff]
      use s
    rw [mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset' (by grind) (by use ⊤; grind)] at hm
    obtain ⟨l, u, hm, hlus⟩ := hm
    have hm' := hm
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hm'
    apply And.right at hm'
    apply notMem_of_csSup_lt at hm'
    specialize hm' <| OrderTop.bddAbove {y | Set.Ioo z y ⊆ s}
    grind
  · intro a
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, and_imp]
    intro hai has
    rw [lt_sSup_iff] at has
    rw [sInf_lt_iff] at hai
    grind

name: ENNReal.exists_seq_rat_tendsto
statement:
theorem ENNReal.exists_seq_rat_tendsto (x : ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → ℚ, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ u n) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (u x))
    Filter.atTop (nhds x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hx : x = ⊤
  · subst hx
    use fun n ↦ n
    simp only [Nat.cast_nonneg, implies_true, Rat.cast_natCast, ofReal_natCast, true_and]
    refine tendsto_nhds_top ?_
    simp only [Nat.cast_lt, Filter.eventually_atTop]
    intro n
    use n + 1
    grind
  by_cases! hx0 : x = 0
  · use fun n ↦ 0
    simp [hx0]
  obtain ⟨u, _, _, hut⟩ := Real.exists_seq_rat_strictMono_tendsto (ENNReal.toReal x)
  have hut' := hut
  simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hut'
  apply And.left at hut'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hut' 0 (by exact ENNReal.toReal_pos hx0 hx)
  use u ∘ (fun k ↦ k + n)
  constructor
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    intro k
    specialize hn (k + n) (by grind)
    rw [Rat.cast_pos] at hn
    exact le_of_lt hn
  · rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hx]
    refine ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal ?_
    rw [← Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat n] at hut
    exact hut

name: notMem_of_dist_lt
statement:
private lemma notMem_of_dist_lt {a b : X} {s t : Set X} {ε : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hz : ∀ z : X, sInf {dist z w | w ≠ z} > 0)
    (hd : dist a b < min ε (sInf (((fun z ↦ sInf {dist z w | w ≠ z}) '' s)
    ∪ ((fun z ↦ sInf {dist z w | w ≠ z}) '' t)))) : a ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hd
  rw [min_le_iff]
  right
  trans (fun z ↦ sInf {dist z w | w ≠ z}) a
  · refine csInf_le ?_ ?_
    · rw [bddBelow_def]
      use 0
      simp
      intro r hr
      rcases hr with hr | hr
      · obtain ⟨x, _, hr⟩ := hr
        subst hr
        exact le_of_lt (hz x)
      · obtain ⟨x, _, hr⟩ := hr
        subst hr
        exact le_of_lt (hz x)
    · grind
  · refine csInf_le ?_ ?_
    · rw [bddBelow_def]
      use 0
      grind [dist_nonneg]
    · grind

name: choice
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε s t hs ht
  simp [discreteUniformity_iff_setRelId_mem_uniformity, Metric.mem_uniformity_dist] at hd
  by_cases! hne : s = ∅ ∧ t = ∅
  · simp [hne]
    simp_rw [and_comm] at hd
    exact hd ε hε
  have hz : ∀ z : X, sInf {dist z w | w ≠ z} > 0 := by
    intro z
    specialize hX z
    simp [← Filter.principal_univ, accPt_iff_nhds, Metric.mem_nhds_iff] at hX
    obtain ⟨U, δ, hδ, hzU, hz⟩ := hX
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le hδ ?_
    refine le_csInf ?_ ?_
    · specialize hd 1 zero_lt_one
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab1, hab⟩ := hd
      by_cases! haz : a ≠ z
      · use dist z a
        grind
      · use dist z b
        grind
    simp
    intro w hwz
    contrapose! hwz
    refine hz w ?_
    apply hzU
    rw [Metric.mem_ball']
    exact hwz
  let d : X → ℝ := fun z ↦ sInf {dist z w | w ≠ z}
  specialize hd (min ε (sInf (d '' s ∪ d '' t))) ?_
  · rw [lt_min_iff]
    constructor
    · exact hε
    · rw [Set.Finite.lt_csInf_iff]
      · simp [d]
        intro r hr
        rcases hr with hr | hr
        · obtain ⟨z, _, hr⟩ := hr
          rw [← hr]
          exact hz z
        · obtain ⟨z, _, hr⟩ := hr
          rw [← hr]
          exact hz z
      · exact Set.Finite.union (Set.Finite.image _ hs) (Set.Finite.image _ ht)
      · rw [Set.union_nonempty]
        by_cases! hnes : s = ∅
        · specialize hne hnes
          right
          exact Set.Nonempty.image _ hne
        · left
          exact Set.Nonempty.image _ hnes
  obtain ⟨a, b, hd, hab⟩ := hd
  use (a, b)
  constructor
  · exact hab
  constructor
  · grind
  constructor
  · exact notMem_of_dist_lt hab hz hd
  constructor
  · rw [Set.union_comm] at hd
    exact notMem_of_dist_lt hab hz hd
  · rw [dist_comm] at hd
    push Not at hab
    exact notMem_of_dist_lt hab.symm hz hd

name: f_eq_of_le
statement:
private lemma f_eq_of_le (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X) (hX : ∀ x, ¬ AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X))
    {n m k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) (hnm : n ≤ m) : f hd hX n ⟨k, hk⟩ = f hd hX m ⟨k, by grind⟩
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hnm' : n = m
  · subst hnm'
    rfl
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by grind
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm0
  simp at hi
  subst hi
  simp [f, show k < i by grind]
  exact f_eq_of_le hd hX hk (by grind)

name: f_ne
statement:
private lemma f_ne (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X) (hX : ∀ x, ¬ AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X))
    (n : ℕ) : (f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩).1 ≠ (f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩).2
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩ =
      Classical.choose (choice hd hX (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
      ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX n)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX n))
      (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _)) := by
    simp [f]
  have hc := Classical.choose_spec (choice hd hX (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
    ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX n)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX n))
    (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _))
  rw [hf]
  exact hc.1

name: exists_inj_djsoint_seqs_dist_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma exists_inj_djsoint_seqs_dist_tendsto_zero (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X)
    (hX : ∀ x, ¬ AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ dist (x n) (y n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (Disjoint (Set.range x) (Set.range y)) ∧ Function.Injective x
proof:
:= by
  use (fun n ↦ (f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩).1), (fun n ↦ (f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩).2)
  constructor
  · simp [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hε
    use N
    intro n hn
    have hnN : 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (N + 1 : ℝ) := Nat.one_div_le_one_div hn
    have hf : f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩ =
        Classical.choose (choice hd hX (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
        ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX n)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX n))
        (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _)) := by
      simp [f]
    have hc := Classical.choose_spec (choice hd hX (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
      ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX n)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX n))
      (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _))
    apply And.right at hc; apply And.left at hc
    grind
  constructor
  · rw [Set.disjoint_range_iff]
    intro n m
    by_cases! hnm' : n = m
    · subst hnm'
      exact f_ne hd hX _
    by_cases! hnm : n < m
    · have hc := Classical.choose_spec (choice hd hX (1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
        ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX m)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX m))
        (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _))
      repeat apply And.right at hc
      contrapose! hc
      conv at hc => rhs; simp [f]
      rw [f_eq_of_le hd hX _ hnm] at hc
      simp
      use ⟨n, by grind⟩
    · have hnm : m < n := by grind
      have hc := Classical.choose_spec (choice hd hX (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
        ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX n)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX n))
        (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _))
      apply And.right at hc; apply And.right at hc; apply And.right at hc; apply And.left at hc
      contrapose! hc
      conv at hc => lhs; simp [f]
      rw [f_eq_of_le hd hX _ hnm] at hc
      simp
      symm at hc
      use ⟨m, by grind⟩
  · intro n m hnm
    contrapose! hnm
    wlog hnm' : n < m generalizing n m
    · symm at hnm ⊢
      exact this hnm (by grind)
    have hf : f hd hX (n + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩ = f hd hX (m + 1) ⟨n, by grind⟩ := by
      conv => rhs; simp [f, hnm']
      exact f_eq_of_le hd hX _ hnm'
    rw [hf]
    simp [f, hnm']
    have hc := Classical.choose_spec (choice hd hX (1 / (m + 1 : ℝ)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
      ((fun b ↦ b.1) '' Set.range (f hd hX m)) ((fun b ↦ b.2) '' Set.range (f hd hX m))
      (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _) (Set.Finite.image _ <| Set.finite_range _))
    apply And.right at hc; apply And.right at hc; apply And.left at hc
    contrapose! hc
    simp
    use ⟨n, by grind⟩

name: is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono'
statement:
lemma is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono' {f : α → β} (h : Continuous f) (hm : Monotone f)
    (S : Set α) (hS : S.Nonempty) : sSup (f '' S) = f (sSup S)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ¬ sSup (f '' S) < f (sSup S) by
    have hfs : sSup (f '' S) ≤ f (sSup S) := by
      refine sSup_le ?_
      simp only [Set.mem_image, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
      intro a ha
      refine hm ?_
      exact le_sSup ha
    contrapose! this
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hfs this
  by_contra!
  obtain ⟨u, hum, hu, huS⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto_sSup hS (OrderTop.bddAbove S)
  apply Continuous.seqContinuous at h
  specialize h hu
  contrapose! h; clear h
  simp [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem]
  use Set.Ioi (sSup (f '' S))
  constructor
  · exact IsOpen.mem_nhds (isOpen_Ioi' (sSup (f '' S))) (by grind)
  · intro n
    use n
    simp only [le_refl, Set.mem_Ioi, true_and]
    suffices f (u n) ≤ sSup (f '' S) by grind
    exact le_sSup (by grind)

name: is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono
statement:
lemma is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono {f : α → β} (h : Continuous f) (hm : Monotone f)
    (hb : f ⊥ = ⊥) (S : Set α) : sSup (f '' S) = f (sSup S)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hS : ¬S.Nonempty
  · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hS
    simp [hS, hb]
  exact is_sSupHom_of_continuous_mono' h hm S hS

name: tnorm_with_idpt_set_mp
statement:
theorem tnorm_with_idpt_set_mp (S : Set I) : (∃ T : Tnorm, S = {p : I | T.mul p p = p}) →
  (∃ A : Set (I×I), ∃ a : A → I, ∃ b : A → I,
    ⋃ α : A, Set.Ioo (a α) (b α) ⊆ Sᶜ
    ∧ Sᶜ ⊆ ⋃ α : A, Set.Ioc (a α) (b α)
    ∧ (∀ α β : A, (Set.Ioo (a α) (b α)) ∩ (Set.Ioo (a β) (b β)) ≠ ∅ → α = β)
    ∧ (∀ α β : A, (b α) = (a β) → (b α) ∈ S))
proof:
:= by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨T, h⟩ := h
    let B := Sᶜ
    let a' : B → I := fun p₀ => sSup {p : I | p < p₀ ∧ T.mul p p = p}
    let b' : B → I := fun p₀ => sInf {p : I | p₀ < p ∧ T.mul p p = p}
    let ab' : B → I×I := fun p₀ => (a' p₀, b' p₀)
    let A := Set.range ab'
    let a : A → I := fun pq : A => pq.1.1
    let b : A → I := fun pq : A => pq.1.2

    use A; use a; use b;

    have hax : ∀ p₀ : B, T.mul (a' p₀) (a' p₀) = (a' p₀) := by
      intro p₀
      apply antisymm (T.mul_le_left (a' p₀) (a' p₀))
      apply sSup_le
      intro p hp;
      let hp2 := Set.mem_setOf.mp hp
      obtain ⟨hpp, hpid⟩ := hp2
      rw [← hpid]
      apply T.mul_le_mul
      exact le_sSup hp; exact le_sSup hp

    have hap₀ : ∀ p₀ : B, a' p₀ < p₀ := by
      intro p₀
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne
      apply sSup_le
      intro p hp; rw[Set.mem_setOf] at hp
      exact le_of_lt hp.1

      by_contra happ
      specialize hax p₀
      rw [happ] at hax
      let hpb : ↑p₀ ∉ S := p₀.2
      rw [h, Set.mem_setOf] at hpb
      contradiction

    have hbp₀ : ∀ p₀ : B, p₀ ≤ b' p₀ := by
      intro p₀
      apply le_sInf
      intro p hp; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hp
      exact le_of_lt hp.1

    have hable' : ∀ p₀ : B, (a' p₀) < (b' p₀) := by
      intro p₀
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le (hap₀ p₀)
      apply le_sInf
      intro p hp; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hp
      exact le_of_lt hp.1

    have hooni : ∀ p₀ : B, ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (a' p₀) (b' p₀), T.mul p p ≠ p := by
      intro p₀ p hpo; rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hpo
      contrapose hpo
      rw [not_and_or]; push_neg; push_neg at hpo

      by_cases hpeq : p = p₀
      rw [hpeq] at hpo
      let hpb : ↑p₀ ∈ Sᶜ := p₀.2
      rw [h, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf] at hpb
      contradiction

      by_cases hpp : p < p₀
      left; apply le_sSup; rw [Set.mem_setOf]
      constructor; exact hpp; exact hpo

      push_neg at hpp; push_neg at hpeq; symm at hpeq
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne hpp at hpeq
      right; apply sInf_le; rw [Set.mem_setOf]
      constructor; exact hpeq; exact hpo

    
    have hocni : ∀ p₀ : B, ∀ c d : I, (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo c d, T.mul p p ≠ p) →
      Set.Ioo (a' p₀) (b' p₀) ⊆ Set.Ioo c d → Set.Ioo (a' p₀) (b' p₀) = Set.Ioo c d := by
        intro p₀ c d hrni hsr
        apply subset_antisymm hsr

        have hrap : a' p₀ ∉ Set.Ioo c d := by
          by_contra hapr
          specialize hrni (a' p₀) hapr
          specialize hax p₀
          contradiction

        have hr : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo c d, (a' p₀) < r := by
          intro r hr
          by_contra! harp
          by_cases hrp : r = a' p₀
          rw [← hrp] at hrap
          contradiction

          apply lt_of_le_of_ne harp at hrp
          rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hr
          suffices (a' p₀) ∈ Set.Ioo c d by contradiction
          constructor
          exact lt_trans hr.1 hrp
          obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Set.nonempty_Ioo.mpr (hable' p₀)
          let hy2 := hsr hy
          rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy; rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy2
          exact lt_trans hy.1 hy2.2
        have hbc : c < (b' p₀) := by
          obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Set.nonempty_Ioo.mpr (hable' p₀)
          let hy2 := hsr hy
          rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy; rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy2
          exact lt_trans hy2.1 hy.2
        have hr2 : c ≤ (a' p₀) := by
          apply forall_lt_iff_le'.mp
          intro q hpq
          by_cases hq : b' p₀ ≤ q
          apply lt_of_lt_of_le hbc hq
          push_neg at hq
          have hqcd : q ∈ Set.Ioo c d := by
            apply hsr; constructor
            exact hpq; exact hq
          exact hqcd.1

        intro r hro; rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hro; rw [Set.mem_Ioo]
        constructor; exact hr r hro

        by_contra! hbr
        let hy := exists_between hro.2
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hy
        let hby := lt_of_le_of_lt hbr hy.1
        apply sInf_lt_iff.mp at hby
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hby
        rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hp
        specialize hrni p ?_
        constructor
        calc c
          _ ≤ a' p₀ := hr2
          _ < p₀ := hap₀ p₀
          _ < p := hp.1.1
        exact lt_trans hp.2 hy.2

        exact hrni hp.1.2

    have hprwdjt : ∀ p₀ q₀ : B, p₀ ≠ q₀ → ((a' p₀ = a' q₀ ∧ b' p₀ = b' q₀) ∨
      (Set.Ioo (a' p₀) (b' p₀) ∩ Set.Ioo (a' q₀) (b' q₀) = ∅)) := by
        intro p₀ q₀ hpq
        by_cases hab : a' p₀ = a' q₀ ∧ b' p₀ = b' q₀
        left; exact hab
        right; contrapose! hab
        obtain ⟨x, hab⟩ := hab

        let R := Set.Ioo (a' p₀) (b' p₀) ∪ Set.Ioo (a' q₀) (b' q₀)
        let c := (a' p₀) ⊓ (a' q₀)
        let d := (b' p₀) ⊔ (b' q₀)
        have hrs : R = Set.Ioo c d := by
          unfold R; rw [Set.Ioo_union_Ioo']
          simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Ioo] at hab
          exact lt_trans hab.2.1 hab.1.2
          exact lt_trans hab.1.1 hab.2.2
        have hrni : ∀ p ∈ R, T.mul p p ≠ p := by
          intro p hrp
          rcases hrp with hpr|hpr
          exact hooni p₀ p hpr
          exact hooni q₀ p hpr
        have hrsp : Set.Ioo (a' p₀) (b' p₀) ⊆ R := Set.subset_union_left
        have hrsq : Set.Ioo (a' q₀) (b' q₀) ⊆ R := Set.subset_union_right
        rw [hrs] at hrni; rw [hrs] at hrsp; rw [hrs] at hrsq

        apply hocni p₀ c d hrni at hrsp
        apply hocni q₀ c d hrni at hrsq
        rw [← hrsp] at hrsq
        let hapql := (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo_iff (hable' q₀)).mp hrsq.subset
        let hapqg := (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo_iff (hable' p₀)).mp hrsq.superset

        constructor
        exact antisymm hapql.1 hapqg.1
        exact antisymm hapqg.2 hapql.2

    constructor; swap; constructor; swap; constructor
    intro α β hnon
    let hα := α.2; let hβ := β.2
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hα; rw [Set.mem_range] at hβ
    obtain ⟨p₀, hα⟩ := hα; obtain ⟨q₀, hβ⟩ := hβ
    unfold ab' at hα; unfold ab' at hβ

    by_cases hpq : p₀ = q₀
    rw [hpq] at hα; rw [hα] at hβ
    ext1; exact hβ

    specialize hprwdjt p₀ q₀ hpq
    unfold a b at hnon
    rw [← hα, ← hβ] at hnon; simp only at hnon
    simp only [hnon, or_false] at hprwdjt
    ext; rw [← hα, ← hβ]; simp only
    apply Subtype.coe_inj.mpr; exact hprwdjt.1
    rw [← hα, ← hβ]; simp only
    apply Subtype.coe_inj.mpr; exact hprwdjt.2

    swap; intro r hr
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    use ⟨(ab' ⟨r, hr⟩), by apply Set.mem_range_self⟩
    constructor
    simp only [a, ab']
    exact hap₀ ⟨r, hr⟩
    simp only [b, ab']
    exact hbp₀ ⟨r, hr⟩

    swap; intro r hr
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, h, Set.mem_setOf]; push_neg
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hr
    obtain ⟨α, hr⟩ := hr
    let hα := α.2
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hα; obtain ⟨p₀, hα⟩ := hα
    unfold ab' at hα
    unfold a b at hr; rw [← hα] at hr
    simp only at hr
    exact hooni p₀ r hr


    intro α β hab
    rw [hab, h, Set.mem_setOf]
    let hβ := β.2
    unfold A ab' at hβ
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hβ
    obtain ⟨p₀, hβ⟩ := hβ
    unfold a; rw [← hβ]
    simp only
    exact hax p₀

name: tnorm_with_idpt_set_mpr
statement:
theorem tnorm_with_idpt_set_mpr (S : Set I) (h1S : 1 ∈ S) :
 (∃ A : Set (I×I), ∃ a b : A → I,
 ⋃ α : A, Set.Ioo (a α) (b α) ⊆ Sᶜ
  ∧ Sᶜ ⊆ ⋃ α : A, Set.Ioc (a α) (b α)
  ∧ (∀ α β : A, (Set.Ioo (a α) (b α)) ∩ (Set.Ioo (a β) (b β)) ≠ ∅ → α = β)
  ∧ (∀ α β : A, (b α) = (a β) → (b α) ∈ S))
  → (∃ T : Tnorm, S = {p : I | T.mul p p = p})
proof:
:= by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨A, a, b, hus, hsu, hpwdt, hend⟩ := h
    let A := {α : A | (a α) < (b α)}
    let J : A → Set I := fun α : A => if (b α) ∉ S then Set.Ioc (a α) (b α) else Set.Ioo (a α) (b α)
    have hrJa : ∀ α : A, ∀ r : I, r ∈ J α → a α < r := by
      intro α r hr
      by_cases hab : b α ∈ S
      simp only [J, hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo] at hr
      exact hr.1

      simp only [J, hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc] at hr
      exact hr.1
    have hrJb : ∀ α : A, ∀ r : I, r ∈ J α → r ≤ b α := by
      intro α r hr
      by_cases hab : b α ∈ S
      simp only [J, hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo] at hr
      exact le_of_lt hr.2
      simp only [J, hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc] at hr
      exact hr.2
    have hpwdt : ∀ α β : A, (∃ r, r ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J β) → α = β := by
      intro α β hr
      obtain ⟨r, hα, hβ⟩ := hr
      apply Subtype.coe_inj.mp
      apply hpwdt α β
      refine Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp ?_

      let hr1 := hrJa α r hα
      let hr2 := hrJa β r hβ
      have hr3 : max (a α) (a β) < r := by apply max_lt hr1 hr2
      obtain ⟨q, hql, hqr⟩ := exists_between hr3
      use q; constructor; constructor
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hql; apply le_max_left
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqr (hrJb α r hα)
      constructor
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hql; apply le_max_right
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hqr (hrJb β r hβ)
    have hsJ : ∀ α : A, Set.Ioo (a α) (b α) ⊆ J α := by
      intro α
      by_cases haS : (b α) ∈ S
      simp only [J, haS, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte]; rfl
      simp only [J, haS, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte]
      exact Set.Ioo_subset_Ioc_self
    have haJ : ∀ α β : A, (a β) ∉ (J α) := by
      intro α β habJ
      by_cases hab : b α = a β
      specialize hend α β hab
      simp only [J, hend, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, ← hab, Set.mem_Ioo] at habJ
      exact (lt_self_iff_false (b α)).mp habJ.2

      specialize hrJb α (a β) habJ
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne' hrJb at hab
      have hmax : (a β) < min (b α) (b β) := by apply lt_min hab β.2
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_between hmax
      suffices α = β by
        rw [this] at habJ
        specialize hrJa β (a β) habJ
        exact (lt_self_iff_false (a β)).mp hrJa
      apply hpwdt α β
      use r; constructor
      apply hsJ α; constructor
      apply lt_trans ?_ hr.1
      exact hrJa α (a β) habJ
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hr.2 (min_le_left (b α) (b β))

      apply hsJ β; constructor; exact hr.1
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hr.2 (min_le_right (b α) (b β))

    have hpqJ : ∀ α : A, ∀ p q : I, p ≤ q → a α < p → q ∈ J α → p ∈ J α := by
      intro α p q hpq hap hα
      by_cases hab : b α ∈ S
      simp only [J, hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo]
      simp only [J, hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo] at hα
      constructor; exact hap; exact lt_of_le_of_lt hpq hα.2

      simp only [J, hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc]
      simp only [J, hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc] at hα
      constructor; exact hap; exact le_trans hpq hα.2

    have hconnJ : ∀ p q r : I, p ≤ q → q ≤ r → (¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ q ∈ J α) → (¬∃ α, q ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α) → (¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α) := by
      intro p q r hpq' hqr' hpq hqr
      contrapose! hpq
      obtain ⟨α, hpq⟩ := hpq; use α; constructor; exact hpq.1
      by_cases hab : b α ∈ S
      simp only [J, hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo]
      simp only [J, hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo] at hpq
      constructor; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpq.1.1 hpq'; exact lt_of_le_of_lt hqr' hpq.2.2

      simp only [J, hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc]
      simp only [J, hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc] at hpq
      constructor; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpq.1.1 hpq'; exact le_trans hqr' hpq.2.2
    have hconnJ' : ∀ r q p : I, r ≤ q → q ≤ p → (¬∃ α, q ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α) → (¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ q ∈ J α) → (¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α) := by
      intro r q p hqr' hpq' hqr hpq
      simp only [And.comm]; simp only [And.comm] at hpq; simp only [And.comm] at hqr
      exact hconnJ r q p hqr' hpq' hqr hpq


    let T : Tnorm := {
      mul p q := if h : ∃ α : A, p ∈ (J α) ∧ q ∈ (J α) then a ↑(Classical.choose h) else p ⊓ q
      mul_assoc := by
        intro p q r
        by_cases hpq : ∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ q ∈ J α
        simp only [hpq, reduceDIte, haJ, false_and, exists_false]

        by_cases hqr : ∃ β, q ∈ J β ∧ r ∈ J β
        simp only [hqr, reduceDIte, haJ, and_false, exists_false]
        let α := Classical.choose hpq; let β := Classical.choose hqr
        let hα := Classical.choose_spec hpq; let hβ := Classical.choose_spec hqr
        specialize hpwdt α β ?_; use q; constructor
        exact hα.2; exact hβ.1
        apply And.left at hα; apply And.right at hβ
        apply hrJa α p at hα; apply hrJa β r at hβ
        apply Subtype.coe_inj.mpr at hpwdt
        rw [hpwdt] at hα; rw [← hpwdt] at hβ
        apply le_of_lt at hα; apply le_of_lt at hβ
        rw [min_eq_right hα, min_eq_left hβ, hpwdt]


        simp only [hqr, reduceDIte]
        by_cases hqr' : q ≤ r
        simp only [min_eq_left hqr', hpq, reduceDIte]
        apply min_eq_left; apply le_trans ?_ hqr'; apply le_of_lt
        let α := Classical.choose hpq; let hα := Classical.choose_spec hpq
        exact hrJa α q hα.2

        push_neg at hqr'; apply le_of_lt at hqr'; simp only [min_eq_right hqr']
        suffices ¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α by
          simp only [this, reduceDIte]
          let α := Classical.choose hpq; let hα := Classical.choose_spec hpq
          suffices r ≤ a ↑(Classical.choose hpq) by
            rw [min_eq_right this, min_eq_right]
            apply le_trans this;
            exact le_of_lt (hrJa α p hα.1)
          contrapose! this
          use α; constructor; exact hα.1
          exact hpqJ α r q hqr' this hα.2
        contrapose! hqr
        obtain ⟨α, hpq⟩ := hpq; obtain ⟨β, hqr⟩ := hqr
        specialize hpwdt α β ?_; use p; constructor; exact hpq.1; exact hqr.1
        use α; constructor; exact hpq.2; rw [hpwdt]; exact hqr.2


        simp only [hpq, reduceDIte]
        by_cases hqr : ∃ β, q ∈ J β ∧ r ∈ J β
        simp only [hqr, reduceDIte, haJ, and_false, exists_false]
        by_cases hpq' : p ≤ q
        have hpr : ¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α := by
          contrapose! hpq
          obtain ⟨α, hpq⟩ := hpq; obtain ⟨β, hqr⟩ := hqr
          specialize hpwdt α β ?_; use r; constructor; exact hpq.2; exact hqr.2
          use α; constructor; exact hpq.1; rw [hpwdt]; exact hqr.1
        simp only [min_eq_left hpq', hpr, reduceDIte]
        apply inf_eq_inf_iff_left.mpr;
        let α := Classical.choose hqr; let hα := Classical.choose_spec hqr
        constructor
        apply le_trans (min_le_right p (a ↑α))
        exact le_of_lt (hrJa α r hα.2)
        apply le_trans (min_le_left p r)
        contrapose! hpq
        use α; constructor; swap; exact hα.1
        exact hpqJ α p q hpq' hpq hα.1

        push_neg at hpq'; apply le_of_lt at hpq';
        simp only [min_eq_right hpq', hqr, reduceDIte]
        symm; apply min_eq_right
        apply le_trans ?_ hpq'
        let α := Classical.choose hqr; let hα := Classical.choose_spec hqr
        exact le_of_lt (hrJa α q hα.1)


        simp only [hqr, reduceDIte]
        by_cases hpq' : q ≤ p
        simp only [min_eq_right hpq', hqr, reduceDIte]
        by_cases hqr' : q ≤ r
        simp only [min_eq_left hqr', hpq, reduceDIte]
        symm; exact min_eq_right hpq'
        push_neg at hqr'; apply le_of_lt at hqr'
        simp only [min_eq_right hqr']
        suffices ¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α by
          simp only [this, reduceDIte, min_eq_right (le_trans hqr' hpq')]
        exact hconnJ' r q p hqr' hpq' hqr hpq

        push_neg at hpq'; apply le_of_lt at hpq'
        simp only [min_eq_left hpq']
        by_cases hqr' : q ≤ r
        simp only [min_eq_left hqr', hpq, reduceDIte]
        suffices ¬∃ α, p ∈ J α ∧ r ∈ J α by
          simp only [this, reduceDIte, min_eq_left (le_trans hpq' hqr'), min_eq_left hpq']
        exact hconnJ p q r hpq' hqr' hpq hqr
        push_neg at hqr'; apply le_of_lt at hqr'
        simp only [min_eq_right hqr']

      mul_comm := by
        intro p q
        simp only [min_comm, and_comm]
      mul_one := by
        intro p
        suffices ∀ α : A, 1 ∉ J α by
          simp only [this, and_false, exists_false, reduceDIte]
          apply min_eq_left
          exact le_one p
        intro α; unfold J
        by_cases hab : b α ∈ S
        simp only [hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo, not_and_or]
        push_neg; right; exact le_one (b α)

        simp only [hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or]
        push_neg; right; apply lt_of_le_of_ne (le_one (b α))
        contrapose! hab
        rw [Set.Icc.coe_eq_one] at hab
        rw [hab]; exact h1S
      mul_le_mul_left := by
        intro p q hpq r
        by_cases hrp : ∃ α : A, r ∈ J α ∧ p ∈ J α
        by_cases hrq : ∃ α : A, r ∈ J α ∧ q ∈ J α

        simp only [hrp, hrq, reduceDIte]
        apply le_of_eq
        congr; ext α; constructor
        intro hr
        obtain ⟨β, hrq⟩ := hrq
        suffices α = β by
          rw [this]; exact hrq
        apply hpwdt α β
        use r; constructor; exact hr.1; exact hrq.1

        intro hr
        obtain ⟨β, hrp⟩ := hrp
        suffices α = β by
          rw [this]; exact hrp
        apply hpwdt α β
        use r; constructor; exact hr.1; exact hrp.1


        simp only [hrp, hrq, reduceDIte]
        apply le_min
        let hα := Classical.choose_spec hrp
        apply And.left at hα
        apply hrJa at hα
        apply le_of_lt hα
        apply le_trans ?_ hpq
        let hα := Classical.choose_spec hrp
        apply And.right at hα
        apply hrJa at hα
        apply le_of_lt hα


        by_cases hrq : ∃ α : A, r ∈ J α ∧ q ∈ J α

        simp only [hrp, hrq, reduceDIte]
        apply le_trans (min_le_right r p)
        let hα := hrq
        obtain ⟨α, hrq⟩ := hrq
        suffices ht : p ≤ a α by
          suffices a α = a ↑(Classical.choose hα) by
            rw [← this]; exact ht
          congr
          apply hpwdt α (Classical.choose hα)
          use r; constructor; exact hrq.1
          exact (Classical.choose_spec hα).1
        have haq : p < b α := by
          by_cases hpq' : p = q
          rw [← hpq'] at hrq
          rw [not_exists] at hrp
          specialize hrp α
          contradiction

          apply lt_of_le_of_ne hpq at hpq'
          apply lt_of_lt_of_le hpq'
          exact hrJb α q hrq.2
        push_neg at hrp
        specialize hrp α hrq.1
        unfold J at hrp
        by_cases hab : b α ∈ S
        simp only [hab, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo, haq, and_true] at hrp
        push_neg at hrp; exact hrp
        simp only [hab, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc, (le_of_lt haq), and_true] at hrp
        push_neg at hrp; exact hrp



        simp only [hrp, hrq, reduceDIte]
        exact inf_le_inf_left r hpq
    }

    use T; ext p; constructor; intro hp

    rw [Set.mem_setOf]
    suffices ∀ α : A, p ∉ (J α) by
      simp only [T, this, false_and, exists_false, reduceDIte, min_self]
    intro α
    rw [Set.subset_compl_comm] at hus
    let hpS := hp; apply hus at hp
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion] at hp
    push_neg at hp
    specialize hp α

    by_cases hbα : (b α) ∉ S
    simp only [J, hbα, not_false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

    suffices p ∉ Set.Ioo (a α) (b α) ∪ {(b α)} by
      rw [Set.Ioo_union_right α.2] at this
      exact this
    rw [Set.mem_union, not_or, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor; exact hp
    by_contra!; rw [this] at hpS
    exact hbα hpS

    push_neg at hbα
    simp only [J, hbα, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte]
    exact hp



    intro hp; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hp
    contrapose! hp
    let hpS := hp
    rw [← Set.mem_compl_iff] at hp
    apply hsu at hp; rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hp
    obtain ⟨α, hp⟩ := hp
    let α' : A := ⟨α, by
      unfold A; rw [Set.mem_setOf]
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 hp.2
    ⟩

    suffices p ∈ J α' by
      have hα : ∃ α' : A, p ∈ J α' := by use α'
      simp only [T, and_self, hα, reduceDIte]
      let hαp := Classical.choose_spec hα
      by_contra!; symm at this
      unfold J at hαp
      rw [← this] at hαp

      by_cases hbS : b ↑(Classical.choose hα) ∈ S
      simp only [hbS, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioo] at hαp
      exact (lt_self_iff_false p).mp hαp.1

      simp only [hbS, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte, Set.mem_Ioc] at hαp
      exact (lt_self_iff_false p).mp hαp.1

    by_cases hbα : b α' ∈ S
    simp only [J, hbα, not_true_eq_false, reduceIte]
    suffices p ≠ b α' by
      rw [← Set.Ioc_diff_right, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor; exact hp; exact this
    by_contra!
    rw [this] at hpS
    exact hpS hbα

    simp only [J, hbα, not_false_eq_true, reduceIte]
    exact hp

name: tnorm_with_idpt_set
statement:
theorem tnorm_with_idpt_set (S : Set I) (h1S : 1 ∈ S) : (∃ T : Tnorm, S = {p : I | T.mul p p = p}) ↔
  (∃ A : Set (I×I), ∃ a : A → I, ∃ b : A → I,
  ⋃ α : A, Set.Ioo (a α) (b α) ⊆ Sᶜ
  ∧ Sᶜ ⊆ ⋃ α : A, Set.Ioc (a α) (b α)
  ∧ (∀ α β : A, (Set.Ioo (a α) (b α)) ∩ (Set.Ioo (a β) (b β)) ≠ ∅ → α = β)
  ∧ (∀ α β : A, (b α) = (a β) → (b α) ∈ S))
proof:
:= by
    constructor;
    exact tnorm_with_idpt_set_mp S
    exact tnorm_with_idpt_set_mpr S h1S

name: Tnorm.top_eq_min
statement: theorem top_eq_min : (⊤ : Tnorm M) = minTnorm M
proof: := by rfl

name: Tnorm.bot_eq_drastic
statement: theorem bot_eq_drastic : (⊥ : Tnorm M) = drasticTnorm M
proof: := by rfl

name: Tnorm.prod_lt_min
statement: theorem prod_lt_min : prodTnorm < minTnorm I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← top_eq_min, lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  by_contra h
  let p : I := ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num⟩
  have hpm : p * p = (minTnorm I).mul p p := by
    rw [top_eq_min] at h
    rw [← h]
    rfl
  have h2 : 1 / (2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2) = 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  conv_lhs at hpm => unfold p HMul.hMul instHMul Mul.mul; simp only [Set.Icc.instMul, h2]
  conv_rhs at hpm => simp only [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, min_self, Subtype.mk.injEq, p]
  simp at hpm

name: Tnorm.luk_lt_prod
statement: theorem luk_lt_prod : lukTnorm < prodTnorm
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ ?_
  · intro ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩
    simp at hp hq
    simp [Mul.mul]
    constructor
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  · suffices @Nilpotent I _ lukMonoid _ ∧ ¬ Nilpotent I by
      by_contra! h
      obtain ⟨nl, ni⟩ := this
      have h2 : lukMonoid = prodTnorm.toCommMonoidWithZero := by
        rw [← h]
        rfl
      rw [h2] at nl
      contradiction
    constructor
    · infer_instance
    · by_contra h
      let p : I := ⟨1/2, by norm_num⟩
      have hp : IsNilpotent p := h.nilpt p (by grind)
      simp [IsNilpotent] at hp
      grind [coe_ne_zero]

name: Tnorm.drastic_lt_luk
statement: theorem drastic_lt_luk : drasticTnorm I < lukTnorm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bot_eq_drastic, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]
  by_contra h
  let p : I := ⟨3 / 4, by norm_num⟩
  have hp1 : p ≠ 1 := by
    unfold p
    rw [show (1 : I) = ⟨(1 : ℝ), by norm_num⟩ by rfl, ne_eq, Subtype.mk_eq_mk]
    norm_num
  rw [bot_eq_drastic] at h
  have hdl : (drasticTnorm I).mul p p = lukTnorm.mul p p := by rw [h]
  have hdp : (drasticTnorm I).mul p p = 0 := by
    simp [Mul.mul, ← one_eq_top, hp1, zero_eq_bot]
  have hlp : lukTnorm.mul p p = ⟨1/2, by norm_num⟩ := by
    simp [Mul.mul, p]
    norm_num
  grind [coe_ne_zero]

name: idpt_iff_min
statement: theorem idpt_iff_min (a : M) : a * a = a ↔ ∀ p : M, a ≤ p → a * p = min a p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p hap
    rw [min_eq_left hap]
    refine le_antisymm (mul_le_left _ _) ?_
    nth_rw 1 [← h]
    exact mul_le_mul_right hap _
  · intro h
    specialize h a (by rfl)
    rw [h, min_self]

name: diag_min
statement: theorem diag_min (h: ∀ p : M, p * p = p) (p q : M) : p * q = min p q
proof:
:= by
  wlog! hpq : p ≤ q generalizing p q
  · grind [le_of_lt hpq]
  · exact (idpt_iff_min p).mp (h p) q hpq

name: diag_drastic
statement:
theorem diag_drastic (h : ∀ p : M, p ≠ 1 → p * p = 0) (p q : M) :
    p * q = if p = 1 then q else if q = 1 then p else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs
  · grind
  · grind
  · rename_i hp1 hq1
    wlog hpq : p ≤ q generalizing p q
    · rw [mul_comm]
      push_neg at hpq
      exact this q p hq1 hp1 (le_of_lt hpq)
    rw [← le_zero_iff_zero, ← h q hq1]
    exact mul_le_mul_left hpq _

name: idpt_iff_min'
statement:
theorem idpt_iff_min' [TopologicalSpace M] [OrderTopology M] [ContinuousMul M]
    [PreconnectedSpace M] (a : M) :
    a * a = a ↔ ∀ p : M, a * p = min a p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p
    by_cases! hap : a ≤ p
    · exact (idpt_iff_min a).mp h p hap
    · have hc := intermediate_value_univ 0 a (continuous_const_mul a)
      simp [h] at hc
      have hp : p ∈ Set.Icc 0 a := by grind [nonneg]
      apply hc at hp
      simp at hp
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hp
      rw [min_eq_right (le_of_lt hap), ← hq, ← mul_assoc, h]
  · intro h
    rw [h a, min_self]

name: nilpt_els_interval
statement:
theorem nilpt_els_interval {M : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder M]
    [CommMonoidWithZero M] [IsOrderedMonoid M] [OneTop M] : ∃ c : M,
    (∀ p : M, IsNilpotent p ↔ p ≤ c) ∨ (∀ p : M, IsNilpotent p ↔ p < c)
proof:
:= by
  let c := sSup {p : M | IsNilpotent p}
  use c
  by_cases! hc : IsNilpotent c
  · left
    intro p
    constructor
    · exact fun hp ↦ le_sSup hp
    · exact fun hpc ↦ isNilpotent_monotone (nonneg p) hpc hc
  · right
    intro p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (le_sSup hp) ?_
      contrapose! hc
      exact hc ▸ hp
    · intro hpc
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.mp hpc
      exact isNilpotent_monotone (nonneg p) (le_of_lt hpq) hq

name: choose_subseq_is_subseq
statement: lemma choose_subseq_is_subseq (A : Set ℕ) (hA : ∀ x : ℕ, ∃ y ∈ A, x < y) : StrictMono (choose_subseq A hA)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  induction j with
  | zero => contradiction
  | succ k ih =>
    suffices choose_subseq A hA k < choose_subseq A hA (k+1) by
      by_cases hk : i < k
      specialize ih hk
      apply lt_trans ih this

      push_neg at hk
      have hik := Nat.eq_of_le_of_lt_succ hk hij
      rw [hik]; exact this
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hA (choose_subseq A hA k))).2

name: above_or_below
statement:
lemma above_or_below (a : I) (x : ℕ → I) (h : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a)) :
  ¬BddAbove {k : ℕ | ∀ j : ℕ, j ≥ k → x k ≤ x j} ∨ ¬BddAbove {k : ℕ | ∀ j : ℕ, j ≥ k → x k ≥ x j}
proof:
:= by
    rw [← not_and_or, not_and]
    intro hb
    have hnbad : (∀ z : ℕ, ∃ y ∈ {k : ℕ | ∀ j : ℕ, j ≥ k → x k ≥ x j}, z ≤ y) → ¬BddAbove {k : ℕ | ∀ j : ℕ, j ≥ k → x k ≥ x j} := by
      intro h; exact not_bddAbove_iff.mpr fun x ↦ h x.succ

    apply hnbad
    intro m;
    apply bddAbove_def.mp at hb
    obtain ⟨m', hb⟩ := hb

    by_cases hb2 : BddAbove {n : ℕ | x n ≠ a}
    apply bddAbove_def.mp at hb2
    obtain ⟨N, hb2⟩ := hb2
    use (m ⊔ (N+1)); constructor; swap; exact le_max_left m (N+1)
    rw [Set.mem_setOf]; intro j hj
    suffices ∀ l > N, x l = a by
      let hN := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_add_one N) (le_max_right m (N+1))
      rw [this (max m (N+1)) hN, this j]
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hN hj
    intro l hl
    specialize hb2 l; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hb2
    contrapose! hb2; constructor; exact hb2; exact hl


    apply bddAbove_def.not.mp at hb2; push_neg at hb2
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hb2 (m ⊔ m'); rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hn
    let C := {N : ℕ | n ≤ N ∧ ∀ k > N, dist (x k) a < dist (x n) a}
    let k := sInf C
    have hkC : k ∈ C := by
      apply Nat.sInf_mem
      apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp at h
      specialize h (dist (x n) a) (dist_pos.mpr hn.1)
      obtain ⟨N, h⟩ := h
      use N ⊔ n; unfold C; rw [Set.mem_setOf]; constructor
      exact le_max_right N n
      intro k hk
      apply le_of_lt at hk
      apply le_trans (le_max_left N n) at hk
      exact h k hk
    use k; constructor; rw [Set.mem_setOf]
    intro j hjk

    rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hkC
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hjk with hjk|hjk
    let hk := hkC.2
    specialize hk j hjk
    have hxk : dist (x k) a ≥ dist (x n) a := by
      by_cases hnk : k = n; rw [hnk]

      apply lt_of_le_of_ne' hkC.1 at hnk
      by_contra!
      suffices k ≠ sInf C by contradiction
      apply ne_of_gt; apply lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hnk)
      apply Nat.sInf_le
      unfold C; rw [Set.mem_setOf]; constructor
      exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hnk
      intro j hjk
      by_cases hjk' : j = k
      rw [hjk']; exact this
      exact hkC.2 j (lt_of_le_of_ne' (Nat.le_of_pred_lt hjk) hjk')
    by_cases hxka : (x k) ≤ a
    suffices ∀ i ≥ k, x k ≤ x i by
      specialize hb k; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hb; specialize hb this
      apply le_trans hkC.1 at hb
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hn.2 at hb
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right m m') at hb
      apply (lt_self_iff_false m').mp at hb
      contradiction
    intro i hik
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hik with hik|hik
    rw [hik]
    let hk := hkC.2
    specialize hk i hik
    calc (x k).1
      _ ≤ a-(dist (x n) a) := by
        suffices dist (x k) a = -((x k).1-a) by
          rw [this] at hxk
          apply le_sub_comm.mp
          apply le_trans hxk
          ring_nf; rfl
        apply abs_eq_neg_self.mpr
        exact tsub_nonpos.mpr hxka
      _ ≤ a-|(x i).1-a| := by exact sub_le_sub_left (le_of_lt hk) a.1
      _ ≤ a-(-((x i).1-a)) := by apply sub_le_sub_left ?_ a.1; apply neg_le_abs
      _ = x i := by ring



    push_neg at hxka; apply le_of_lt at hxka
    calc (x k).1
      _ ≥ a+(dist (x n) a) := by
        suffices dist (x k) a = (x k).1-a by
          rw [this] at hxk
          exact le_sub_iff_add_le'.mp hxk
        apply abs_eq_self.mpr
        exact sub_nonneg_of_le hxka
      _ ≥ a+|(x j).1-a| := by exact add_le_add_left (le_of_lt hk) a.1
      _ ≥ a+((x j).1-a) := by apply add_le_add_left ?_ a.1; apply le_abs_self
      _ = (x j) := by ring

    rw [hjk]

    rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hkC
    apply le_trans (le_max_left m m')
    apply le_trans (le_of_lt hn.2) hkC.1

name: mono_or_anti_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma mono_or_anti_of_tendsto (a : I) (x : ℕ → I) (h : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a)) :
  ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n  ∧ ((Monotone (x ∘ n)) ∨ (Antitone (x ∘ n)))
proof:
:= by
    let A := {k : ℕ | ∀ j : ℕ, j ≥ k → x k ≤ x j}
    let B := { k : ℕ | ∀ j : ℕ, j ≥ k → x k ≥ x j}
    rcases above_or_below a x h with hA|hB

    apply bddAbove_def.not.mp at hA; push_neg at hA
    use choose_subseq A hA; constructor; exact choose_subseq_is_subseq A hA; left
    intro k k' hkk; rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    apply StrictMono.monotone (choose_subseq_is_subseq A hA) at hkk
    match k with
    | 0 =>
      have hcA := (Classical.choose_spec (hA 0)).1
      unfold A at hcA; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hcA
      exact hcA (choose_subseq A hA k') hkk
    | j+1 =>
      have hcA := (Classical.choose_spec (hA (choose_subseq A hA j))).1
      unfold A at hcA; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hcA
      exact hcA (choose_subseq A hA k') hkk

    apply bddAbove_def.not.mp at hB; push_neg at hB
    use choose_subseq B hB; constructor; exact choose_subseq_is_subseq B hB; right
    intro k k' hkk; rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    apply StrictMono.monotone (choose_subseq_is_subseq B hB) at hkk
    match k with
    | 0 =>
      have hcB := (Classical.choose_spec (hB 0)).1
      unfold B at hcB; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hcB
      exact hcB (choose_subseq B hB k') hkk
    | j+1 =>
      have hcB := (Classical.choose_spec (hB (choose_subseq B hB j))).1
      unfold B at hcB; rw [Set.mem_setOf] at hcB
      exact hcB (choose_subseq B hB k') hkk

name: idpts_closed
proof:
:= by
  rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
  intro a ha
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ⊢ ha
  
  apply closure_subset_iff_isClosed.mp
  intro a ha; rw [Set.mem_setOf]
  apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp at ha
  let x : ℕ → I := fun n => Classical.choose (ha (1/(n+1)) (by exact Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat))
  have hxid : ∀ n : ℕ, T.mul (x n) (x n) = (x n) := by
    intro n
    have h := (Classical.choose_spec (ha (1/(n+1)) (by exact Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat))).1
    rw [Set.mem_setOf] at h
    exact h
  have hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a) := by
    apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
    intro ε he
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt he
    use N; intro n hn
    have hxn := (Classical.choose_spec (ha (1/(n+1)) (by exact Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat))).2
    calc dist (x n) a
      _ = dist a (x n) := by rw [dist_comm]
      _ < 1/(n+1) := hxn
      _ ≤ 1/(N+1) := by
        apply div_le_div₀ (zero_le_one) (by rfl) (Nat.cast_add_one_pos N)
        exact_mod_cast add_le_add_right hn 1
      _ < ε := hN
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hmax⟩ := mono_or_anti_of_tendsto a x hx
  rcases hmax with hmx|hax

  apply antisymm (T.mul_le_left a a)
  let hx' := Filter.Tendsto.comp hx (StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hn)
  let hlub := isLUB_of_tendsto_atTop hmx hx'
  apply (isLUB_le_iff hlub).mpr
  rw [mem_upperBounds]
  intro y hy; rw [Set.mem_range] at hy
  obtain ⟨k, hy⟩ := hy; rw [← hy]
  rw [Function.comp_apply, ← hxid (n k)]
  suffices x (n k) ≤ a by apply T.mul_le_mul; exact this; exact this
  apply Monotone.ge_of_tendsto hmx hx'



  apply h a (x ∘ n) hax
  suffices ∀ k : ℕ, T.mul ((x ∘ n) k) ((x ∘ n) k) = x (n k) by
    simp only [this]
    suffices Filter.Tendsto (x ∘ n) Filter.atTop (nhds a) by exact this
    apply Filter.Tendsto.comp hx
    exact StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hn
  intro k; rw [Function.comp_apply]
  exact hxid (n k)

name: iso_invariants
statement:
theorem iso_invariants {T : Tnorm} : (∀ φ : Isomorphisms, Tnorm.apply_iso T φ.2 = T)
  ↔ T = Tnorm.MinTnorm.toTnorm ∨ T = Tnorm.DrasticTnorm
proof:
:= by
  constructor; swap; intro h
  intro ⟨φ, hφ⟩; rw [Isomorphisms, Set.mem_setOf] at hφ
  ext p q
  rcases h with h|h

  simp [Tnorm.apply_iso, h, Tnorm.min_tnorm_def]
  by_cases hpq : p ≤ q
  let hpq' := hφ.2 hpq
  rw [min_eq_left hpq, min_eq_left hpq', Function.leftInverse_invFun hφ.1.1]
  push_neg at hpq; apply le_of_lt at hpq
  let hpq' := hφ.2 hpq
  rw [min_eq_right hpq, min_eq_right hpq', Function.leftInverse_invFun hφ.1.1]

  simp only [Tnorm.apply_iso, h, Tnorm.drastic_def]
  by_cases hpq : p = 1 ∨ q = 1
  rcases hpq with hp | hq

  simp only [hp, Tnorm.iso_one hφ, true_or, reduceIte]
  rw [min_eq_right, min_eq_right, Function.leftInverse_invFun hφ.1.1]
  exact le_one q; exact le_one (φ q)

  simp only [hq, Tnorm.iso_one hφ, or_true, reduceIte]
  rw [min_eq_left, min_eq_left, Function.leftInverse_invFun hφ.1.1]
  exact le_one p; exact le_one (φ p)

  have hpq' : ¬(φ p = 1 ∨ φ q = 1) := by
    contrapose! hpq
    rcases hpq with hp | hq
    left; rw [← Tnorm.iso_one hφ] at hp
    apply hφ.1.1 hp

    right; rw [← Tnorm.iso_one hφ] at hq
    apply hφ.1.1 hq
  simp only [hpq, hpq', reduceIte]
  rw [Tnorm.iso_zero (Tnorm.iso_inv_is_iso hφ)]



  intro h
  by_cases hid : ∀ p : I, T.mul p p = p
  left; exact diag_min hid

  right; apply diag_drastic
  push_neg at hid
  obtain ⟨p₀, hid⟩ := hid
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (T.mul_self_le_self p₀) at hid
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpp : p = 0
  rw [hpp, T.mul_zero]
  have hpnt : IsNontrivial p := by constructor; exact hpp; exact hp
  have hp₀0 : p₀.1 ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose! hid
    apply Set.Icc.coe_eq_zero.mp at hid
    rw [hid, T.mul_zero]
  have hp₀1 : p₀ ≠ 1 := by
    contrapose! hid
    rw [hid, T.mul_one]

  have hqdiv : ∀ q : I, q > p₀ → p+(1-p.1)/(1-p₀)*(q-p₀) ∈ I := by
    intro q hpq; constructor
    apply add_nonneg p.2.1
    apply mul_nonneg
    apply div_nonneg; unit_interval; unit_interval
    simp only [sub_nonneg, Subtype.coe_le_coe]
    exact le_of_lt hpq

    rw [div_mul_comm]
    suffices (q.1-p₀)/(1-p₀) ≤ 1 by
      calc p.1+((q.1-p₀)/(1-p₀))*(1-p)
        _ ≤ p+(1-p) := by
          apply add_le_add_left
          apply mul_le_of_le_one_left ?_ this
          unit_interval
        _ = 1 := by ring
    apply (div_le_one ?_).mpr
    apply sub_le_sub_right q.2.2
    rw [sub_pos]
    apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp₀1
  let φ : I → I := fun q => ⟨if q ≤ p₀ then p/p₀*q else p+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(q-p₀), by
    by_cases hpq : q ≤ p₀
    simp only [hpq, reduceIte]; constructor
    apply mul_nonneg (div_nonneg p.2.1 p₀.2.1) q.2.1
    rw [div_mul_comm]
    apply mul_le_one₀ ?_ p.2.1 p.2.2
    refine (div_le_one₀ ?_).mpr hpq
    exact unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)

    simp only [hpq, reduceIte]; push_neg at hpq
    exact hqdiv q hpq
    ⟩
  let ψ : I → I := fun q => ⟨if q ≤ p₀ then p/√p₀*√q else p+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(q-p₀), by
    by_cases hpq : q ≤ p₀
    simp only [hpq, reduceIte]; constructor
    apply mul_nonneg (div_nonneg p.2.1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg p₀.1)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg q.1)
    rw [div_mul_comm, ← Real.sqrt_div q.2.1]
    apply mul_le_one₀ ?_ p.2.1 p.2.2
    apply Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr
    refine (div_le_one₀ ?_).mpr hpq
    exact unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)

    simp only [hpq, reduceIte]; push_neg at hpq
    exact hqdiv q hpq
    ⟩

  have hrtop : ∀ r : I, r > p → ∃ q : I, r.1 = p+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(q-p₀) ∧ ¬q ≤ p₀ := by
    intro r hrp
    have hqI : (1-p₀.1)/(1-p)*(r-p)+p₀ ∈ I := by
      constructor
      apply add_nonneg ?_ p₀.2.1
      apply mul_nonneg; apply div_nonneg
      unit_interval; unit_interval; rw [sub_nonneg]; exact le_of_lt hrp

      rw [div_mul_comm]
      calc (r.1-p)/(1-p)*(1-p₀)+p₀
        _ ≤ 1*(1-p₀)+p₀ := by
          apply add_le_add_right
          apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
          apply (div_le_one ?_).mpr
          apply sub_le_sub_right; exact r.2.2
          rw [sub_pos]; apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp
          rw [sub_pos]; apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp₀1
        _ = 1 := by ring
    use ⟨(1-p₀)/(1-p)*(r-p)+p₀, hqI⟩; constructor
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, ← mul_assoc, div_mul_div_cancel₀, div_self, one_mul, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; symm; apply coe_ne_one.mpr hp
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; symm; apply coe_ne_one.mpr hp₀1

    push_neg; apply Subtype.mk_lt_mk.mpr
    refine lt_add_of_pos_of_le ?_ ?_; swap; rfl
    apply mul_pos; apply div_pos
    rw [sub_pos]; apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp₀1
    rw [sub_pos]; apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp
    rw [sub_pos]; exact hrp

  have hpdiv : 0 < (1-p.1)/(1-p₀) := by
      apply div_pos
      rw [sub_pos]; apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp
      rw [sub_pos]; apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr hp₀1

  have hrsm : ∀ q r : I, q < r → q > p₀ → (p.1+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(q-p₀)) < (p+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(r-p₀)) := by
    intro q r hqr hqp
    apply add_lt_add_left
    apply (mul_lt_mul_left ?_).mpr
    apply sub_lt_sub_right
    apply Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr hqr
    exact hpdiv

  have hφ : Tnorm.Isomorphism φ := by
    suffices StrictMono φ ∧ Function.Surjective φ by
      constructor; constructor
      exact StrictMono.injective this.1
      exact this.2
      exact StrictMono.monotone this.1
    constructor
    intro q r hqr; unfold φ
    by_cases hrp : r ≤ p₀
    have hqp : q ≤ p₀ := le_trans (le_of_lt hqr) hrp
    simp only [hrp, hqp, reduceIte, Subtype.mk_lt_mk]
    apply (mul_lt_mul_left ?_).mpr
    apply Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr hqr
    apply div_pos
    apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
    apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)

    by_cases hqp : ¬q ≤ p₀
    simp only [hrp, hqp, reduceIte, Subtype.mk_lt_mk]; push_neg at hqp
    exact hrsm q r hqr hqp

    push_neg at hqp
    simp only [hrp, hqp, reduceIte, Subtype.mk_lt_mk]; push_neg at hrp
    calc p.1/p₀*q
      _ ≤ p := by
        rw [div_mul_comm]; nth_rw 2 [← one_mul p.1]
        apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
        apply (div_le_one ?_).mpr; exact hqp
        apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)
        apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
      _ < p+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(r-p₀) := by
        apply lt_add_of_le_of_pos ?_ ?_; rfl
        apply mul_pos; exact hpdiv
        rw [sub_pos, Subtype.coe_lt_coe]; exact hrp


    intro r
    by_cases hpr : r ≤ p
    have hpprI : p₀.1/p*r ∈ I := by
      rw [div_mul_comm]
      apply mul_mem ?_ p₀.2
      apply unitInterval.div_mem r.2.1 p.2.1 hpr
    use ⟨p₀.1/p*r, hpprI⟩
    have hppr : ⟨p₀.1/p*r, hpprI⟩ ≤ p₀ := by
      apply Subtype.mk_le_mk.mpr
      rw [div_mul_comm]; nth_rw 2 [← one_mul p₀.1]
      apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
      apply (div_le_one ?_).mpr; exact hpr
      apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
