      apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)
    simp only [φ, hppr, reduceIte]; apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr
    rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_div_cancel₀, div_self, one_mul]
    apply coe_ne_zero.mpr hpp; exact hp₀0

    push_neg at hpr
    apply hrtop r at hpr
    obtain ⟨q, hpr, hqp⟩ := hpr
    use q
    simp only [φ, hqp, reduceIte]; rw [Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr]
    symm; exact hpr

  have hψ : Tnorm.Isomorphism ψ := by
    suffices StrictMono ψ ∧ Function.Surjective ψ by
      constructor; constructor
      exact StrictMono.injective this.1
      exact this.2
      exact StrictMono.monotone this.1
    constructor
    intro q r hqr; unfold ψ
    by_cases hrp : r ≤ p₀
    have hqp : q ≤ p₀ := le_trans (le_of_lt hqr) hrp
    simp only [hrp, hqp, reduceIte, Subtype.mk_lt_mk]
    apply (mul_lt_mul_left ?_).mpr
    apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt q.2.1 hqr
    apply div_pos
    apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr; apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)

    by_cases hqp : ¬q ≤ p₀
    simp only [hrp, hqp, reduceIte, Subtype.mk_lt_mk]; push_neg at hqp
    exact hrsm q r hqr hqp

    push_neg at hqp
    simp only [hrp, hqp, reduceIte, Subtype.mk_lt_mk]; push_neg at hrp
    calc p.1/√p₀*√q
      _ ≤ p := by
        rw [div_mul_comm, ← Real.sqrt_div q.2.1]; nth_rw 2 [← one_mul p.1]
        apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
        apply Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr
        apply (div_le_one ?_).mpr; exact hqp
        apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)
        apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
      _ < p+(1-p)/(1-p₀)*(r-p₀) := by
        apply lt_add_of_le_of_pos ?_ ?_; rfl
        apply mul_pos; exact hpdiv
        rw [sub_pos, Subtype.coe_lt_coe]; exact hrp



    intro r
    by_cases hpr : r ≤ p
    have hpprI : (√p₀.1/p*r)^2 ∈ I := by
      rw [div_mul_comm, pow_two]
      suffices (r.1/p*√p₀)∈ I by exact mul_mem this this
      apply unitInterval.mul_mem
      apply div_mem r.2.1 p.2.1 hpr
      constructor
      apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
      apply Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr p₀.2.2
    use ⟨(√p₀.1/p*r)^2, hpprI⟩
    have hppr : ⟨(√p₀.1/p*r)^2, hpprI⟩ ≤ p₀ := by
      apply Subtype.mk_le_mk.mpr
      rw [div_mul_comm, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt]; nth_rw 2 [← one_mul p₀.1]
      apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
      apply (sq_le_one_iff₀ ?_).mpr
      apply (div_le_one ?_).mpr; exact hpr
      apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
      apply div_nonneg r.2.1 p.2.1
      apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)
      exact p₀.2.1
    simp only [ψ, hppr, reduceIte]; apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq, ← mul_assoc, div_mul_div_cancel₀, div_self, one_mul]
    exact coe_ne_zero.mpr hpp; apply (Real.sqrt_ne_zero p₀.2.1).mpr hp₀0
    apply mul_nonneg; apply div_nonneg; apply Real.sqrt_nonneg
    exact p.2.1; exact r.2.1


    push_neg at hpr
    apply hrtop r at hpr
    obtain ⟨q, hpr, hqp⟩ := hpr
    use q
    simp only [ψ, hqp, reduceIte]; rw [Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr]
    symm; exact hpr

  have hmfp : (T.mul p p).1/p ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one₀ ?_).mpr
    apply T.mul_self_le_self p
    apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpp
  let hφ' := h ⟨φ, hφ⟩; let hψ' := h ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
  have hφp : p₀.1/p*(T.mul p p) = T.mul p₀ p₀ := by
    have hpI : p₀.1/p*(T.mul p p) ∈ I := by
      rw [div_mul_comm]
      apply unitInterval.mul_mem ?_ p₀.2
      apply unitInterval.div_mem (T.mul p p).2.1 p.2.1
      apply Subtype.coe_le_coe.mpr (T.mul_self_le_self p)
    suffices ⟨p₀.1/p*(T.mul p p), hpI⟩ = T.mul p₀ p₀ by apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mp this

    nth_rw 2 [← hφ']
    simp only [Tnorm.apply_iso, φ, le_refl, reduceIte]
    apply_fun φ; swap; exact hφ.1.1
    rw [Function.rightInverse_invFun hφ.1.2]
    have hpl : ⟨p₀.1/p*(T.mul p p), hpI⟩ ≤ p₀ := by
      apply Subtype.mk_le_mk.mpr
      rw [div_mul_comm]; nth_rw 2 [← one_mul p₀.1]
      apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
      exact hmfp
      apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)
    simp only [φ, hpl, reduceIte]
    apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr
    have hpdiv : p.1/p₀*p₀ = p := by exact div_mul_cancel₀ (↑p) hp₀0
    have hppI : p.1/p₀*p₀ ∈ I := by rw [hpdiv]; exact p.2
    calc (p.1/p₀)*(p₀/p*(T.mul p p))
      _ = (p*(p.1)⁻¹)*(p₀*(p₀.1)⁻¹)*(T.mul p p) := by ring
      _ = T.mul p p := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hp₀0, mul_inv_cancel₀ (coe_ne_zero.mpr hpp)]
        ring
      _ = T.mul ⟨p.1/p₀*p₀, hppI⟩ ⟨p.1/p₀*p₀, hppI⟩ := by
        have hpI' : ⟨p.1/p₀*p₀, hppI⟩ = p := by apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr hpdiv
        rw [hpI']
  have hψp : p₀.1/(p^2)*(T.mul p p)^2 = T.mul p₀ p₀ := by
    have hpI : p₀.1/(p^2)*(T.mul p p)^2 ∈ I := by
      rw [div_mul_comm, ← div_pow, pow_two]
      apply unitInterval.mul_mem ?_ p₀.2
      suffices (T.mul p p).1/p ∈ I by apply unitInterval.mul_mem this this
      apply unitInterval.div_mem (T.mul p p).2.1 p.2.1
      apply Subtype.coe_le_coe.mpr (T.mul_self_le_self p)
    suffices ⟨p₀.1/(p^2)*(T.mul p p)^2, hpI⟩ = T.mul p₀ p₀ by apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mp this

    nth_rw 2 [← hψ']
    simp only [Tnorm.apply_iso, ψ, le_rfl, reduceIte]
    apply_fun ψ; swap; exact hψ.1.1
    rw [Function.rightInverse_invFun hψ.1.2]
    have hpl : ⟨p₀.1/p^2*(T.mul p p)^2, hpI⟩ ≤ p₀ := by
      apply Subtype.mk_le_mk.mpr
      rw [div_mul_comm]; nth_rw 2 [← one_mul p₀.1]
      apply (mul_le_mul_right ?_).mpr
      rw [← div_pow]; apply (sq_le_one_iff₀ ?_).mpr hmfp
      apply div_nonneg (T.mul p p).2.1 p.2.1
      apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coe_ne_zero.mp hp₀0)
    simp only [ψ, hpl, reduceIte]
    apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr
    have hpdiv : p.1/√p₀*√p₀ = p := by
      apply div_mul_cancel₀
      exact (Real.sqrt_ne_zero (nonneg p₀)).mpr hp₀0
    have hppI : p.1/√p₀*√p₀ ∈ I := by rw [hpdiv]; exact p.2
    calc p.1/√p₀*√(p₀/p^2*(T.mul p p)^2)
      _ = p.1/√p₀*(√p₀/√(p^2)*√((T.mul p p)^2)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul, Real.sqrt_div (nonneg p₀)]
        apply div_nonneg (nonneg p₀) ?_
        apply sq_nonneg p.1
      _ = p.1/√p₀*(√p₀/p*(T.mul p p)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq p.2.1, Real.sqrt_sq]
        unit_interval
      _ = (√p₀*(√p₀)⁻¹)*(p*(p.1)⁻¹)*(T.mul p p) := by ring
      _ = T.mul p p := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀, mul_inv_cancel₀, one_mul, one_mul]
        exact coe_ne_zero.mpr hpp
        exact (Real.sqrt_ne_zero (nonneg p₀)).mpr hp₀0
      _ = T.mul ⟨p.1/√p₀*√p₀, hppI⟩ ⟨p.1/√p₀*√p₀, hppI⟩ := by
        have hpI' : ⟨p.1/√p₀*√p₀, hppI⟩ = p := by apply Subtype.mk_eq_mk.mpr hpdiv
        rw [hpI']

  rw [← hφp] at hψp
  ring_nf at hψp
  rw [pow_two, pow_two, mul_assoc p₀.1, mul_assoc p₀.1] at hψp
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp₀0 at hψp
  rw [mul_assoc] at hψp
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero (coe_ne_zero.mpr hpp)) at hψp
  rw [← mul_assoc] at hψp; nth_rw 3 [← one_mul (T.mul p p).1] at hψp
  contrapose! hid
  apply le_of_eq; apply Subtype.coe_inj.mp
  rw [← hφp]; ring_nf; rw [mul_assoc]; nth_rw 1 [← mul_one p₀.1]
  congr; apply coe_ne_zero.mpr at hid
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hid at hψp
  symm; exact hψp

name: cont_of_iso
statement: lemma cont_of_iso {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : _root_.Continuous φ
proof:
:= by
  exact Monotone.continuous_of_surjective hi.2 hi.1.2

name: uni_cont_of_iso
statement: lemma uni_cont_of_iso {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : UniformContinuous φ
proof:
:= by
  exact CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous (cont_of_iso hi)

name: iso_is_strict_mono
statement: lemma iso_is_strict_mono {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : StrictMono φ
proof:
:=
    Monotone.strictMono_of_injective hi.2 hi.1.1

name: mono_inv_is_mono
statement: lemma mono_inv_is_mono {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : Monotone (Function.invFun φ)
proof:
:= by
    let φ' := Function.invFun φ
    intro p q
    contrapose
    intro hpq
    apply lt_of_not_ge at hpq
    apply not_le_of_gt
    apply_fun φ at hpq

    have hφ : Function.RightInverse φ' φ := by exact Function.rightInverse_invFun hi.1.2
    let hφ2 := hφ
    specialize hφ p; specialize hφ2 q;
    rw [hφ, hφ2] at hpq
    exact hpq
    exact iso_is_strict_mono hi

name: iso_inv_is_iso
statement: lemma iso_inv_is_iso {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : Isomorphism (Function.invFun φ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr ?_
  use φ
  constructor
  exact Function.rightInverse_invFun hi.1.2
  exact Function.leftInverse_invFun hi.1.1

  exact mono_inv_is_mono hi

name: iso_inv_is_iso_btwn
statement:
lemma iso_inv_is_iso_btwn {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (hi : IsomorphismBetween T₁ T₂ φ) :
  IsomorphismBetween T₂ T₁ (Function.invFun φ)
proof:
:= by
    constructor; exact iso_inv_is_iso hi.1
    intro p q
    nth_rw 1 [← Function.rightInverse_invFun hi.1.1.2 p, ← Function.rightInverse_invFun hi.1.1.2 q]
    rw [← hi.2, Function.leftInverse_invFun hi.1.1.1]

name: iso_comp
statement: lemma iso_comp {φ ψ : I → I} (hiφ : Isomorphism φ) (hiψ : Isomorphism ψ) : Isomorphism (φ ∘ ψ)
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    apply Function.Bijective.comp hiφ.1 hiψ.1
    apply Monotone.comp hiφ.2 hiψ.2

name: iso_symm'
statement: lemma iso_symm' {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} : Isomorphic T₁ T₂ ↔ Isomorphic T₂ T₁
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    exact iso_symm
    exact iso_symm

name: id_iso
statement: lemma id_iso : Isomorphism id
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  exact Function.bijective_id
  exact fun ⦃a b⦄ a ↦ a

name: iso_rfl
statement: lemma iso_rfl {T : Tnorm} : Isomorphic T T
proof:
:= by
  use id; constructor; exact id_iso
  intro p q; rw [id, id, id]

name: iso_one
statement: lemma iso_one {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : φ 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  apply unitInterval.lt_one_iff_ne_one.mpr at h
  have hex : ∃ p : I, φ p = 1 := by exact hi.1.2 1
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hex
  nth_rw 2 [← hp] at h
  have hpl : p ≤ 1 := le_one p
  apply hi.2 at hpl
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt hpl at h
  exact (lt_self_iff_false (φ p)).mp h

name: iso_zero
statement: lemma iso_zero {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : φ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  apply unitInterval.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr at h
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hi.1.2 0
  nth_rw 1 [← hp] at h
  have hpl : 0 ≤ p := nonneg p
  apply hi.2 at hpl
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt hpl at h
  exact (lt_self_iff_false (φ 0)).mp h

name: apply_is_iso
statement: lemma apply_is_iso {T : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : Isomorphic (apply_iso T hi) T
proof:
:= by
  use φ; constructor; exact hi
  intro p q
  apply Function.rightInverse_invFun hi.1.2

name: apply_is_iso'
statement: lemma apply_is_iso' {T : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (hi : Isomorphism φ) : Isomorphic T (apply_iso T hi)
proof:
:= by
  apply iso_symm (apply_is_iso hi)

name: apply_iso_comp
statement:
lemma apply_iso_comp {T : Tnorm} {φ ψ : I → I} (hφ : Isomorphism φ) (hψ : Isomorphism ψ) :
  (T.apply_iso hφ).apply_iso hψ = T.apply_iso (iso_comp hφ hψ)
proof:
:= by
    ext p q
    unfold apply_iso; simp only
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    have hfinComp : Function.invFun (φ ∘ ψ) = (Function.invFun ψ) ∘ (Function.invFun φ) := by
      apply Function.invFun_eq_of_injective_of_rightInverse (Function.Injective.comp hφ.1.1 hψ.1.1) ?_
      exact Function.RightInverse.comp (Function.rightInverse_invFun hφ.1.2) (Function.rightInverse_invFun hψ.1.2)
    rw [hfinComp, Function.comp_apply]

name: apply_iso_id
statement: lemma apply_iso_id {T : Tnorm} : T.apply_iso (id_iso) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext p q; simp only [apply_iso, id]
  have hid : Function.invFun (id : I → I) = id := by
    exact Function.invFun_eq_of_injective_of_rightInverse (fun ⦃a₁ a₂⦄ a ↦ a) (congrFun rfl)
  rw [hid, id]

name: apply_iso_inv
statement:
lemma apply_iso_inv {T : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (hφ : Isomorphism φ) :
  (T.apply_iso hφ).apply_iso (iso_inv_is_iso hφ) = T
proof:
:= by
    rw [apply_iso_comp]
    nth_rw 2 [← T.apply_iso_id]
    congr
    apply Function.RightInverse.id (Function.rightInverse_invFun hφ.1.2)

name: apply_iso_inv'
statement:
lemma apply_iso_inv' {T : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (hφ : Isomorphism φ) :
  (T.apply_iso (iso_inv_is_iso hφ)).apply_iso hφ = T
proof:
:= by
    rw [apply_iso_comp]
    nth_rw 2 [← T.apply_iso_id]
    congr
    apply Function.LeftInverse.id (Function.leftInverse_invFun hφ.1.1)

name: mul_inv_iso
statement:
lemma mul_inv_iso {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (h : IsomorphismBetween T₁ T₂ φ) :
  ∀ p q : I, T₁.mul ((Function.invFun φ) p) ((Function.invFun φ) q) = (Function.invFun φ) (T₂.mul p q)
proof:
:= by
    intro p q
    obtain ⟨hφ, hm⟩ := h
    apply_fun φ; swap; exact hφ.1.1
    specialize hm ((Function.invFun φ) p) ((Function.invFun φ) q)
    rw [hm]
    have hr : ∀ r : I, φ ((Function.invFun φ) r) = r := by
      intro r; apply Function.rightInverse_invFun hφ.1.2
    rw [hr, hr, hr]

name: iso_left_cont
statement: lemma iso_left_cont {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : T₂.LeftContinuous → T₁.LeftContinuous
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  intro x y p q hmx hmy hx hy
  specialize hc (φ ∘ x) (φ ∘ y) (φ p) (φ q) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  apply Monotone.comp h.1.2 hmx
  apply Monotone.comp h.1.2 hmy
  apply Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hx
  exact Continuous.tendsto' (cont_of_iso h.1) p (φ p) rfl
  apply Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hy
  exact Continuous.tendsto' (cont_of_iso h.1) q (φ q) rfl

  simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← h.2] at hc
  have hr : ∀ r : I, ((Function.invFun φ) ∘ φ) r = r := by
    intro r; apply Function.leftInverse_invFun h.1.1.1
  have hrf : (fun n => T₁.mul (x n) (y n)) = (Function.invFun φ) ∘ (fun n => (φ (T₁.mul (x n) (y n)))) := by
    ext n; rw [Function.comp_apply]; nth_rw 1 [← hr (T₁.mul (x n) (y n)), Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hrf, ← hr (T₁.mul p q)]
  apply Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hc
  apply Continuous.tendsto' (cont_of_iso (iso_inv_is_iso h.1))
  rw [Function.comp_apply]

name: iso_right_cont
statement: lemma iso_right_cont {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : T₂.RightContinuous → T₁.RightContinuous
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  intro x y p q hmx hmy hx hy
  specialize hc (φ ∘ x) (φ ∘ y) (φ p) (φ q) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  apply Monotone.comp_antitone h.1.2 hmx
  apply Monotone.comp_antitone h.1.2 hmy
  apply Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hx
  exact Continuous.tendsto' (cont_of_iso h.1) p (φ p) rfl
  apply Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hy
  exact Continuous.tendsto' (cont_of_iso h.1) q (φ q) rfl

  simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← h.2] at hc
  have hr : ∀ r : I, ((Function.invFun φ) ∘ φ) r = r := by
    intro r; apply Function.leftInverse_invFun h.1.1.1
  have hrf : (fun n => T₁.mul (x n) (y n)) = (Function.invFun φ) ∘ (fun n => (φ (T₁.mul (x n) (y n)))) := by
    ext n; rw [Function.comp_apply]; nth_rw 1 [← hr (T₁.mul (x n) (y n)), Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hrf, ← hr (T₁.mul p q)]
  apply Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hc
  apply Continuous.tendsto' (cont_of_iso (iso_inv_is_iso h.1))
  rw [Function.comp_apply]

name: iso_cont
statement: lemma iso_cont {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : T₂.Continuous → T₁.Continuous
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  apply (cont_iff_left_right T₁).mpr; apply (cont_iff_left_right T₂).mp at hc
  constructor
  exact iso_left_cont h hc.1
  exact iso_right_cont h hc.2

name: iso_strict_mono
statement: lemma iso_strict_mono {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : StrictlyMonotone T₂ → StrictlyMonotone T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hsm p hpp q r hqr
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  specialize hsm (φ p) ?_ (φ q) (φ r) ?_
  rw [← iso_zero h.1]
  apply iso_is_strict_mono h.1 hpp
  apply iso_is_strict_mono h.1 hqr
  rw [← h.2, ← h.2] at hsm
  contrapose! hsm
  apply h.1.2 hsm

name: iso_canc
statement: lemma iso_canc {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : Cancellative T₂ → Cancellative T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  apply (canc_iff_strictly_mono T₁).mpr
  apply (canc_iff_strictly_mono T₂).mp at hc
  exact iso_strict_mono h hc

name: iso_cond_canc
statement: lemma iso_cond_canc {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : ConditionalCancellative T₂ → ConditionalCancellative T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hcc p q r hmul hpr
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  apply_fun φ at hmul
  apply (iso_is_strict_mono h.1) at hpr
  rw [iso_zero h.1] at hpr
  rw [h.2, h.2] at hmul; rw [h.2] at hpr
  specialize hcc (φ p) (φ q) (φ r) hmul hpr
  exact h.1.1.1 hcc

name: iso_npow
statement:
lemma iso_npow {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (h : IsomorphismBetween T₁ T₂ φ) (n : ℕ) (p : I) :
  φ (T₁.npow n p) = T₂.npow n (φ p)
proof:
:= by
    induction' n with n ih
    rw [T₁.npow_zero, T₂.npow_zero, iso_one h.1]
    rw [T₁.npow_succ, T₂.npow_succ, ← ih, h.2]

name: iso_nontrivial
statement:
lemma iso_nontrivial {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} {φ : I → I} (h : IsomorphismBetween T₁ T₂ φ) {p : I}
  (hpnt : IsNontrivial p) : IsNontrivial (φ p)
proof:
:= by
    contrapose! hpnt; unfold IsNontrivial; unfold IsNontrivial at hpnt
    rw [not_and_or]; rw [not_and_or] at hpnt; push_neg; push_neg at hpnt
    rcases hpnt with hpnt|hpnt
    left; rw [← iso_zero h.1] at hpnt
    apply h.1.1.1 hpnt
    right; rw [← iso_one h.1] at hpnt
    apply h.1.1.1 hpnt

name: iso_arch
statement: lemma iso_arch {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : IsArchimedean T₂ → IsArchimedean T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro ha p q hpnt hqnt
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  apply iso_nontrivial h at hpnt;  apply iso_nontrivial h at hqnt
  specialize ha (φ p) (φ q) hpnt hqnt
  obtain ⟨n, ha⟩ := ha; use n
  rw [← iso_npow h n p] at ha
  contrapose! ha
  apply h.1.2 ha

name: iso_lp
statement: lemma iso_lp {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : HasLimitProperty T₂ → HasLimitProperty T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hlp
  apply (arch_iff_lp T₂).mpr at hlp
  apply (arch_iff_lp T₁).mp
  exact iso_arch h hlp

name: iso_ntid
statement: lemma iso_ntid {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : HasNontrivialIdempotent T₂ → HasNontrivialIdempotent T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hid
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨p, hpnt, hmul⟩ := hid
  use (Function.invFun φ) p; constructor
  apply iso_nontrivial (iso_inv_is_iso_btwn h) hpnt
  apply_fun φ; swap; exact h.1.1.1
  rw [h.2, Function.rightInverse_invFun h.1.1.2]
  exact hmul

name: iso_nilpt_el
statement: lemma iso_nilpt_el {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : HasNilpotent T₂ → HasNilpotent T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hn
  obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨p, hpnt, hn⟩ := hn
  use (Function.invFun φ) p; constructor
  exact iso_nontrivial (iso_inv_is_iso_btwn h) hpnt
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hn; use n
  apply_fun φ; swap; exact h.1.1.1
  rw [iso_npow h, Function.rightInverse_invFun h.1.1.2, iso_zero h.1]
  exact hn

name: iso_zd
statement: lemma iso_zd {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : HasZeroDivisors T₂ → HasZeroDivisors T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hzd
  apply (nilpt_el_iff_zd T₂).mpr at hzd
  apply (nilpt_el_iff_zd T₁).mp
  exact iso_nilpt_el h hzd

name: iso_strict
statement: lemma iso_strict {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : Strict T₂ → Strict T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨hc, hm⟩; constructor
  exact iso_cont h hc
  exact iso_strict_mono h hm

name: iso_nilpt
statement: lemma iso_nilpt {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm} (h : Isomorphic T₁ T₂) : Nilpotent T₂ → Nilpotent T₁
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨hc, hn⟩; constructor
  exact iso_cont h hc
  intro p hpnt; obtain ⟨φ, h⟩ := h
  specialize hn (φ p) (iso_nontrivial h hpnt)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hn; use n
  rw [← iso_npow h, ← iso_zero h.1] at hn
  apply h.1.1.1 hn

name: ext_mul
statement:
@[ext high]
lemma ext_mul {T₁ T₂ : Tnorm M} (h : ∀ a b : M, T₁.mul a b = T₂.mul a b) : T₁ = T₂
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : T₁.one = T₂.one := by
    have ht : T₁.one = ⊤ :=
      @one_eq_top M _ T₁.toOne T₁.toIsTopOneClass _
    have ht' : T₂.one = ⊤ := one_eq_top
    rw [ht, ht']
  have hm : T₁.mul = T₂.mul := by
    ext a b
    exact h a b
  ext1
  · exact hm
  · exact h1
  · ext n a
    rw [@npow_eq_pow M T₁.toMonoid, @npow_eq_pow M T₂.toMonoid]
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, @pow_zero M T₁.toMonoid]
      exact h1
    | succ n ih =>
      simp [pow_succ, @pow_succ M T₁.toMonoid, HMul.hMul, hm, ih]
  · have ht : T₁.zero = ⊥ :=
      let : @IsBotZeroClass M _ T₁.toZero :=
        @instIsBotZeroClassOfIsTopOneClassLeft M _ T₁.toMulZeroOneClass
          (@IsOrderedMonoid.toMulLeftMono M T₁.toCommMonoid _ T₁.toIsOrderedMonoid)
          T₁.toIsTopOneClass
      (@bot_eq_zero M _ T₁.toZero this _).symm
    have ht' : T₂.zero = ⊥ := bot_eq_zero.symm
    rw [ht, ht']

name: monotone_continuous_mul
statement:
lemma monotone_continuous_mul [LeftContinuousMul M] : ∀ x y : ℕ → M, ∀ p q : M,
    Monotone x → Monotone y →
    Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)
    → Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds q)
    → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (x n) * (y n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (p * q))
proof:
:= by
  exact fun x y p q a a_1 a_2 a_3 ↦ LeftContinuousMul.monotone_continuous_mul x y p q a a_1 a_2 a_3

name: antitone_continuous_mul
statement:
lemma antitone_continuous_mul [RightContinuousMul M] : ∀ x y : ℕ → M, ∀ p q : M,
    Antitone x → Antitone y →
    Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)
    → Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atTop (nhds q)
    → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (x n) * (y n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (p * q))
proof:
:= by
  exact fun x y p q a a_1 a_2 a_3 ↦ RightContinuousMul.antitone_continuous_mul x y p q a a_1 a_2 a_3

name: LImp_def
statement: lemma LImp_def {p q : M} : p ⇒ q = sSup {r : M | p * r ≤ q}
proof:
:= by
  simp [LImp]

name: zero_LImp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_LImp (p : M) : (0 : M) ⇒ p = (1 : M)
proof:
:= by
  simp [LImp_def, zero_le, one_eq_top]

name: LImp_self
statement: lemma LImp_self (p : M) : p ⇒ p = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [LImp_def, mul_le_left, one_eq_top]

name: mul_LImp
statement: lemma mul_LImp (p q : M) : p * (p ⇒ q) ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LImp_def]
  have hre : {r | p * r ≤ q}.Nonempty := by
    use 0
    simp [zero_le]
  have hrbd : BddAbove {r | p * r ≤ q} := by
    rw [bddAbove_def]
    use 1
    grind [le_one]
  obtain ⟨u, hum, hut, hus⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto_sSup hre hrbd
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hus
  have ht := monotone_continuous_mul _ (fun n ↦ p) u p (p ⇒ q) monotone_const hum
    tendsto_const_nhds hut
  simp only [LImp_def, tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at ht
  apply And.left at ht
  contrapose! ht
  use q
  simp only [ht, true_and]
  intro n
  use n
  grind

name: le_LImp_iff_mul_le
statement: lemma le_LImp_iff_mul_le (p q r : M) : r ≤ p ⇒ q ↔ r * p ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [mul_comm]
    refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_right h p) (mul_LImp p q)
  · intro h
    rw [LImp_def]
    exact le_sSup (by grind)

name: LImp_lt_iff_lt_mul
statement: lemma LImp_lt_iff_lt_mul (p q r : M) : p ⇒ q < r ↔ q < r * p
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  exact le_LImp_iff_mul_le _ _ _

name: map_LImp
statement:
lemma map_LImp (M N : Type*)
    [CompleteLinearOrder M] [CompleteLinearOrder N]
    [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace N]
    [Tnorm M] [Tnorm N]
    [IsFuzzyLogic M] [IsFuzzyLogic N]
    (e : M ≃*o N) (p q : M) :
    e (p ⇒ q) = (e p ⇒ e q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LImp_def, map_sSup]
  congr
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨y, hpq, hy⟩
    rw [← hy, ← map_mul, map_le_map_iff]
    exact hpq
  · intro h
    use e.symm x
    simp only [OrderMonoidIso.apply_symm_apply, and_true]
    rw [← map_inv_le_iff, show EquivLike.inv e (e p * x) = e.symm (e p * x) by rfl,
      map_mul, OrderMonoidIso.symm_apply_apply] at h
    exact h

name: eq_zero_of_ne_one
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_ne_one [SubsingletonZeroOne M] {a : M} (ha : a ≠ 1) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := SubsingletonZeroOne.allEq_zero_or_one a
  grind

name: aux_sInf_eq_sInf
statement:
private lemma aux_sInf_eq_sInf {x : ℕ → M} {p r : M}
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) (n m : ℕ)
    (hr : sInf (x '' Set.Ici n) < r)
    (h : ∀ k, m ≤ k → r < x k) :
    sInf (x '' Set.Ici n) = sInf (x '' Set.Ico n m)
proof:
:= by
  refine csInf_eq_csInf_of_forall_exists_le ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Ici, Set.mem_Ico, exists_exists_and_eq_and,
      forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    contrapose! hr
    rw [le_csInf_iff]
    · grind
    · exact BddBelow.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddBelow_range hx)
    · simp
  · simp
    grind

name: exists_index_eq_sInf_of_lt_limit
statement:
private lemma exists_index_eq_sInf_of_lt_limit {x : ℕ → M} {p : M}
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) (n : ℕ)
    (hs : sInf (x '' Set.Ici n) < p) :
    ∃ k ∈ Set.Ici n, x k = sInf (x '' Set.Ici n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hpq : ∃ r, sInf (x '' Set.Ici n) < r ∧ r < p
  · obtain ⟨r, hqr, hrp⟩ := hpq
    have hx₀ := hx
    rw [tendsto_order] at hx
    obtain ⟨hx, hx'⟩ := hx
    have hx'' := hx r hrp
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hx''
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx''
    have hnm : n < m := by
      contrapose! hm
      apply exists_lt_of_csInf_lt at hqr
      · grind
      · simp
    rw [aux_sInf_eq_sInf hx₀ n m hqr hm]
    suffices sInf (x '' Set.Ico n m) ∈ x '' Set.Ico n m by grind
    refine Set.Nonempty.csInf_mem ?_ ?_
    · simp [hnm]
    · exact Set.Finite.image _ (Set.finite_Ico _ _)
  · contrapose! hs
    refine le_csInf (by simp) ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Ici, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    intro k hnk
    specialize hs k
    have hxk : sInf (x '' Set.Ici n) ≤ x k := by
      refine csInf_le ?_ (by grind)
      exact BddBelow.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddBelow_range hx)
    grind

name: aux_mono_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  intro n k hnk
  refine csInf_le_csInf ?_ (by simp) <| Set.image_mono <| by grind
  exact BddBelow.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddBelow_range hx)

name: aux_le_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  refine csInf_le ?_ (by grind)
  exact BddBelow.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddBelow_range hx)

name: aux_tendsto_sInf_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀ := hx
  simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨hx, hx'⟩ := hx
  constructor
  · intro q hqp
    specialize hx q hqp
    obtain ⟨k, hx⟩ := hx
    use k
    intro m hmk
    by_cases! hap : sInf (x '' Set.Ici m) ≥ p
    · grind
    · obtain ⟨l, hl, hla⟩ := exists_index_eq_sInf_of_lt_limit hx₀ m hap
      grind
  · intro q hpq
    specialize hx' q hpq
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx'
    use k
    intro m hkm
    specialize hk m hkm
    refine csInf_lt_of_lt ?_ (by grind) hk
    exact BddBelow.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddBelow_range hx₀)

name: mono_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma mono_of_tendsto {x : ℕ → M} {p : M} (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → M, Monotone a ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (a n) ≤ (x n)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds p)
proof:
:= by
  use (fun n ↦ sInf (x '' Set.Ici n))
  constructorm* _ ∧ _
  · exact aux_mono_of_tendsto hx
  · exact aux_le_of_tendsto hx
  · exact aux_tendsto_sInf_of_tendsto hx

name: mono_of_tendsto'
statement:
lemma mono_of_tendsto' {x : ℕ → M} {p q : M} (hxq : ∀ n, q < x n)
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → M, Monotone a ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, a n ≤ x n) ∧ (∀ n, q ≤ a n) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds p)
proof:
:= by
  use (fun n ↦ sInf (x '' Set.Ici n))
  constructorm* _ ∧ _
  · exact aux_mono_of_tendsto hx
  · exact aux_le_of_tendsto hx
  · intro n
    exact le_csInf (by simp) (by grind)
  · exact aux_tendsto_sInf_of_tendsto hx

name: aux_sSup_eq_sSup
statement:
private lemma aux_sSup_eq_sSup {x : ℕ → M} {p r : M}
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) (n m : ℕ)
    (hr : sSup (x '' Set.Ici n) > r)
    (h : ∀ k, m ≤ k → r > x k) :
    sSup (x '' Set.Ici n) = sSup (x '' Set.Ico n m)
proof:
:= by
  refine csSup_eq_csSup_of_forall_exists_le ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Ici, Set.mem_Ico, exists_exists_and_eq_and,
      forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    contrapose! hr
    rw [csSup_le_iff]
    · grind
    · exact BddAbove.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddAbove_range hx)
    · simp
  · simp
    grind

name: exists_index_eq_sSup_of_limit_lt
statement:
private lemma exists_index_eq_sSup_of_limit_lt
    {x : ℕ → M} {p : M}
    (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) (n : ℕ)
    (hs : p < sSup (x '' Set.Ici n)) :
    ∃ k ∈ Set.Ici n, x k = sSup (x '' Set.Ici n)
proof:
:= by
  let q := sSup (x '' Set.Ici n)
  by_cases! hpq : ∃ r, q > r ∧ r > p
  · obtain ⟨r, hqr, hrp⟩ := hpq
    have hx₀ := hx
    rw [tendsto_order] at hx
    obtain ⟨hx, hx'⟩ := hx
    have hx'' := hx' r hrp
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hx''
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx''
    have hnm : n < m := by
      contrapose! hm
      apply exists_lt_of_lt_csSup at hqr
      · grind
      · simp
    rw [aux_sSup_eq_sSup hx₀ n m hqr hm]
    suffices sSup (x '' Set.Ico n m) ∈ x '' Set.Ico n m by grind
    refine Set.Nonempty.csSup_mem ?_ ?_
    · simp [hnm]
    · exact Set.Finite.image _ (Set.finite_Ico _ _)
  · contrapose! hs
    refine csSup_le (by simp) ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Ici, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    intro k hnk
    specialize hs k
    have hxk : x k ≤ sSup (x '' Set.Ici n)  := by
      refine le_csSup ?_ (by grind)
      exact BddAbove.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddAbove_range hx)
    grind

name: aux_anti_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  intro n k hnk
  refine csSup_le_csSup ?_ (by simp) <| Set.image_mono <| by grind
  exact BddAbove.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddAbove_range hx)

name: aux_ge_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  refine le_csSup ?_ (by grind)
  exact BddAbove.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddAbove_range hx)

name: aux_tendsto_sSup_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀ := hx
  simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨hx, hx'⟩ := hx
  constructor
  · intro q hqp
    specialize hx q hqp
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx
    use k
    intro m hmk
    specialize hk m hmk
    refine lt_csSup_of_lt ?_ (by grind) hk
    exact BddAbove.mono (by simp) (Filter.Tendsto.bddAbove_range hx₀)
  · intro q hpq
    specialize hx' q hpq
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx'
    use k
    intro m hkm
    by_cases! hap : sSup (x '' Set.Ici m) ≤ p
    · grind
    · obtain ⟨l, hl, hla⟩ := exists_index_eq_sSup_of_limit_lt hx₀ m hap
      grind

name: anti_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma anti_of_tendsto {x : ℕ → M} {p : M} (hx : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → M, Antitone a ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (x n) ≤ (a n)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds p)
proof:
:= by
  use (fun n => sSup (x '' Set.Ici n))
  constructorm* _ ∧ _
  · exact aux_anti_of_tendsto hx
  · exact aux_ge_of_tendsto hx
  · exact aux_tendsto_sSup_of_tendsto hx

name: continuousMul_iff_separatelyContinuousMul
statement:
theorem continuousMul_iff_separatelyContinuousMul :
    ContinuousMul M ↔ SeparatelyContinuousMul M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    infer_instance
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine ContinuousMul.mk ?_
    rw [continuous_iff_seqContinuous]
    intro z ⟨p, q⟩ hz
    rw [Prod.tendsto_iff] at hz
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hz
    simp only [tendsto_order, Function.comp_apply, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt]
    obtain ⟨a, hao, haz, hat⟩ := mono_of_tendsto hx
    obtain ⟨b, hbo, hbz, hbt⟩ := anti_of_tendsto hx
    obtain ⟨c, hco, hcz, hct⟩ := mono_of_tendsto hy
    obtain ⟨d, hdo, hdz, hdt⟩ := anti_of_tendsto hy
    simp_rw [continuous_iff_seqContinuous] at h₁ h₂
    specialize h₁ (a := p)
    constructor
    · intro r hr
      have hc := h₁ hct
      simp only [tendsto_order, Function.comp_apply, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hc
      obtain ⟨N, hc⟩ := hc.1 r hr
      have ha := h₂ (a := c N) hat
      simp only [tendsto_order, Function.comp_apply, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at ha
      obtain ⟨M, ha⟩ := ha.1 r (by grind)
      use N ⊔ M
      intro n hn
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le (ha n (by grind)) ?_
      exact mul_le_mul' (haz n) <| le_trans (hco (le_of_max_le_left hn)) (hcz n)
    · intro r hr
      have hd := h₁ hdt
      simp only [tendsto_order, Function.comp_apply, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hd
      obtain ⟨N, hd⟩ := hd.2 r hr
      have hb := h₂ (a := d N) hbt
      simp only [tendsto_order, Function.comp_apply, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hb
      obtain ⟨M, hb⟩ := hb.2 r (by grind)
      use N ⊔ M
      intro n hn
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (hb n (by grind))
      exact mul_le_mul' (hbz n) <| le_trans (hdz n) (hdo (le_of_max_le_left hn))

name: continuousMul_iff_leftRightContinuousMul
statement:
theorem continuousMul_iff_leftRightContinuousMul :
    ContinuousMul M ↔ LeftContinuousMul M ∧ RightContinuousMul M
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ inferInstance⟩

name: idempt_iff_exists_pow_seq_tendsto
statement:
lemma idempt_iff_exists_pow_seq_tendsto [Preorder M] [IsOrderedMonoid M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    [T2Space M] [RightContinuousMul M] (a : M) :
    IsIdempotentElem a ↔ ∃ p : M, Filter.Tendsto (p ^ ·) Filter.atTop (nhds a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    use a
    have h : Filter.EventuallyEq Filter.atTop (a ^ ·) (fun _ ↦ a) := by
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_atTop]
      use 1
      grind [IsIdempotentElem.pow_eq]
    rw [Filter.tendsto_congr' h]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  · intro ⟨p, hp⟩
    suffices Filter.Tendsto ((p ^ ·) * (p ^ ·)) Filter.atTop (nhds a) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto ((p ^ ·) * (p ^ ·)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a * a)) by
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique this.2 this.1
    constructor
    · have hp2 : (p ^ ·) * (p ^ ·) = (fun n ↦ p ^ n) ∘ (fun n ↦ 2 * n) := by
        ext n
        simp [two_mul, pow_add]
      rw [hp2]
      refine Filter.Tendsto.comp hp <| Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_monotone ?_ ?_
      · grind [Monotone]
      · intro b
        use b
        grind
    · have := pow_right_anti₀ zero_le (le_one (a := p))
      exact antitone_continuous_mul _ (p ^ ·) (p ^ ·) a a this this hp hp

name: exists_pow_tendsto
statement:
lemma exists_pow_tendsto [ConditionallyCompletePartialOrderInf M] [InfConvergenceClass M]
    [IsOrderedMonoid M]
    {p : M} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    ∃ q : M, Filter.Tendsto (p ^ ·) Filter.atTop (nhds q)
proof:
:= by
  use ⨅ n, p ^ n
  refine tendsto_atTop_ciInf (pow_right_anti₀ hp0 hp1) ?_
  rw [bddBelow_def]
  use 0
  simp only [Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]
  intro n
  by_cases! hn : n = 0
  · rw [hn, pow_zero]
    exact le_trans hp0 hp1
  · rw [← zero_pow hn]
    exact pow_le_pow_left' hp0 n

name: lt_one_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma lt_one_of_tendsto [PartialOrder M] [OrderTopology M] [IsTopOneClass M] [OrderTop M]
    [IsOrderedMonoid M]
    {p q : M} (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : Filter.Tendsto (p ^ ·) Filter.atTop (nhds q)) :
    q < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_one_iff_ne_one]
  contrapose! hq
  subst hq
  rw [one_eq_top]
  simp only [nhds_top_order, Filter.tendsto_iInf, Filter.tendsto_principal, Set.mem_Ioi,
    Filter.eventually_atTop, not_forall, not_exists]
  use p, (by rwa [← one_eq_top])
  intro n
  use n + 1
  simp only [le_add_iff_nonneg_right, zero_le, exists_const]
  refine not_lt_of_ge ?_
  conv_rhs => rw [← pow_one p]
  exact pow_right_anti₀ zero_le le_one (by lia)

name: not_isReduced_of_nilpotent
statement:
lemma not_isReduced_of_nilpotent [MonoidWithZero M] [Nilpotent M] [NontrivialZeroOne M] :
    ¬ IsReduced M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isReduced_iff, not_forall]
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ := NontrivialZeroOne.exists_ne (M := M)
  use x
  simp only [exists_prop]
  grind [Nilpotent.nilpt]

name: nilpt_of_not_noZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem nilpt_of_not_noZeroDivisors [SemilatticeInf M] [CommMonoidWithZero M]
    [ContinuousMul M] [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M] [IsOrderedMonoid M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    (h : ¬ NoZeroDivisors M) : Nilpotent M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isReduced_iff_noZeroDivisors_of_arch, isReduced_iff] at h
  push Not at h
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨m, ha⟩, ha0⟩ := h
  rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero] at ha0
  refine Nilpotent.mk ?_
  intro p hp
  rw [← lt_one_iff_ne_one] at hp
  obtain ⟨n, hap⟩ := MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch ha0 hp
  use n * m
  rw [← le_zero_iff]
  grind [pow_mul, pow_le_pow_left']

name: nilpt_tfae'
statement: theorem nilpt_tfae' : [Nilpotent M, ¬ IsReduced M, ¬ NoZeroDivisors M].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := by simp [isReduced_iff_noZeroDivisors_of_arch]
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := by
    exact nilpt_of_not_noZeroDivisors M
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := by
    intro _
    exact not_isReduced_of_nilpotent M
  tfae_finish

name: strict_of_noZeroDivisors_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem strict_of_noZeroDivisors_of_tendsto
  (f : ℕ → M)
  (hf : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
  (hf1 : ∀ n, f n ≠ 1)
  (h : NoZeroDivisors M) : Strict M
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  simp only [strict_iff, posMulStrictMono_iff, not_and, not_forall] at h
  specialize h (by assumption)
  obtain ⟨u, hu0, ⟨v, w, hvw, h⟩⟩ := h
  suffices ∃ z, v ≤ z * w ∧ z ≠ 1 by
    obtain ⟨z, hvz, hz1⟩ := this
    have huzw : u * w * z = u * w := by
      refine le_antisymm (mul_le_left _ _) ?_
      simp only [lt_iff_le_and_ne, mul_le_mul_right hvw.le u, ne_eq, true_and, not_not] at h
      nth_rw 1 [← h, mul_assoc, mul_comm w z]
      exact mul_le_mul_right hvz u
    have huwz : ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≥ 0 → u * w * (z ^ n) = u * w := by
      simp only [ge_iff_le, zero_le, forall_const]
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih => rwa [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih]
    rw [noZeroDivisors_iff]
    push Not
    use u, w
    constructor; swap; constructor
    · exact ne_of_gt hu0
    · exact ne_of_gt <| lt_of_le_of_lt zero_le hvw
    suffices Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ u * w * (z ^ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (u * w)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ u * w * (z ^ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) by
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique this.1 this.2
    constructor
    · exact tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const huwz
    · have huwt : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ u * w) Filter.atTop (nhds (u * w)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds
      have hzt : Filter.Tendsto (z ^ ·) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        rw [← lt_one_iff_ne_one] at hz1
        exact arch_iff_lim_prop.mp (by assumption) hz1
      rw [show 0 = u * w * 0 by exact Eq.symm (mul_zero _)]
      refine antitone_continuous_mul _ _ _ _ _ antitone_const ?_ huwt hzt
      exact pow_right_anti₀ zero_le le_one
  apply Filter.Tendsto.mul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := w)) at hf
  rw [mul_one] at hf
  simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at hf
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf.1 v hvw
  specialize hn n (by rfl)
  rw [mul_comm] at hn
  use f n
  simp [hn.le, hf1 n]

name: nilpt_tfae
statement: theorem nilpt_tfae : [Nilpotent M, ¬ IsReduced M, ¬ NoZeroDivisors M, ¬ Strict M].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := nilpt_of_not_noZeroDivisors M
  tfae_have 2 → 4 := by
    contrapose!
    intro h
    infer_instance
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun _ ↦ not_isReduced_of_nilpotent M
  tfae_have 4 → 3 := by
    intro h
    simp only [strict_iff, posMulStrictMono_iff, not_and, not_forall, not_lt] at h
    specialize h (by assumption)
    obtain ⟨u, hu0, ⟨v, w, hvw, h⟩⟩ := h
    have hz := intermediate_value_univ v 1 (continuous_const_mul w)
    have hvz : v ∈ Set.Icc (w * v) (w * 1) := by
      simp only [mul_one, Set.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · exact mul_le_right _ _
      · exact le_of_lt hvw
    apply hz at hvz
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hvz
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hvz
    have huwz : ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≥ 0 → u * w * (z ^ n) = u * w := by
      simp only [ge_iff_le, zero_le, forall_const]
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih =>
        have huvw : u * w = u * v := le_antisymm h <| mul_le_mul_right hvw.le u
        rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, mul_assoc, hz, huvw]
    rw [noZeroDivisors_iff]
    push Not
    use u, w
    constructor; swap; constructor
    · exact ne_of_gt hu0
    · exact ne_of_gt <| lt_of_le_of_lt zero_le hvw
    suffices Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ u * w * (z ^ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (u * w)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ u * w * (z ^ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) by
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique this.1 this.2
    constructor
    · exact tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const huwz
    · have huwt : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ u * w) Filter.atTop (nhds (u * w)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds
      have hzt : Filter.Tendsto (z ^ ·) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have hz1 : z < 1 := by
          rw [lt_one_iff_ne_one]
          contrapose! hz
          rw [hz, mul_one]
          exact ne_of_gt hvw
        exact arch_iff_lim_prop.mp (by assumption) hz1
      rw [show 0 = u * w * 0 by exact Eq.symm (mul_zero _)]
      refine antitone_continuous_mul _ _ _ _ _ antitone_const ?_ huwt hzt
      exact pow_right_anti₀ zero_le le_one
  tfae_finish

name: nilpt_iff
statement: theorem nilpt_iff : Nilpotent M ↔ ¬ Strict M
proof:
:= by
  refine (nilpt_tfae M) (Nilpotent M) ?_ (¬ Strict M) ?_ <;> simp

name: nilpt_or_strict_of_cont_arch
statement: theorem nilpt_or_strict_of_cont_arch : Nilpotent M ∨ Strict M
proof:
:= by
  grind [nilpt_iff]

name: mul_lt_right
statement: lemma mul_lt_right (p q : M) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) : p * q < q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hnt : ¬Nontrivial M
  · rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hnt
    grind [Subsingleton.eq_one p]
  cases nilpt_or_strict_of_cont_arch M
  · refine lt_of_le_of_ne (mul_le_right p q) ?_
    by_contra!
    have hp : ∀ n, (p ^ n) * q = q := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih => rw [pow_add, pow_one, mul_assoc, this, ih]
    have hp' := Nilpotent.nilpt p hp1
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hp'
    specialize hp n
    rw [hn, zero_mul] at hp
    symm at hp
    contradiction
  · have := PosMulStrictMono.toMulPosStrictMono (α := M)
    exact mul_lt_of_lt_one_left (lt_of_le_of_ne' zero_le hq0) <| (lt_of_le_of_ne le_one hp1)

name: mul_lt_left
statement: lemma mul_lt_left (p q : M) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hq1 : q ≠ 1) : p * q < p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact mul_lt_right q p hq1 hp0

name: npow_right_strictAnti
statement:
theorem npow_right_strictAnti (p : M) (n m : ℕ) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) (hpn : p ^ n ≠ 0)
    (h : n < m) : p ^ m < p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk0, hk⟩ := exists_pos_add_of_lt h
  rw [← hk, pow_add]
  refine mul_lt_left _ _ hpn ?_
  rw [← lt_one_iff_ne_one] at hp1
  refine ne_of_lt <| lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hp1
  nth_rw 2 [← npow_one p]
  exact pow_right_anti₀ zero_le le_one hk0

name: npow_right_inj
statement:
theorem npow_right_inj (p : M) (n m : ℕ) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) (hpn : p ^ n ≠ 0)
    (h : p ^ n = p ^ m) : n = m
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  wlog hnm : n < m generalizing n m
  · symm at h
    contrapose! h
    rw [h] at hpn
    contrapose! h
    push Not at hnm
    exact (this m n hpn h (lt_of_le_of_ne hnm h)).symm
  · exact (ne_of_lt <| npow_right_strictAnti p n m hp1 hpn hnm).symm

name: nontrivialZeroOne_of_card_ge_three
statement:
theorem nontrivialZeroOne_of_card_ge_three [Fintype M] (h : 2 < Fintype.card M) :
    NontrivialZeroOne M
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.two_lt_card_iff] at h
  refine NontrivialZeroOne.mk ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc⟩ := h
  by_cases! ha : a ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 1
  · use a
  by_cases! hb : b ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 1
  · use b
  use c
  grind

name: nontrivialZeroOne_iff_not_subsingletonZeroOne
statement:
theorem nontrivialZeroOne_iff_not_subsingletonZeroOne :
    NontrivialZeroOne M ↔ ¬ SubsingletonZeroOne M
proof:
:= by
  simp [subsingletonZeroOne_iff, nontrivialZeroOne_iff]

name: subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_nontrivialZeroOne
statement:
theorem subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_nontrivialZeroOne :
    SubsingletonZeroOne M ↔ ¬ NontrivialZeroOne M
proof:
:= by
  rw [nontrivialZeroOne_iff_not_subsingletonZeroOne, not_not]

name: nontrivialZeroOne_iff_exists_isNontrivial
statement:
theorem nontrivialZeroOne_iff_exists_isNontrivial :
    NontrivialZeroOne M ↔ ∃ a : M, IsNontrivial a
proof: := nontrivialZeroOne_iff M

name: subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_isNontrivial
statement:
theorem subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_isNontrivial :
    SubsingletonZeroOne M ↔ ∀ a : M, ¬IsNontrivial a
proof:
:= by
  simp [subsingletonZeroOne_iff_not_nontrivialZeroOne, nontrivialZeroOne_iff_exists_isNontrivial]

name: MulPosStrictMon.toInfinite
statement:
theorem MulPosStrictMon.toInfinite [PartialOrder M] [MulZeroOneClass M]
    [MulLeftMono M] [PosMulStrictMono M]
    [IsTopOneClass M] [NontrivialZeroOne M] :
    Infinite M where
  not_finite fin
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha⟩ := exists_covBy_of_wellFoundedLT (isBot_zero.not_isMax (α := M))
    have ha1 : a < 1 := by
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := NontrivialZeroOne.exists_ne (M := M)
      rw [lt_one_iff_ne_one]
      contrapose! ha
      use b
      rwa [ha, pos_iff_ne_zero, lt_one_iff_ne_one]
    have ha02 : 0 < a * a := mul_pos ha0 ha0
    have ha2 : a * a < a := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← mul_one a]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ha1 ha0
    exact ha ha02 ha2

name: npow_tendsto_bot
statement:
lemma npow_tendsto_bot [TopologicalSpace M] [PartialOrder M] [OrderBot M]
    [OrderTopology M] [MonoidWithZero M] [PosMulMono M] [MulLeftMono M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M]
    (p : M) (hp : p ≠ 1) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ p ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tendsto_order, not_lt_bot, Filter.eventually_atTop, IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true,
    gt_iff_lt, true_and]
  intro q hq
  rw [← lt_one_iff_ne_one] at hp
  rw [bot_eq_zero] at hq
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch hq hp
  use n
  intro k hk
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_right_anti₀ zero_le le_one hk) hn

name: arch_iff_lim_prop
statement:
theorem arch_iff_lim_prop [PartialOrder M] [CommMonoidWithZero M] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [OrderTopology M] [IsOrderedMonoid M] [IsBotZeroClass M] :
    MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M ↔ ∀ {p : M}, p < 1 →
    Filter.Tendsto (p ^ ·) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ p hp1 ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.mk ?_⟩
  · simp only [tendsto_order, not_lt_zero, Filter.eventually_atTop, IsEmpty.forall_iff,
      implies_true, gt_iff_lt, true_and]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch hq hp1
    use n
    intro m hnm
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hn
    exact pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one' (le_of_lt hp1) hnm
  · intro x y hx hy
    specialize h hy
    simp only [tendsto_order, Filter.eventually_atTop, gt_iff_lt] at h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.2 x hx
    use n
    grind

name: arch_of_all_nilpt_els
statement:
lemma arch_of_all_nilpt_els [PartialOrder M] [MonoidWithZero M]
    (h : ∀ p : M, p ≠ 1 → IsNilpotent p) : MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M where
  arch
proof:
:= by
    intro x y hx hy
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h y (ne_of_lt hy)
    grind

name: isReduced_iff_noZeroDivisors_of_arch
statement:
theorem isReduced_iff_noZeroDivisors_of_arch [SemilatticeInf M]
    [MonoidWithZero M] [MulLeftMono M] [MulRightMono M] [IsTopOneClass M]
    [MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M] :
    IsReduced M ↔ NoZeroDivisors M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ NoZeroDivisors.mk ?_, fun h ↦ isReduced_of_noZeroDivisors⟩
  intro p q hpq
  suffices p ⊓ q = 0 by
    rw [isReduced_iff] at h
    contrapose! h
    obtain ⟨hp, hq⟩ := h
    use p
    constructor
    · have hp1 : p < 1 := by
        rw [lt_one_iff_ne_one]
        contrapose! hpq
        rwa [hpq, one_mul]
      have hq0 : 0 < q := by rwa [pos_iff_ne_zero]
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := MulArchimedeanDualWithZero.arch hq0 hp1
      use n
      rw [← le_zero_iff, ← this]
      refine le_inf ?_ ?_
      · conv_rhs => rw [← pow_one p]
        have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
          contrapose! hn
          simp [hn, pow_zero]
        exact pow_right_anti₀ zero_le le_one (by lia)
      · exact hn.le
    · exact hp
  rw [isReduced_iff] at h
  refine h _ ?_
  use 2
  rw [pow_two, ← le_zero_iff, ← hpq]
  exact mul_le_mul' inf_le_left inf_le_right

name: aux_converge_ge
statement:
private lemma aux_converge_ge
    (p q r : ℕ → M) {p₀ q₀ : M} (hq : Monotone q) (hr : Monotone r)
    (hrt : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (h : ∀ n, (r n) * (q n) ≤ (p n) ∧ (p n) ≤ (q n))
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds p₀))
    (hqt : Filter.Tendsto q Filter.atTop (nhds q₀)) :
    q₀ ≤ p₀
proof:
:= by
  have ht := left_cont r q 1 q₀ hr hq hrt hqt
  rw [one_mul] at ht
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' ht hpt (by grind)

name: aux_try_converge_eq
statement:
private lemma aux_try_converge_eq
    {U : Set (M × M)} (hU : U ∈ uniformity M) (p q : ℕ → M) {p₀ : M} (h : ∀ n, (p n, q n) ∉ U)
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds p₀))
    (hqt : Filter.Tendsto q Filter.atTop (nhds p₀)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hov, hsv, hVU⟩ := comp_open_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hU
  have hpq : Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ (p n, q n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (p₀, p₀)) :=
    Filter.Tendsto.prodMk_nhds hpt hqt
  have hvn : V ∈ nhds (p₀, p₀) := by
    apply nhds_le_uniformity
    exact hV
  specialize hpq hvn
  simp only [Filter.mem_map, Filter.mem_atTop_sets, Set.mem_preimage] at hpq
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hpq
  specialize hn n (by rfl)
  specialize h n
  suffices (p n, q n) ∈ U by contradiction
  exact (comp_self_subset hVU hV) hn

name: aux_refine_convergent
statement:
private lemma aux_refine_convergent {U : Set (M × M)}
    (hU : U ∈ uniformity M) (p q r : ℕ → M) {p₀ q₀ : M} (hr : Monotone r)
    (hrt : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (h : ∀ n, (p n, q n) ∉ U ∧ (r n) * (q n) ≤ (p n) ∧ (p n) ≤ (q n))
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds p₀))
    (hqt : Filter.Tendsto q Filter.atTop (nhds q₀)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  suffices p₀ = q₀ by
    rw [this] at hpt
    exact aux_try_converge_eq hU p q (by grind) hpt hqt
  suffices ¬ p₀ < q₀ by
    have := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hpt hqt (by grind)
    grind
  by_contra! hpq
  have : DenselyOrdered M := denselyOrdered_of_preconnectedSpace
  obtain ⟨z, hpz, hqz⟩ := exists_between hpq
  have hpt' := hpt; have hqt' := hqt
  simp only [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem, Filter.eventually_atTop] at hpt'
  specialize hpt' (Set.Iio z) <| IsOpen.mem_nhds isOpen_Iio (by grind)
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hpt'
  simp only [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem, Filter.eventually_atTop] at hqt'
  specialize hqt' (Set.Ioi z) <| IsOpen.mem_nhds isOpen_Ioi (by grind)
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hqt'
  let N := N₁ ⊔ N₂
  let φ : ℕ →  ℕ := fun n ↦ n + N
  have hφ : StrictMono φ := by intro n; grind
  suffices q₀ ≤ p₀ by grind
  have hz : ∀ n, z < (q ∘ φ) n := by grind
  obtain ⟨q', hq'm, hqq', hzq', hq't⟩ := mono_of_conv' hz (Filter.Tendsto.comp hqt <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hφ)
  refine aux_converge_ge (p ∘ φ) q' (r ∘ φ) hq'm (Monotone.comp hr <| StrictMono.monotone hφ)
    (Filter.Tendsto.comp hrt <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hφ) ?_
    (Filter.Tendsto.comp hpt <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hφ) hq't
  intro n
  constructor
  · exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_right (by grind) _) (h (φ n)).2.1
  · grind

name: aux_refine_sequences
statement:
private lemma aux_refine_sequences
    {U : Set (M × M)} (hU : U ∈ uniformity M) (p q r : ℕ → M) (hr : Monotone r)
    (hrt : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (h : ∀ n, (p n, q n) ∉ U ∧ (r n) * (q n) ≤ (p n) ∧ (p n) ≤ (q n)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₀, φ, hφ, hp⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq p
  obtain ⟨q₀, ψ, hψ, hq⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq (q ∘ φ)
  exact aux_refine_convergent hU ((p ∘ φ) ∘ ψ) ((q ∘ φ) ∘ ψ) (r ∘ φ ∘ ψ)
    (Monotone.comp hr (Monotone.comp (StrictMono.monotone hφ) (StrictMono.monotone hψ)))
    (Filter.Tendsto.comp hrt <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop <| StrictMono.comp hφ hψ) (by grind)
    (Filter.Tendsto.comp hp <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hψ) hq

name: aux_refine_prod_to_two
statement:
private lemma aux_refine_prod_to_two [Nontrivial M]
    {U : Set (M × M)} (hU : U ∈ uniformity M) (p q : M → M)
    (h : ∀ r < 1, (p r, q r) ∉ U ∧ r * (q r) ≤ (p r) ∧ (p r) ≤ (q r)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have : DenselyOrdered M := denselyOrdered_of_preconnectedSpace
  obtain ⟨r, hrm, hr, hrt⟩ := exists_seq_strictMono_tendsto' (zero_lt_one' M)
  exact aux_refine_sequences hU (p ∘ r) (q ∘ r) r (StrictMono.monotone hrm) hrt (by grind)

name: aux_refine_uniformContinuous
statement:
private lemma aux_refine_uniformContinuous [Nontrivial M]
    {U : Set (M × M)} (hU : U ∈ uniformity M)
    (h : ∀ r < 1, ∃ p : M × M, (p.1, p.2) ∉ U ∧ r * p.2 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  let z : M → M × M := fun r ↦ if hr : r = 1 then (1, 1) else
    Classical.choose <| h r (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_one r) hr)
  refine aux_refine_prod_to_two hU (fun r ↦ (z r).1) (fun r ↦ (z r).2) ?_
  simp only [Prod.mk.eta]
  intro r hr
  simp only [Prod.mk.eta, ne_of_lt hr, ↓reduceDIte, z]
  exact Classical.choose_spec <| h r hr

name: uniformContinuous_of_pocat
statement:
theorem uniformContinuous_of_pocat {X : Type*} [UniformSpace X] (f : X → M)
    (h : PrincipleOfCharityAlmostTrue f) :
    UniformContinuous f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hm : Subsingleton M
  · exact IndiscreteTopology.uniformContinuous
  intro U hU
  simp only [Filter.mem_map]
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVs, hVU⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hU
  by_contra!
  refine aux_refine_uniformContinuous hV ?_
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hr⟩ := h r hr
  obtain ⟨W', hW', hW's, hWW'⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hW
  have hWU : ¬W' ⊆ (fun x ↦ (f x.1, f x.2))⁻¹' U := by
    contrapose! this
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset hW' this
  rw [Set.not_subset] at hWU
  obtain ⟨z, hzW', hzU⟩ := hWU
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage] at hzU
  by_cases! hxyle : f z.1 ≤ f z.2
  · use (f z.1, f z.2)
    simp only [hxyle, and_true]
    constructor
    · contrapose! hzU
      exact (comp_self_subset hVU hV) hzU
    · simp only [PrincipleOfCharity, le_sInf_iff, Set.mem_range, Prod.exists,
        Function.uncurry_apply_pair, PC_Imp, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_LImp, forall_exists_index] at hr
      specialize hr (f z.2 ⇒ f z.1) z.2 z.1
      simp only [(comp_self_subset hWW' hW') (SetRel.symm W' hzW'), ↓reduceIte, le_LImp_iff_mul_le, forall_const] at hr
      exact hr
  · use (f z.2, f z.1)
    constructor; rotate_right; constructor
    · simp only [PrincipleOfCharity, le_sInf_iff, Set.mem_range, Prod.exists,
        Function.uncurry_apply_pair, PC_Imp, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_LImp, forall_exists_index] at hr
      specialize hr (f z.1 ⇒ f z.2) z.1 z.2
      simp only [(comp_self_subset hWW' hW') hzW', ↓reduceIte, forall_const, le_LImp_iff_mul_le] at hr
      exact hr
    · exact le_of_lt hxyle
    · contrapose! hzU
      exact (comp_self_subset hVU hV) (SetRel.symm V hzU)

name: exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_unitInterval
statement:
lemma exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_unitInterval
    (h : ∃ x, AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : I, ∀ p : ℕ → I, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → I,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
  rw [← Filter.principal_univ, accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt,
    ← mem_closure_iff_clusterPt, mem_closure_iff_seq_limit] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_singleton_iff, true_and] at hx
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hda⟩ := refine_seq_uniformity x y hxy hx
  have hxy' : Filter.Tendsto (x ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds y) :=
    Filter.Tendsto.comp hxy <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hφ
  use x ∘ φ; use (fun n ↦ y)
  constructor
  · intro U hU
    simp [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem] at hxy'
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVs, hVU⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hU
    specialize hxy' (UniformSpace.ball y V) <| UniformSpace.ball_mem_nhds y hV
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hxy'
    use N
    intro n hn
    specialize hN n hn
    simp [UniformSpace.ball_eq_of_symmetry] at hN
    grind [refl_mem_uniformity, SetRel.mem_comp]
  · intro q p hpt
    use (dist_fun (x ∘ φ) y p q) ∘ (fun z ↦ dist z y)
    constructor
    · refine UniformContinuous.comp ?_ ?_
      · exact dist_fun_uniformContinuous hxy' hda hpt
      · exact UniformContinuous.dist uniformContinuous_id uniformContinuous_const
    constructor
    · intro n
      simp [dist_fun]
      split_ifs
      · rename_i hd
        specialize hx (φ n)
        simp at hd
        contradiction
      · rename_i hd hn'
        suffices n = Classical.choose hn' by
          simp [interpolate_n]
          conv => lhs; rhs; rw [this]
          conv => rhs; rw [this]
          rw [interpolate_right]
          exact hda (lt_add_one _)
        have hpn := Classical.choose_spec hn'
        obtain ⟨hcn, hnc⟩ := hpn
        refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
        · refine Nat.le_of_lt_succ ?_
          contrapose! hcn
          exact (StrictAnti.antitone hda) hcn
        · contrapose! hnc
          exact hda hnc
      · have hn : ∃ m, dist (x (φ n)) y ∈ Set.Ioc (dist (x (φ (m + 1))) y) (dist (x (φ m)) y) := by
          use n
          simp
          exact hda (lt_add_one n)
        contradiction
    · simp [dist_fun]

name: exists_match_fun_of_match_fun_unitInterval
statement:
lemma exists_match_fun_of_match_fun_unitInterval (e : M ≃ᵤ I)
    (h : ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : I, ∀ p : ℕ → I, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → I,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hU, hf⟩ := h
  use x, y
  constructor
  · exact hU
  intro q p hpq
  specialize hf (e q) (e ∘ p) ?_
  · refine Filter.Tendsto.comp ?_ hpq
    exact Continuous.tendsto (UniformEquiv.continuous _) _
  obtain ⟨f', hf', hfx', hfy'⟩ := hf
  use e.symm ∘ f'
  constructor
  · exact UniformContinuous.comp (UniformEquiv.uniformContinuous_symm e) hf'
  constructor
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hfx' ⊢
    intro n
    rw [← UniformEquiv.coe_symm_toEquiv, Equiv.symm_apply_eq, UniformEquiv.coe_toEquiv]
    exact hfx' n
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hfy' ⊢
    intro n
    rw [← UniformEquiv.coe_symm_toEquiv, Equiv.symm_apply_eq, UniformEquiv.coe_toEquiv]
    exact hfy' n

name: exists_match_fun_of_uniformEquiv_unitInterval
statement:
lemma exists_match_fun_of_uniformEquiv_unitInterval (e : M ≃ᵤ I) (hX : ∃ x : X, AccPt x ⊤) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_match_fun_of_match_fun_unitInterval e ?_
  exact exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_unitInterval hX

name: isClosed_seq_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma isClosed_seq_of_tendsto {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] {x : ℕ → X} {y : X}
    (h : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y)) : IsClosed (insert y (Set.range x))
proof:
:= by
  refine IsCompact.isClosed ?_
  exact Filter.Tendsto.isCompact_insert_range h

name: exists_subseq_of_infinite_indices
statement:
lemma exists_subseq_of_infinite_indices {X : Type*} (x : ℕ → X) {A : Set ℕ}
    (h : A.Infinite) : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ x '' A = Set.range (x ∘ φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : Infinite A := Set.infinite_coe_iff.mpr h
  use Subtype.val ∘ (Nat.Subtype.orderIsoOfNat A)
  constructor
  · refine StrictMono.comp ?_ ?_
    · exact Subtype.strictMono_coe _
    · refine Monotone.strictMono_of_injective ?_ ?_
      · exact OrderIso.monotone _
      · exact Equiv.injective (Nat.Subtype.orderIsoOfNat A).toEquiv
  · ext y
    simp
    constructor
    · intro  ⟨a, ha, haxy⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (OrderIso.surjective (Nat.Subtype.orderIsoOfNat A)) ⟨a, ha⟩
      use n
      simp [hn, haxy]
    · grind

name: continuousOn_seq_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma continuousOn_seq_of_tendsto {X M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace M]
    [T2Space X] {s : Set X} {g : s → M} {x : ℕ → s} {y : s} {p : ℕ → M} {q : M}
    (hxt : Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds y)) (hx : ∀ n, x n ≠ y)
    (hpt : Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q))
    (hgx : ∀ n, g (x n)  = p n) (hgy : g y = q) :
    ContinuousOn g ({y} ∪ Set.range x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_isClosed]
  intro t ht
  by_cases! hqt : q ∈ t
  · let A := {i : ℕ | p i ∈ t}
    use {y} ∪ (x '' A)
    constructor
    · by_cases! hA : A.Finite
      · refine Set.Finite.isClosed ?_
        exact Set.Finite.union (Set.finite_singleton y) <| Set.Finite.image x hA
      · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hxA⟩ := exists_subseq_of_infinite_indices x hA
        rw [hxA]
        have hxt' := Filter.Tendsto.comp hxt <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hφ
        exact isClosed_seq_of_tendsto hxt'
    · grind
  · have hyt : y ∉ g⁻¹' t := by grind
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, p n ∉ t := by
      rw [tendsto_atTop_nhds] at hpt
      exact hpt tᶜ hqt IsClosed.isOpen_compl
    use x '' {i : ℕ | x i ∈ g⁻¹' t}
    constructor
    · refine Set.Finite.isClosed ?_
      refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.toFinite (x '' {i | i < N})) ?_
      grind
    · ext z
      simp
      intro hz
      rcases hz with hz | hz
      · simp at hyt
        subst hz
        simp [hyt, hx]
      · grind

name: exists_open_containing_seq_with_compact_closure
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ K, IsCompact K ∧ ({y} ∪ Set.range x) ⊆ K by
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hxyK⟩ := this
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hKU, _, hcU⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK
        isOpen_univ (Set.subset_univ K)
    use U
    grind
  obtain ⟨K', hK', hKy'⟩ := exists_compact_mem_nhds y
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def] at h
  specialize h K' hKy'
  simp at h
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h
  let f : Fin N → Set X := fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ Classical.choose (exists_compact_mem_nhds (x n))
  use K' ∪ (⋃ n : Fin N, f n)
  constructor
  · refine IsCompact.union hK' ?_
    refine isCompact_iUnion ?_
    intro n
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_compact_mem_nhds (x n.1))).1
  · rw [Set.union_subset_iff]
    constructor
    · simp [mem_of_mem_nhds hKy']
    intro z
    simp
    intro n hn
    subst hn
    by_cases! hn : n < N
    · right
      use ⟨n, hn⟩
      have hf := Classical.choose_spec (exists_compact_mem_nhds (x n))
      simp [f, mem_of_mem_nhds hf.2]
    · left
      exact hN n hn

name: exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_tietze
statement:
lemma exists_match_fun_of_exists_accPt_tietze [TietzeExtension.{u, v} M]
    (h : ∃ x, AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
  rw [← Filter.principal_univ, accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt,
    ← mem_closure_iff_clusterPt, mem_closure_iff_seq_limit] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_singleton_iff, true_and] at hx
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hda⟩ := refine_seq_uniformity x y hxy hx
  have hxy' : Filter.Tendsto (x ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds y) :=
    Filter.Tendsto.comp hxy <| StrictMono.tendsto_atTop hφ
  use x ∘ φ; use (fun n ↦ y)
  constructor
  · intro U hU
    simp [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem] at hxy'
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVs, hVU⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hU
    specialize hxy' (UniformSpace.ball y V) <| UniformSpace.ball_mem_nhds y hV
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hxy'
    use N
    intro n hn
    specialize hN n hn
    simp [UniformSpace.ball_eq_of_symmetry] at hN
    grind [refl_mem_uniformity, SetRel.mem_comp]
  · intro q p hpt
    obtain ⟨U, hyU, hxU, hU, hcU⟩ := exists_open_containing_seq_with_compact_closure hxy'
    let D := {y} ∪ Set.range (x ∘ φ) ∪ Uᶜ
    have hcxy : IsClosed ({y} ∪ Set.range (x ∘ φ)) := isClosed_seq_of_tendsto hxy'
    have hcmb : IsClosed Uᶜ := by
      rw [isClosed_compl_iff]
      exact hU
    have hD : IsClosed D := IsClosed.union hcxy hcmb
    classical let g : D → M := fun a ↦ if a = y then q else
      if hn : ∃ n, a = x (φ n) then p (Classical.choose hn) else q
    have hgy : g ⟨y, by grind⟩ = q := by simp [g]
    have hgx : ∀ n, g ⟨x (φ n), by grind⟩ = p n := by
      intro n
      specialize hx (φ n)
      have hn : ∃ m, x (φ n) = (⟨x (φ m), by grind⟩ : D) := by use n
      simp [g, hx, hn]
      suffices n = Classical.choose hn by
        rw [← this]
      have hn' := Classical.choose_spec hn
      simp at hn'
      apply_fun (fun z ↦ dist z y) at hn'
      exact StrictAnti.injective hda hn'
    have hg : Continuous g := by
      let y' : D := ⟨y, by grind⟩
      let x' : ℕ → D := fun n ↦ ⟨x (φ n), by simp [D]⟩
      let B' := Uᶜ
      let i : B' → D := fun ⟨b, hb⟩ ↦ ⟨b, by
        simp [B'] at hb
        simp [D]
        right; exact hb⟩
      have hxy'' : Filter.Tendsto x' Filter.atTop (nhds y') := by
        rw [tendsto_subtype_rng]
        exact hxy'
      have hu : (Set.univ : Set D) = {y'} ∪ Set.range x' ∪ Set.range i := by
        ext ⟨z, hz⟩
        simp [D] at hz
        simp [y', x', i, B']
        exact hz
      rw [← continuousOn_univ, hu, continuousOn_union_iff_of_isClosed]
      constructor
      · exact continuousOn_seq_of_tendsto hxy'' (by grind) hpt hgx hgy
      · suffices Set.EqOn g (fun w ↦ q) (Set.range i) by
          rw [continuousOn_congr this]
          exact continuousOn_const
        intro z
        simp [g, i, B']
        grind
      · have hsv := IsClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal hD
        rw [Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.isClosed_iff_image_isClosed hsv]
        suffices Subtype.val '' ({y'} ∪ Set.range x') = {y} ∪ Set.range (x ∘ φ) by
          rw [this]
          exact hcxy
        ext z
        simp [y', x']
        grind
      · have hsv := IsClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal hD
        rw [Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.isClosed_iff_image_isClosed hsv]
        suffices Subtype.val '' Set.range i = Uᶜ by
          rw [this]
          exact hcmb
        ext z
        simp [B', i, D]
        intro hdz
        right
        exact hdz
    obtain ⟨f, hfg⟩ := ContinuousMap.exists_restrict_eq hD ⟨g, hg⟩
    use f
    constructor
    · suffices Filter.Tendsto ⇑f (Filter.cocompact X) (nhds q) by
        exact Continuous.uniformContinuous_of_tendsto_cocompact f.2 this
      rw [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem]
      intro s hs
      rw [Filter.Eventually, Filter.mem_cocompact]
      use closure U
      constructor
      · exact hcU
      · intro z
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        intro hz
        suffices z ∉ U by
          have hzd : z ∈ D := by grind
          rw [← ContinuousMap.restrict_apply_mk _ _ _ hzd, hfg]
          simp [g]
          grind [mem_of_mem_nhds]
        exact notMem_of_notMem_closure hz
    constructor
    · intro n
      suffices (x ∘ φ) n ∈ D by
        rw [← ContinuousMap.restrict_apply_mk _ _ _ this, hfg]
        simp [hgx]
      simp [D]
    · have hy : y ∈ D := by grind
      rw [← ContinuousMap.restrict_apply_mk _ _ _ hy, hfg]
      simp [hgy]

name: charitableOn_of_discreteUniformity
statement: theorem charitableOn_of_discreteUniformity [DiscreteUniformity X] : IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  intro f _ p hp
  use SetRel.id
  simp [DiscreteUniformity.eq_principal_setRelId, PC_Imp]
  intro q x y
  split_ifs
  · rename_i hxy
    simp_all [LImp_self]
    grind
  · rename_i hxy
    grind

name: notCharitableOn_of_noZeroDivisors_seq
statement:
lemma notCharitableOn_of_noZeroDivisors_seq [Nontrivial M]
    (hM : NoZeroDivisors M) (x y : ℕ → X) (hxy : ∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U)
    (hf : ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)) : ¬ IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hap, hp, hpt⟩ := exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto' (zero_lt_one' M)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfx, hfy⟩ := hf 0 p hpt
  unfold IsCharitableOn
  push Not
  use f
  constructor
  · exact hf
  simp [PrincipleOfCharityAlmostTrue, PC_Imp]
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr1⟩ := exists_between (zero_lt_one' M)
  use r
  simp only [hr1, true_and]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxy U hU
  specialize hn n (by rfl)
  use x n; use y n
  simp only [hn, ↓reduceIte, hfx n, hfy n, LImp_lt_iff_lt_mul, pos_iff_ne_zero', ne_eq, mul_eq_zero,
    not_or]
  specialize hp n
  rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hp
  simp_rw [← ne_eq, ← pos_iff_ne_zero', hp.1, hr0, true_and]

name: notCharitableOn_of_nontrivialIdempotent_seq
statement:
lemma notCharitableOn_of_nontrivialIdempotent_seq [Nontrivial M]
    (hM : ¬ NoNontrivialIdempotents M) (x y : ℕ → X)
    (hxy : ∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U)
    (hf : ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)) : ¬ IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  simp [noNontrivialIdempotents_iff] at hM
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0, hq1⟩ := hM
  rw [← ne_eq, ← pos_iff_ne_zero'] at hq0
  obtain ⟨p, hap, hp, hpt⟩ := exists_seq_strictMono_tendsto' hq0
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfx, hfy⟩ := hf q p hpt
  simp [IsCharitableOn, PrincipleOfCharityAlmostTrue, PC_Imp]
  use f
  simp [hf]
  use q
  constructor
  · grind [le_one q]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVs, hVU⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hU
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxy V hV
  specialize hn n (by rfl)
  use y n; use x n
  apply SetRel.symm at hn
  have hn' : (y n, x n) ∈ U := by grind [refl_mem_uniformity, SetRel.mem_comp]
  simp [hn', LImp_lt_iff_lt_mul, hfy n, hq, hfx n]
  specialize hp n
  rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hp
  exact hp.2

name: notCharitableOn_of_nonArchimedean_seq
statement:
lemma notCharitableOn_of_nonArchimedean_seq [Nontrivial M]
    (hM : NoNontrivialIdempotents M) (harch : ¬MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M) (x y : ℕ → X)
    (hxy : ∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U)
    (hf : ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)) : ¬ IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulArchimedeanDualWithZero_iff] at harch
  push Not at harch
  obtain ⟨r, p, hr0, hp1, hpr⟩ := harch
  let A := Set.range (fun n : ℕ ↦ p ^ n)
  let q := sInf A
  have hqA : q ∉ A := by
    contrapose! hM
    rw [noNontrivialIdempotents_iff]
    push Not
    use q
    simp [A] at hM
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM
    constructor
    · refine le_antisymm (mul_le_left q q) ?_
      conv => rhs; rw [← hn, ← pow_add]
      exact sInf_le (by simp [A])
    · constructor
      · refine ne_of_gt ?_
        refine lt_of_lt_of_le hr0 ?_
        rw [← hn]
        exact hpr n
      · refine ne_of_lt ?_
        refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hp1
        refine sInf_le ?_
        simp [A]
        use 1
        simp
  have hqp : ∀ n, q < p ^ n := by
    contrapose! hqA
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hqA
    simp only [Set.mem_range, A]
    use n
    exact le_antisymm hn <| sInf_le (by simp [A])
  have hqp' : Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ p ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds q) := by
    simp [tendsto_order]
    constructor
    · intro q' hqq'
      use 0
      intro n _
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hqq' ?_
      exact sInf_le (by simp [A])
    · intro q' hqq'
      rw [sInf_lt_iff] at hqq'
      obtain ⟨p', hpA, hpq⟩ := hqq'
      simp [A] at hpA
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hpA
      use n
      intro k hnk
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hpq
      rw [← hn]
      exact pow_right_anti₀ (nonneg p) (le_one p) hnk
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfx, hfy⟩ := hf q (fun n ↦ p ^ n) hqp'
  simp [IsCharitableOn]
  use f
  simp [hf, PrincipleOfCharityAlmostTrue, PC_Imp]
  use p
  constructor
  · exact hp1
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxy U hU
  specialize hn n (by rfl)
  use x n; use y n
  simp [hn, LImp_lt_iff_lt_mul, hfx n, hfy n, ← pow_succ']
  exact hqp (n + 1)

name: charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_match_fun
statement:
theorem charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_match_fun
    (h : ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)) :
    IsCharitableOn X M ↔ Nilpotent M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hM : Subsingleton M
  · simp [charitableOn_of_subsingleton]
    exact inferInstance
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hf⟩ := h
    contrapose!
    intro hN
    by_cases! hnzd : NoZeroDivisors M
    · exact notCharitableOn_of_noZeroDivisors_seq hnzd x y hxy hf
    by_cases! hntid : ¬ NoNontrivialIdempotents M
    · exact notCharitableOn_of_nontrivialIdempotent_seq hntid x y hxy hf
    have hm : ¬MulArchimedeanDualWithZero M := by
      contrapose! hN
      exact nilpt_of_noZeroDivisors M hnzd
    exact notCharitableOn_of_nonArchimedean_seq hntid hm x y hxy hf
  · intro hn
    exact charitableOn_of_nilpotent

name: exists_match_fun_of_no_accPt_tietze
statement:
lemma exists_match_fun_of_no_accPt_tietze {M : Type*} [UniformSpace M]
    (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X) (h : ∀ x, ¬ AccPt x (⊤ : Filter X)) :
    ∃ x y : ℕ → X, (∀ U ∈ uniformity X, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (x n, y n) ∈ U) ∧
    ∀ q : M, ∀ p : ℕ → M, Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds q) → ∃ f : X → M,
    UniformContinuous f ∧ (∀ n, f (x n) = p n) ∧ (∀ n, f (y n) = q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, ht, hd, hxi⟩ := exists_inj_djsoint_seqs_dist_tendsto_zero hd h
  use x, y
  constructor
  · simp [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem] at ht
    intro U hU
    rw [Metric.mem_uniformity_dist] at hU
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hU⟩ := hU
    specialize ht (Metric.ball 0 ε) <| Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ht
    use N
    intro n hn
    specialize hN n hn
    simp at hN
    exact hU hN
  · intro q p hpq
    let f : X → M := (fun z ↦ if hn : ∃ n, z = x n then p (Classical.choose hn) else q)
    use f
    constructor
    · have hf : Filter.Tendsto f (Filter.cocompact X) (nhds q) := by
        intro U hU
        simp [Filter.mem_cocompact]
        simp [Filter.tendsto_iff_forall_eventually_mem] at hpq
        specialize hpq U hU
        obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hpq
        use {x n | n < N}
        constructor
        · refine Set.Finite.isCompact ?_
          refine Set.Finite.image _ ?_
          simp
          refine Set.finite_iff_bddAbove.mpr ?_
          rw [bddAbove_def]
          use N
          intro y
          exact fun a ↦ Nat.le_of_succ_le a
        · intro z hz
          by_cases! hn : ∃ n, z = x n
          · grind
          · grind [mem_of_mem_nhds]
      refine Continuous.uniformContinuous_of_tendsto_cocompact ?_ hf
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      exact continuousAt_of_not_accPt_top (h x)
    · constructor
      · intro n
        simp [f]
        have hn : ∃ m, x n = x m := by use n
        suffices n = Classical.choose hn by rw [← this]
        have hm := Classical.choose_spec hn
        exact hxi hm
      · intro n
        simp [f]
        intro m
        rw [Set.disjoint_range_iff] at hd
        grind

name: charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_noAccPt
statement:
theorem charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_noAccPt (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X)
    (hX : ∀ x : X, ¬ AccPt x ⊤) :
    IsCharitableOn X M ↔ Nilpotent M
proof:
:=
  charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_match_fun <| exists_match_fun_of_no_accPt_tietze hd hX

name: charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_unitInterval
statement:
theorem charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_unitInterval (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X)
    (e : M ≃ᵤ unitInterval) : IsCharitableOn X M ↔ Nilpotent M
proof:

  by_cases! hX : ∃ x : X, AccPt x ⊤
  · exact charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_match_fun <| exists_match_fun_of_uniformEquiv_unitInterval e hX
  · exact charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_noAccPt hd hX

name: charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_tietzeExtension
statement:
theorem charitable_iff_nilpotent_of_tietzeExtension (hd : ¬ DiscreteUniformity X) :
    IsCharitableOn X M ↔ Nilpotent M
