name: poc_anti
statement: theorem poc_anti (f : X → M) : Antitone (PrincipleOfCharity f)
proof:
:= by
  intro U V h
  simp [PrincipleOfCharity]
  intro p x y hp
  subst hp
  by_cases hU : (x, y) ∈ U
  · refine sInf_le ?_
    simp [PC_Imp]
    have hV : (x, y) ∈ V := h hU
    grind
  · simp [PC_Imp, le_one, hU]

name: charitableOn_of_charitableOn
statement:
theorem charitableOn_of_charitableOn {M N : Type*}
    [CompleteLinearOrder M] [CompleteLinearOrder N]
    [UniformSpace M] [UniformSpace N]
    [Tnorm M] [Tnorm N]
    [IsFuzzyLogic M] [IsFuzzyLogic N] (e : M ≃*o N) (h : IsCharitableOn X M) :
    IsCharitableOn X N
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  let g : X → M := e.symm ∘ f
  have hug := UniformContinuous.comp (CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous
    (OrderIso.continuous e.symm.toOrderIso)) hf

  intro p hp
  specialize h g hug (e.symm p) ?_
  · rw [← map_one e.symm, map_lt_map_iff]
    exact hp
  obtain ⟨U, hU, h⟩ := h
  use U
  constructor; exact hU
  unfold PrincipleOfCharity at h ⊢
  rw [← le_map_inv_iff] at h
  simp [PC_Imp] at h ⊢
  simp_rw [apply_ite e, map_LImp] at h
  simp [g] at h
  exact h

name: charitableOn_iff_charitableOn
statement:
theorem charitableOn_iff_charitableOn {M N : Type*}
    [CompleteLinearOrder M] [CompleteLinearOrder N]
    [UniformSpace M] [UniformSpace N]
    [Tnorm M] [Tnorm N]
    [IsFuzzyLogic M] [IsFuzzyLogic N] (e : M ≃*o N) :
    IsCharitableOn X M ↔ IsCharitableOn X N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact charitableOn_of_charitableOn e
  · exact charitableOn_of_charitableOn e.symm

name: charitableOn_of_subsingleton
statement: lemma charitableOn_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] : IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf p hp
  use Set.univ
  simp

name: pocat_iff_uni_cont
statement:
theorem pocat_iff_uni_cont (f : X → I) :
  UniformContinuous f ↔ PrincipleOfCharityAlmostTrue f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p hp
    rw [uniformContinuous_def] at h
    specialize h {(q, r) | Tnorm.lukMul.mul p q ≤ r} ?_
    · rw [Metric.mem_uniformity_dist]
      simp only [gt_iff_lt, Mul.mul, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Subtype.forall,
        Subtype.mk_le_mk, sup_le_iff, tsub_le_iff_right]
      use (1 - p)
      simp only [sub_pos, unitInterval.coe_lt_one, hp, true_and]
      intro q hq r hr hqr
      constructor
      · exact hr.1
      simp only [dist] at hqr
      grind
    use {x | (f x.1, f x.2) ∈ {(q, r) | Tnorm.lukMul.mul p q ≤ r}}
    simp only [h, le_sInf_iff, Set.mem_range, Prod.exists, Function.uncurry_apply_pair,
      forall_exists_index, true_and, PC_Imp]
    intro q x y hq
    subst hq
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, @mul_one _ Tnorm.lukTnorm.toMulOneClass,
      @mul_zero _ Tnorm.lukTnorm.toMulZeroClass, zero_LImp]
    split_ifs
    · rename_i hxy
      rw [le_LImp_iff_mul_le]
      exact hxy
    · exact le_of_lt hp
  · intro h U hU
    rw [Metric.mem_uniformity_dist] at hU
    obtain ⟨δ, hd, hU⟩ := hU

    unfold PrincipleOfCharityAlmostTrue PrincipleOfCharity at h
    simp only [Filter.mem_map]
    specialize h ⟨0 ⊔ (1 - δ / 2), by grind⟩ ?_
    · rw [Subtype.mk_lt_mk, show (1 : I) = (1 : ℝ) by
        simp only [Set.Icc.coe_eq_one]]
      grind
    obtain ⟨V, hV, h⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hWs, hWV⟩ := comp_symm_mem_uniformity_sets hV
    simp only [le_sInf_iff, Set.mem_range, Prod.exists, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, PC_Imp,
      @mul_one _ Tnorm.lukTnorm.toMulOneClass, @mul_zero _ Tnorm.lukTnorm.toMulZeroClass,
      zero_LImp, forall_exists_index, Subtype.forall, Subtype.mk_le_mk] at h
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset hW ?_
    intro (x, y) hxy
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage]
    refine hU ?_
    have h' := h
    apply comp_self_subset hWV at hW
    specialize h (f x ⇒ f y).1 (f x ⇒ f y).2 x y
    specialize h' (f y ⇒ f x).1 (f y ⇒ f x).2 y x
    simp only [hW hxy, ↓reduceIte, Tnorm.luk_LImp_eq_min, forall_const, hW (SetRel.symm W hxy)] at h h'
    simp only [dist]
    grind

name: luk_isCharitableOn
statement: theorem luk_isCharitableOn (X : Type*) [UniformSpace X] : IsCharitableOn X I
proof:
:= by
  intro f h
  exact (pocat_iff_uni_cont f).mp h

name: charitableOn_of_iso_luk
statement:
theorem charitableOn_of_iso_luk {M : Type*} [CompleteLinearOrder M] [UniformSpace M]
    [Tnorm M] [IsFuzzyLogic M]
    (e : @OrderMonoidIso M I _ _ _ Tnorm.lukMul) : IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  rw [charitableOn_iff_charitableOn e]
  exact luk_isCharitableOn X

name: charitableOn_of_nilpotent
statement:
theorem charitableOn_of_nilpotent {M : Type*} [UniformSpace M] [CompleteLinearOrder M]
    [DenselyOrdered M] [Tnorm M] [IsFuzzyLogic M] [Nilpotent M] :
    IsCharitableOn X M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hm : Subsingleton M
  · exact charitableOn_of_subsingleton
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := iso_luk_of_nilpt M
  exact charitableOn_of_iso_luk e
